stem.bm: Selesaikan x² − 5x + 6 = 0.
stem.en: Solve x² − 5x + 6 = 0.

explanation.bm: (x−2)(x−3)=0, maka x=2 atau 3.

stem.bm: Graf y = −x² + 6x − 5 mempunyai titik maksimum yang mana?
stem.en: Which is the maximum point of y = −x² + 6x − 5?

explanation.bm: y=−(x−3)²+4; nilai maksimum ialah 4 pada x=3.
explanation.en: y=−(x−3)²+4; the maximum is 4 at x=3.

stem.bm: Segi empat tepat mempunyai lebar x cm dan panjang (x+3) cm. Luasnya 40 cm². Cari perimeter.
stem.en: A rectangle has width x cm and length (x+3) cm. Its area is 40 cm². Find its perimeter.

explanation.bm: x²+3x−40=(x+8)(x−5)=0. Lebar positif ialah 5 cm; panjang 8 cm; perimeter 26 cm.
explanation.en: x²+3x−40=(x+8)(x−5)=0. The positive width is 5 cm, length 8 cm and perimeter 26 cm.

stem.bm: Cari 34₅ + 12₅ dalam asas lima.
stem.en: Find 34₅ + 12₅ in base five.

stem.bm: Diberi 23_b = 15₁₀. Tentukan asas b.
stem.en: Given 23_b = 15₁₀, determine base b.

explanation.bm: 2b+3=15 memberikan b=6, dan kedua-dua digit kurang daripada 6.
explanation.en: 2b+3=15 gives b=6, and both digits are below 6.

stem.bm: Apakah penafian bagi pernyataan “Semua nombor perdana ialah ganjil”?
stem.en: What is the negation of “All prime numbers are odd”?

options.bm: Sekurang-kurangnya satu nombor perdana bukan ganjil
options.en: At least one prime number is not odd

explanation.bm: Penafian “semua” ialah “sekurang-kurangnya satu tidak”. Nombor 2 ialah contoh balas.
explanation.en: The negation of “all” is “at least one is not”. The prime 2 is a counterexample.

stem.bm: Pernyataan “Jika n ialah gandaan 4, maka n ialah genap” mempunyai kontrapositif yang mana?
stem.en: Which is the contrapositive of “If n is a multiple of 4, then n is even”?

options.bm: Jika n genap, maka n gandaan 4
options.en: If n is even, then n is a multiple of 4

options.bm: Jika n bukan genap, maka n bukan gandaan 4
options.en: If n is not even, then n is not a multiple of 4

options.bm: Jika n bukan gandaan 4, maka n bukan genap
options.en: If n is not a multiple of 4, then n is not even

options.bm: Jika n gandaan 4, maka n bukan genap
options.en: If n is a multiple of 4, then n is not even

explanation.bm: Kontrapositif p⇒q ialah bukan q⇒bukan p.
explanation.en: The contrapositive of p⇒q is not q⇒not p.

stem.bm: Premis: Jika p maka q. q adalah benar. Kesimpulan: p adalah benar. Bagaimanakah hujah ini?
stem.en: Premises: If p then q. q is true. Conclusion: p is true. How is this argument classified?

explanation.bm: q mungkin benar walaupun p palsu; contohnya nombor genap tidak semestinya gandaan 4.
explanation.en: q may be true when p is false; for example, an even number need not be a multiple of 4.

stem.bm: Dalam 40 murid, 22 menyertai kelab A, 18 kelab B dan 7 kedua-duanya. Berapa murid tidak menyertai kedua-dua kelab?
stem.en: Of 40 students, 22 join club A, 18 join club B and 7 join both. How many join neither club?

explanation.bm: n(A∪B)=22+18−7=33. Yang tidak menyertai=40−33=7.
B′={1,5,6}; hanya 1 juga berada dalam A.
explanation.en: B′={1,5,6}; only 1 also belongs to A.

stem.bm: Jika n(A)=16, n(B)=13 dan n(A∪B)=24, cari n(A∩B).
stem.en: If n(A)=16, n(B)=13 and n(A∪B)=24, find n(A∩B).

stem.bm: Graf ringkas mempunyai sisi AB, AC, BC dan CD. Berapakah darjah bucu C?
stem.en: A simple graph has edges AB, AC, BC and CD. What is the degree of vertex C?

explanation.bm: C bersambung dengan A, B dan D melalui tiga sisi.
explanation.en: C is joined to A, B and D by three edges.

stem.bm: Rangkaian tidak berarah mempunyai AB=4, AC=7, BC=2, BD=6 dan CD=3 km. Cari jarak laluan terpendek A ke D.
stem.en: An undirected network has AB=4, AC=7, BC=2, BD=6 and CD=3 km. Find the shortest distance from A to D.

explanation.bm: A–B–C–D berjarak 4+2+3=9 km; A–B–D dan A–C–D masing-masing 10 km.
explanation.en: A–B–C–D is 4+2+3=9 km; A–B–D and A–C–D are each 10 km.

stem.bm: Setiap graf ringkas berikut mempunyai bucu A,B,C,D. Senarai sisi manakah membentuk pokok?
stem.en: Each simple graph below has vertices A,B,C,D. Which edge list forms a tree?

explanation.bm: AB,BC,CD menghubungkan semua empat bucu tanpa kitaran. Graf kedua mengandungi kitaran dan D terasing; graf ketiga berkitaran; graf keempat tidak bersambung.
explanation.en: AB,BC,CD connects all four vertices without cycles. The second graph has a cycle and isolated D; the third has a cycle; the fourth is disconnected.

stem.bm: Titik manakah memenuhi x≥0, y≥0 dan 2x+y≤8?
stem.en: Which point satisfies x≥0, y≥0 and 2x+y≤8?

explanation.bm: Bagi (3,2), 2(3)+2=8 dan kedua-dua koordinat bukan negatif. Pilihan lain melanggar satu kekangan.
explanation.en: For (3,2), 2(3)+2=8 and both coordinates are non-negative. Each other option violates a constraint.

stem.bm: Apakah jenis garis sempadan dan rantau bagi y>2x−1?
stem.en: What boundary and region represent y>2x−1?

explanation.bm: Ketaksamaan ketat tidak termasuk sempadan; nilai y lebih besar berada di atas garis.
explanation.en: A strict inequality excludes the boundary; greater y values lie above the line.

stem.bm: Bilangan pek x,y ialah integer bukan negatif. Jika x+y≤9 dan x≥4, apakah nilai maksimum y?
stem.en: Pack counts x,y are non-negative integers. If x+y≤9 and x≥4, what is the maximum y?

explanation.bm: y≤9−x≤5. Nilai 5 boleh dicapai apabila x=4.
explanation.en: y≤9−x≤5. The value 5 is attained at x=4.

stem.bm: Graf jarak-masa melalui (2 min,0.4 km) dan (8 min,1.6 km) pada segmen lurus. Cari laju.
stem.en: A distance-time graph passes through (2 min,0.4 km) and (8 min,1.6 km) on a straight segment. Find the speed.

stem.bm: Laju meningkat secara seragam daripada 0 kepada 12 m/s dalam 6 s, kemudian kekal 12 m/s selama 4 s. Cari jarak dilalui.
stem.en: Speed increases uniformly from 0 to 12 m/s in 6 s, then stays at 12 m/s for 4 s. Find the distance travelled.

explanation.bm: Luas segi tiga ½×6×12=36 dan segi empat tepat 4×12=48. Jumlah 84 m.
explanation.en: Triangle area ½×6×12=36 and rectangle area 4×12=48. Total 84 m.

stem.bm: Kereta bergerak 90 km dalam 1.5 jam dan berhenti 0.5 jam. Cari laju purata sepanjang dua jam itu.
stem.en: A car travels 90 km in 1.5 hours and stops for 0.5 hours. Find its average speed over the two hours.

explanation.bm: Laju purata menggunakan keseluruhan masa: 90/(1.5+0.5)=45 km/h.
explanation.en: Average speed uses all elapsed time: 90/(1.5+0.5)=45 km/h.

stem.bm: Cari varians populasi bagi data 2,4,6.
stem.en: Find the population variance of 2,4,6.

explanation.bm: Min=4; jumlah kuasa dua sisihan=4+0+4=8; bahagi 3 memberikan 8/3.
explanation.en: Mean=4; squared deviations sum to 4+0+4=8; divide by 3 to obtain 8/3.

stem.bm: Set data mempunyai sisihan piawai 3. Setiap nilai ditambah 5. Cari sisihan piawai baharu.
stem.en: A data set has standard deviation 3. Every value is increased by 5. Find the new standard deviation.

explanation.bm: Menambah pemalar mengalihkan min tetapi tidak mengubah sisihan daripada min.
explanation.en: Adding a constant shifts the mean but leaves deviations from the mean unchanged.

stem.bm: Data tersusun ialah 2,3,4,6,7,8,9,12. Gunakan median separuh bawah/atas untuk Q₁,Q₃. Cari julat antara kuartil.
stem.en: Ordered data are 2,3,4,6,7,8,9,12. Use medians of the lower/upper halves for Q₁,Q₃. Find the interquartile range.

stem.bm: Beg mengandungi 3 bola merah dan 2 biru. Dua bola dipilih tanpa pengembalian. Cari kebarangkalian kedua-duanya merah.
stem.en: A bag contains 3 red and 2 blue balls. Two are drawn without replacement. Find the probability both are red.

explanation.bm: (3/5)(2/4)=3/10; bilangan bola berubah selepas cabutan pertama.
explanation.en: (3/5)(2/4)=3/10; the counts change after the first draw.

stem.bm: P(A)=0.4, P(B)=0.5 dan A,B bebas. Cari P(A∪B).
stem.en: P(A)=0.4, P(B)=0.5 and A,B are independent. Find P(A∪B).

stem.bm: Dadu adil dibaling sekali. A={1,2,3}, B={3,4}. Pernyataan manakah betul?
stem.en: A fair die is rolled once. A={1,2,3}, B={3,4}. Which statement is correct?

options.bm: A,B tidak saling eksklusif dan tidak bebas
options.en: A,B are neither mutually exclusive nor independent

options.bm: A,B tidak saling eksklusif tetapi bebas
options.en: A,B are not mutually exclusive but independent
A,B are mutually exclusive and independent

options.bm: A,B saling eksklusif tetapi tidak bebas
options.en: A,B are mutually exclusive but not independent

explanation.bm: Persilangan={3}, P=1/6. P(A)P(B)=(1/2)(1/3)=1/6, maka bebas tetapi bukan saling eksklusif.
explanation.en: Intersection={3}, probability 1/6. P(A)P(B)=(1/2)(1/3)=1/6, so independent but not mutually exclusive.

stem.bm: Pendapatan bulanan RM3200. Perbelanjaan tetap RM1400 dan berubah RM950. Cari aliran tunai sebelum simpanan.
stem.en: Monthly income is RM3200. Fixed expenses are RM1400 and variable expenses RM950. Find cash flow before savings.

stem.bm: Sasaran simpanan RM3600 dalam 12 bulan. Simpanan kini RM600. Tanpa faedah, berapa perlu disimpan setiap bulan?
stem.en: The savings target is RM3600 in 12 months. Current savings are RM600. With no interest, how much must be saved monthly?

stem.bm: Pendapatan RM2800 dan perbelanjaan RM2500 sebulan. Matlamat simpanan RM450 sebulan. Apakah pengurangan minimum perbelanjaan untuk mencapai matlamat?
stem.en: Income is RM2800 and expenses RM2500 monthly. The savings goal is RM450 monthly. What minimum expense reduction meets the goal?

explanation.bm: Lebihan kini RM300. Tambahan RM150 diperlukan untuk mencapai RM450.
explanation.en: Current surplus is RM300. Another RM150 is needed to reach RM450.

prompt.bm: Papan tanda segi empat tepat mempunyai panjang (x+2) m, lebar x m dan luas 24 m². (a) Bentuk dan selesaikan persamaan kuadratik. (b) Tentukan perimeter. (c) Jelaskan mengapa satu punca ditolak.
prompt.en: A rectangular sign has length (x+2) m, width x m and area 24 m². (a) Form and solve a quadratic equation. (b) Find its perimeter. (c) Explain why one root is rejected.

modelAnswer.bm: x(x+2)=24; (x+6)(x−4)=0; x=4 atau −6. Lebar 4 m, panjang 6 m, perimeter 20 m. −6 ditolak kerana panjang mesti positif.
modelAnswer.en: x(x+2)=24; (x+6)(x−4)=0; x=4 or −6. Width 4 m, length 6 m, perimeter 20 m. Reject −6 because a length must be positive.

prompt.bm: Satu rekod menyimpan bilangan 11010₂. (a) Tukarkan kepada asas sepuluh dan asas lima. (b) Selepas 7₁₀ rekod ditambah, tulis jumlah dalam asas dua. Tunjukkan nilai tempat.
prompt.en: A record stores a count of 11010₂. (a) Convert it to base ten and base five. (b) After adding 7₁₀ records, write the total in base two. Show place values.

prompt.bm: Seorang murid berkata: “Jika bentuk ialah segi empat sama, maka bentuk ialah segi empat tepat. Bentuk P ialah segi empat tepat, maka P ialah segi empat sama.” (a) Tulis akas dan kontrapositif implikasi asal. (b) Nilai hujah dengan contoh balas berukuran.
prompt.en: A student says: “If a shape is a square, then it is a rectangle. P is a rectangle, so P is a square.” (a) State the converse and contrapositive of the original implication. (b) Evaluate the argument using a counterexample with dimensions.

modelAnswer.bm: Akas: jika segi empat tepat, maka segi empat sama. Kontrapositif: jika bukan segi empat tepat, maka bukan segi empat sama. Hujah tidak sah: segi empat tepat 2 cm × 5 cm memenuhi premis kedua tetapi bukan segi empat sama.
modelAnswer.en: Converse: if a rectangle, then a square. Contrapositive: if not a rectangle, then not a square. Invalid argument: a 2 cm × 5 cm rectangle satisfies the second premise but is not a square.

prompt.bm: Daripada 50 murid, 28 menyertai sukan S, 24 muzik M dan 12 kedua-duanya. Lukis rajah Venn dengan semua empat kawasan berlabel. Cari bilangan yang menyertai tepat satu kelab dan kebarangkalian murid rawak menyertai sekurang-kurangnya satu kelab.
prompt.en: Of 50 students, 28 join sport S, 24 music M and 12 both. Draw a Venn diagram labelling all four regions. Find the number joining exactly one club and the probability a random student joins at least one club.

modelAnswer.bm: S sahaja=16, kedua-duanya=12, M sahaja=12, luar=10. Tepat satu=28. P(S∪M)=40/50=4/5.
modelAnswer.en: S only=16, both=12, M only=12, neither=10. Exactly one=28. P(S∪M)=40/50=4/5.

prompt.bm: Rangkaian tidak berarah mempunyai AB=3, AC=5, BC=2, BD=6, CD=4. (a) Cari jumlah berat pokok rentangan minimum dan senaraikan sisinya. (b) Cari laluan terpendek A ke D. Jelaskan mengapa dua jawapan mengoptimumkan perkara yang berbeza.
prompt.en: An undirected network has AB=3, AC=5, BC=2, BD=6, CD=4. (a) Find the minimum spanning tree weight and list its edges. (b) Find the shortest path from A to D. Explain why these optimise different quantities.

modelAnswer.bm: Pokok minimum BC, AB, CD: berat 2+3+4=9. Laluan terpendek A–B–D, A–B–C–D atau A–C–D masing-masing 9. Pokok menghubungkan semua bucu tanpa kitaran dengan jumlah berat minimum; laluan hanya menghubungkan A dan D.
modelAnswer.en: Minimum tree BC, AB, CD: weight 2+3+4=9. Shortest paths A–B–D, A–B–C–D or A–C–D each have weight 9. A spanning tree connects every vertex without cycles with minimum total weight; a path connects only A and D.

prompt.bm: Bengkel menghasilkan x meja dan y kerusi. Masa: 2x+y≤12. Permintaan: x+y≥4. x,y≥0. Lukis garis sempadan dan lorek rantau yang memenuhi semua syarat. Senaraikan empat bucu rantau. Adakah (5,3) boleh dilaksanakan?
prompt.en: A workshop makes x tables and y chairs. Time: 2x+y≤12. Demand: x+y≥4. x,y≥0. Draw the boundary lines and shade the feasible region. List its four vertices. Is (5,3) feasible?

modelAnswer.bm: Bucu (0,4),(0,12),(6,0),(4,0). Gunakan garis penuh. (5,3) tidak memenuhi 2x+y≤12 kerana 13>12.
modelAnswer.en: Vertices (0,4),(0,12),(6,0),(4,0). Use solid boundaries. (5,3) fails 2x+y≤12 since 13>12.

prompt.bm: Bas memecut seragam dari rehat ke 10 m/s selama 8 s, bergerak pada 10 m/s selama 12 s, kemudian memperlahankan seragam ke rehat selama 5 s. Lukis graf laju-masa, cari jarak keseluruhan dan laju purata bagi 25 s.
prompt.en: A bus accelerates uniformly from rest to 10 m/s over 8 s, travels at 10 m/s for 12 s, then decelerates uniformly to rest over 5 s. Draw a speed-time graph, find the total distance and average speed over 25 s.

point.bm: Graf dengan paksi/unit dan empat titik
point.en: Graph with axes/units and four points

prompt.bm: Masa penghantaran (minit) ialah A: 8,10,12 dan B: 6,10,14. Kira min dan varians populasi setiap set. Syarikat mahu masa yang lebih konsisten. Pilih A atau B dan justifikasikan tanpa mendakwa pilihan itu sentiasa lebih cepat.
prompt.en: Delivery times (minutes) are A: 8,10,12 and B: 6,10,14. Calculate each mean and population variance. The company wants more consistent times. Choose A or B and justify without claiming it is always faster.

modelAnswer.bm: Kedua-dua min ialah 10. Varians A=(4+0+4)/3=8/3; B=(16+0+16)/3=32/3. A lebih konsisten kerana varians lebih kecil; min adalah sama.
modelAnswer.en: Both means are 10. Variance A=(4+0+4)/3=8/3; B=(16+0+16)/3=32/3. A is more consistent because its variance is smaller; means are equal.

point.bm: Pilihan A dengan serakan dan min yang betul
point.en: Choice A with correct dispersion/mean explanation

prompt.bm: Beg mengandungi 4 bola putih dan 3 hitam. Dua bola dipilih tanpa pengembalian. Lukis rajah pokok lengkap dengan kebarangkalian. Cari kebarangkalian tepat satu bola hitam. Bandingkan dengan nilai jika pengembalian dibuat selepas cabutan pertama.
prompt.en: A bag contains 4 white and 3 black balls. Two are drawn without replacement. Draw a probability tree. Find the probability of exactly one black ball. Compare with the value if the first ball is replaced.

modelAnswer.bm: Tanpa pengembalian: (4/7)(3/6)+(3/7)(4/6)=4/7. Dengan pengembalian: 2(4/7)(3/7)=24/49. Tanpa pengembalian lebih besar sebanyak 4/49.
modelAnswer.en: Without replacement: (4/7)(3/6)+(3/7)(4/6)=4/7. With replacement: 2(4/7)(3/7)=24/49. Without replacement is greater by 4/49.

prompt.bm: Pendapatan bulanan RM3000, kos tetap RM1600 dan kos berubah RM1000. Dana kecemasan sasaran RM6000; kini RM1200. Sasaran dicapai dalam 12 bulan tanpa faedah. Kira simpanan bulanan diperlukan, semak kebolehcapaian dan cadangkan belanjawan baharu jika kos berubah meningkat RM150.
prompt.en: Monthly income is RM3000, fixed costs RM1600 and variable costs RM1000. Target emergency fund RM6000; currently RM1200. Reach it in 12 months without interest. Calculate required monthly saving, assess feasibility and propose a revised budget if variable costs rise by RM150.

modelAnswer.bm: Diperlukan (6000−1200)/12=RM400 sebulan. Lebihan asal RM400, jadi boleh dicapai tanpa margin. Apabila kos berubah RM1150, lebihan RM250: kurangkan kos sebanyak RM150 atau tambah pendapatan RM150 supaya simpanan RM400.
modelAnswer.en: Required saving (6000−1200)/12=RM400 monthly. Original surplus RM400, achievable with no margin. At variable costs RM1150, surplus is RM250: reduce costs by RM150 or increase income by RM150 to restore RM400 saving.

point.bm: Cadangan bernombor yang menutup jurang RM150

stem.en: For a fixed job, time t varies inversely as worker count n. Six workers take 10 hours. Two equally productive workers are added. Find the new time.

explanation.bm: nt=60. Dengan 8 pekerja, t=60/8=7.5 jam.
explanation.en: nt=60. With 8 workers, t=60/8=7.5 hours.

stem.bm: z berubah secara langsung dengan x dan songsang dengan √y. Jika x digandakan dan y didarab 4, apakah perubahan z?
stem.en: z varies directly as x and inversely as √y. If x doubles and y is multiplied by 4, how does z change?

explanation.bm: Faktor perubahan=2/√4=1.
explanation.en: Change factor=2/√4=1.

stem.bm: A=[[1,2],[0,3]], B=[[2,1],[4,0]]. Cari unsur baris 1 lajur 2 bagi AB.
stem.en: A=[[1,2],[0,3]], B=[[2,1],[4,0]]. Find entry row 1 column 2 of AB.

explanation.bm: Darab baris pertama A dengan lajur kedua B: 1×1+2×0=1.
explanation.en: Multiply the first row of A by the second column of B: 1×1+2×0=1.

explanation.bm: Penentu mesti sifar: 6k−6=0, maka k=1.
explanation.en: The determinant must be zero: 6k−6=0, giving k=1.

stem.bm: Polisi contoh mengenakan deduktibel RM500 bagi tuntutan kerosakan RM4200, tanpa had lain. Berapa dibayar penanggung insurans?
stem.en: A sample policy applies a RM500 deductible to a RM4200 damage claim, with no other limits. How much does the insurer pay?

explanation.bm: Penanggung membayar tuntutan tolak deduktibel: 4200−500=3700.
explanation.en: The insurer pays the claim less the deductible: 4200−500=3700.

stem.bm: Polisi contoh membayar 80% bil yang layak; pemegang polisi membayar 20%. Tiada deduktibel. Bil RM3500. Cari bayaran pemegang polisi.
stem.en: A sample policy pays 80% of an eligible bill; the holder pays 20%. There is no deductible. The bill is RM3500. Find the holder’s payment.

explanation.bm: 0.20×3500=700. Kadar adalah syarat contoh, bukan kadar polisi sebenar.
explanation.en: 0.20×3500=700. The rate is a stated example, not an actual policy rate.

stem.bm: Premium asas contoh RM1200 diberi diskaun tanpa tuntutan 25%. Selepas diskaun, caj tetap RM30 ditambah. Cari jumlah.
stem.en: A sample basic premium RM1200 gets a 25% no-claim discount. A fixed RM30 charge is added after discount. Find the total.

stem.bm: Jadual cukai rekaan untuk latihan: RM20000 pertama pada 0%, baki hingga RM30000 pada 5%. Pendapatan bercukai RM26000. Cari cukai sebelum rebat.
stem.en: A fictional practice tax schedule: first RM20000 at 0%, remainder up to RM30000 at 5%. Chargeable income is RM26000. Find tax before rebates.

explanation.bm: Hanya baki RM6000 dikenakan 5%: 6000×0.05=300. Ini bukan jadual cukai sebenar.
explanation.en: Only the RM6000 remainder is taxed at 5%: 6000×0.05=300. This is not a real tax schedule.

stem.bm: Contoh cukai taksiran: nilai tahunan RM18000, kadar yang diberikan 6%. Cari cukai tahunan.
stem.en: Assessment-tax example: annual value RM18000, stated rate 6%. Find annual tax.

explanation.bm: 18000×0.06=1080. Kadar diberi untuk latihan sahaja.
explanation.en: 18000×0.06=1080. The rate is supplied for practice only.

stem.bm: Cukai dikira RM720 sebelum rebat RM150. Bayaran ansuran terkumpul RM500. Berapa baki perlu dibayar?
stem.en: Calculated tax is RM720 before a RM150 rebate. Instalments paid total RM500. What balance remains?

stem.bm: Suatu pembesaran berfaktor skala −2 memetakan bentuk luas 6 cm². Cari luas imej.
stem.en: An enlargement with scale factor −2 maps a shape of area 6 cm². Find the image area.

explanation.bm: Luas didarab k²=(−2)²=4, maka 24 cm².
explanation.en: Area is multiplied by k²=(−2)²=4, giving 24 cm².

stem.bm: P=(1,2) ditranslasikan oleh (3,−1), kemudian dipantulkan pada paksi-x. Cari imej akhir.
stem.en: P=(1,2) is translated by (3,−1), then reflected in the x-axis. Find its final image.

explanation.bm: Translasi memberikan (4,1); pantulan paksi-x memberikan (4,−1).
explanation.en: Translation gives (4,1); reflection in the x-axis gives (4,−1).

stem.bm: Poligon sekata manakah boleh menteselasikan satah sendiri tanpa jurang atau pertindihan?
stem.en: Which regular polygon can tessellate the plane alone without gaps or overlaps?

explanation.bm: Sudut dalam heksagon 120°; tiga sudut berjumlah 360°. Pilihan lain tidak membahagi 360° secara integer.
explanation.en: A hexagon’s interior angle is 120°; three meet to make 360°. The other angles do not divide 360° into an integer number.

stem.bm: Cari sin 150°.
stem.en: Find sin 150°.

explanation.bm: 150° berada dalam kuadran II; sinus positif dengan sudut rujukan 30°.
explanation.en: 150° is in quadrant II; sine is positive with reference angle 30°.

stem.bm: Apakah tempoh graf y=2 sin(3x), dengan x dalam darjah?
stem.en: What is the period of y=2 sin(3x), with x in degrees?

explanation.bm: Tempoh=360°/3=120°; faktor 2 hanya mengubah amplitud.
explanation.en: Period=360°/3=120°; the factor 2 changes only amplitude.

stem.bm: Selesaikan cos x=−1/2 bagi 0°≤x≤360°.
stem.en: Solve cos x=−1/2 for 0°≤x≤360°.

explanation.bm: Kosinus negatif dalam kuadran II dan III, sudut rujukan 60°.
explanation.en: Cosine is negative in quadrants II and III, with reference angle 60°.

stem.bm: Kelas 0≤x<10 mempunyai kekerapan 2; 10≤x<20 kekerapan 3. Anggarkan min menggunakan titik tengah.
stem.en: Class 0≤x<10 has frequency 2; 10≤x<20 frequency 3. Estimate the mean using midpoints.

explanation.en: Midpoints are 5,15. Mean=(2×5+3×15)/5=11.

stem.bm: Data terkumpul mempunyai Σf=10, Σfx=60 dan Σfx²=400, x ialah titik tengah. Cari anggaran varians populasi.
stem.en: Grouped data have Σf=10, Σfx=60 and Σfx²=400, where x is a midpoint. Find estimated population variance.

stem.bm: Semua sempadan kelas ditambah 5 dan kekerapan tidak berubah. Apakah kesan pada anggaran min dan sisihan piawai?
stem.en: Every class boundary is increased by 5 with frequencies unchanged. How do estimated mean and standard deviation change?

options.en: Mean increases by 5, standard deviation unchanged
Mean unchanged, standard deviation increases by 5

explanation.bm: Titik tengah bertambah 5, jadi min bertambah 5. Sisihan daripada min kekal.
explanation.en: Midpoints increase by 5, shifting the mean by 5. Deviations from the mean are unchanged.

stem.bm: Model kos C=120+8n digunakan untuk n peserta. Apakah maksud 120?
stem.en: Cost model C=120+8n is used for n participants. What does 120 represent?

explanation.bm: Apabila n=0, C=120. Ini bahagian kos yang tidak bergantung pada bilangan peserta.
explanation.en: At n=0, C=120. This cost component does not depend on participant count.

stem.bm: Data kos: 10 peserta RM180; 20 peserta RM260. Model linear C=a+bn yang melalui kedua-dua titik mempunyai persamaan yang mana?
stem.en: Cost data: 10 participants RM180; 20 participants RM260. Which linear model C=a+bn passes through both points?

stem.bm: Model meramalkan 150 jualan, tetapi rekod sebenar 126. Jika ralat peratus diukur relatif kepada rekod sebenar, cari ralat peratus.
stem.en: A model predicts 150 sales, but the actual count is 126. If percentage error is relative to actual count, find percentage error.

explanation.bm: |150−126|/126×100%=19.0476…%. Penyebut ialah rekod sebenar seperti ditakrifkan.
explanation.en: |150−126|/126×100%=19.0476…%. The denominator is actual count, as defined.

prompt.bm: Bilangan item N berubah secara langsung dengan bilangan mesin m dan masa t. Empat mesin menghasilkan 240 item dalam 3 jam. Tentukan pemalar, ramalkan hasil 6 mesin selama 5 jam dan nyatakan satu andaian yang perlu untuk ramalan.
prompt.en: Output N varies directly as machine count m and time t. Four machines make 240 items in 3 hours. Find the constant, predict the output of 6 machines over 5 hours and state an assumption needed for the prediction.

modelAnswer.bm: N=kmt; k=240/(4×3)=20 item/(mesin·jam). N=20×6×5=600. Andaian: semua mesin beroperasi pada kadar sama dan tiada masa henti atau kekurangan bahan.
modelAnswer.en: N=kmt; k=240/(4×3)=20 items/(machine·hour). N=20×6×5=600. Assume equal constant machine productivity with no downtime or material shortage.

prompt.bm: Dua sandwic dan tiga jus berharga RM19. Tiga sandwic dan dua jus berharga RM21. Tulis sistem sebagai AX=B, cari A⁻¹ dan tentukan setiap harga. Semak dalam kedua-dua urus niaga.
prompt.en: Two sandwiches and three juices cost RM19. Three sandwiches and two juices cost RM21. Write AX=B, find A⁻¹ and determine each price. Check both transactions.

prompt.bm: Dua polisi contoh untuk tuntutan tunggal: A premium RM400 dan deduktibel RM1000; B premium RM650 dan deduktibel RM300. Kedua-duanya membayar baki kerugian yang layak dan tiada had lain. Bagi kerugian RM5000, kira bayaran penanggung dan jumlah kos pemegang (premium+deduktibel). Jelaskan mengapa hasil ini sahaja tidak membuktikan B sentiasa pilihan terbaik.
prompt.en: Two sample policies for a single claim: A premium RM400 and deductible RM1000; B premium RM650 and deductible RM300. Both cover the remaining eligible loss with no other limits. For a RM5000 loss, find insurer payouts and holder costs (premium+deductible). Explain why this alone does not prove B is always best.

modelAnswer.bm: A: pampasan RM4000, kos pemegang RM1400. B: pampasan RM4700, kos RM950. B lebih murah RM450 dalam senario tuntutan ini. Jika tiada tuntutan, A premium lebih rendah RM250; kebarangkalian tuntutan dan syarat sebenar juga perlu dinilai.
modelAnswer.en: A: insurer RM4000, holder RM1400. B: insurer RM4700, holder RM950. B costs RM450 less in this claim scenario. With no claim, A’s premium is RM250 less; claim likelihood and actual terms also matter.

point.bm: Had kesimpulan melalui senario tanpa tuntutan

prompt.bm: Guna jadual rekaan: RM15000 pertama 0%; RM10000 seterusnya 4%; baki melebihi RM25000 hingga RM40000 pada 8%. Pendapatan bercukai RM32000, rebat RM120, ansuran RM600. Kira cukai sebelum rebat, cukai bersih dan baki/refund. Jelaskan mengapa 8% tidak didarab dengan seluruh RM32000.
prompt.en: Use a fictional schedule: first RM15000 at 0%; next RM10000 at 4%; excess over RM25000 up to RM40000 at 8%. Chargeable income RM32000, rebate RM120, instalments RM600. Find pre-rebate tax, net tax and balance/refund. Explain why 8% is not applied to all RM32000.

modelAnswer.bm: Cukai=10000(0.04)+7000(0.08)=400+560=960. Selepas rebat=840; baki=240. Kadar berbeza digunakan pada jalur masing-masing; 8% hanya pada RM7000 dalam jalur atas. Jadual rekaan bukan nasihat cukai.
modelAnswer.en: Tax=10000(0.04)+7000(0.08)=400+560=960. After rebate=840; balance=240. Each band uses its own rate; 8% applies only to RM7000 in the upper band. Fictional schedule, not tax advice.

prompt.bm: Segi tiga ABC mempunyai A(1,1),B(3,1),C(1,2). T ialah translasi (2,0); R ialah pantulan pada paksi-y. (a) Cari imej A apabila T diikuti R, dan apabila R diikuti T. (b) Buktikan imej segi tiga kekal kongruen dengan menggunakan panjang sisi.
prompt.en: Triangle ABC has A(1,1),B(3,1),C(1,2). T is translation (2,0); R is reflection in the y-axis. (a) Find the image of A under T then R, and R then T. (b) Show triangle images remain congruent by comparing side lengths.

modelAnswer.bm: T kemudian R: A→(3,1)→(−3,1). R kemudian T: A→(−1,1)→(1,1). AB=2, AC=1, BC=√5; kedua-dua transformasi isometri mengekalkan panjang ini, maka kongruen walaupun kedudukan berbeza.
modelAnswer.en: T then R: A→(3,1)→(−3,1). R then T: A→(−1,1)→(1,1). AB=2, AC=1, BC=√5; both isometries preserve these lengths, giving congruent images despite different positions.

prompt.bm: Lakar y=2 sin x untuk 0°≤x≤360°, label lima titik utama. Nyatakan amplitud dan tempoh. Cari semua penyelesaian y=1 dalam selang itu dan tunjukkan sudut rujukan.
prompt.en: Sketch y=2 sin x for 0°≤x≤360°, labelling five key points. State amplitude and period. Find all solutions of y=1 in that interval and show the reference angle.

prompt.bm: Jadual masa (minit): 0≤t<10: f=2; 10≤t<20: f=4; 20≤t<30: f=2. Kira titik tengah, anggaran min, varians populasi dan sisihan piawai. Jelaskan mengapa hasil ini anggaran.
prompt.en: Time table (minutes): 0≤t<10: f=2; 10≤t<20: f=4; 20≤t<30: f=2. Find midpoints, estimated mean, population variance and standard deviation. Explain why these are estimates.

modelAnswer.bm: Titik tengah 5,15,25. Σf=8, Σfx=120, Σfx²=2200. Min=15; varians=2200/8−225=50; sisihan piawai=√50≈7.071 minit. Nilai asal dalam setiap kelas tidak diketahui dan digantikan oleh titik tengah.
modelAnswer.en: Midpoints 5,15,25. Σf=8, Σfx=120, Σfx²=2200. Mean=15; variance=2200/8−225=50; standard deviation=√50≈7.071 minutes. Individual values are unknown and replaced by class midpoints.

prompt.bm: Kos sebenar bagi 20 peserta RM500 dan 40 peserta RM800. Bentuk model linear C=a+bn, ramalkan kos 50 peserta dan kos per peserta. Kos sebenar 50 peserta kemudian ialah RM1010. Kira beza, bincangkan satu kemungkinan andaian gagal dan cadangkan data baharu untuk memurnikan model.
prompt.en: Observed trip costs are RM500 for 20 participants and RM800 for 40. Form C=a+bn, predict cost for 50 and cost per participant. Actual cost for 50 is later RM1010. Find the difference, discuss one assumption that may fail and propose new data to refine the model.

modelAnswer.bm: b=15,a=200. C(50)=950; RM19 seorang. Beza=RM60 (model terkurang anggar). Kemungkinan: kapasiti bas memerlukan bas tambahan; kumpulkan kos berhampiran had kapasiti dan modelkan caj bertingkat. Jawapan relevan lain diterima.
modelAnswer.en: b=15,a=200. C(50)=950; RM19 per person. Difference RM60 (underprediction). A bus-capacity threshold may require an extra bus; collect costs near capacity limits and model a step charge. Other relevant answers are accepted.

title.zh: 中四附加数学

description.bm: Komposisi, songsangan, domain dan julat.
description.en: Composition, inverses, domains and ranges.

description.bm: Diskriminan, punca dan bentuk kuasa dua sempurna.
description.en: Discriminants, roots and completed-square form.

description.bm: Sistem tiga linear dan satu linear/satu tak linear.
description.en: Three linear equations and linear/nonlinear systems.

description.bm: Hukum indeks, pemudahan surd dan persamaan logaritma.
description.en: Index laws, surd simplification and logarithmic equations.

description.bm: Janjang aritmetik dan geometri, termasuk hasil tambah.
description.en: Arithmetic and geometric progressions and sums.

description.en: Transforming nonlinear relationships into straight lines.

description.en: Section formula, perpendicular lines and area.

description.en: Magnitude, unit vectors, parallelism and ratios.

description.en: Price indices, weights and base-year changes.

stem.bm: f(x)=2x−1 dan g(x)=x²+3. Cari f(g(2)).
stem.en: f(x)=2x−1 and g(x)=x²+3. Find f(g(2)).

explanation.bm: g(2)=7; f(7)=14−1=13. Susunan komposisi adalah penting.
explanation.en: g(2)=7; f(7)=14−1=13. Composition order matters.

stem.bm: f(x)=(3x−2)/5. Cari f⁻¹(x).
stem.en: f(x)=(3x−2)/5. Find f⁻¹(x).

explanation.bm: y=(3x−2)/5 ⇒ x=(5y+2)/3; tukar nama pemboleh ubah.
explanation.en: y=(3x−2)/5 ⇒ x=(5y+2)/3; rename the variable.

stem.bm: f(x)=x² dengan domain −2≤x≤3. Apakah julat f?
stem.en: f(x)=x² with domain −2≤x≤3. What is its range?

explanation.bm: Domain mengandungi 0, jadi minimum 0. Nilai terbesar ialah 3²=9.
explanation.en: The domain contains 0, giving minimum 0. The largest value is 3²=9.

stem.bm: Persamaan x²−6x+k=0 mempunyai dua punca sama. Cari k.
stem.en: x²−6x+k=0 has equal roots. Find k.

explanation.bm: Diskriminan 36−4k=0 ⇒ k=9.
explanation.en: Discriminant 36−4k=0 ⇒ k=9.

stem.bm: Cari nilai minimum f(x)=2x²−8x+11.
stem.en: Find the minimum value of f(x)=2x²−8x+11.

explanation.bm: f(x)=2(x−2)²+3; minimum 3.
explanation.en: f(x)=2(x−2)²+3; minimum 3.

stem.bm: Punca x²−5x+3=0 ialah α,β. Cari α²+β².
stem.en: The roots of x²−5x+3=0 are α,β. Find α²+β².

stem.bm: Diberi x+y+z=6, x−y=0 dan z=2. Cari (x,y,z).
stem.en: Given x+y+z=6, x−y=0 and z=2, find (x,y,z).

stem.bm: Selesaikan y=x+1 dan x²+y²=13.
stem.en: Solve y=x+1 and x²+y²=13.

explanation.bm: x²+(x+1)²=13 ⇒ x²+x−6=0 ⇒ x=2 atau −3. y=3 atau −2.

stem.bm: Berapa titik persilangan bagi y=x+2 dan y=x²?
stem.en: How many intersections do y=x+2 and y=x² have?

explanation.bm: x²−x−2=(x−2)(x+1)=0 mempunyai dua punca berbeza.
explanation.en: x²−x−2=(x−2)(x+1)=0 has two distinct roots.

stem.bm: Selesaikan 3^(2x−1)=27.
Ringkaskan √50−√8.
stem.en: Simplify √50−√8.

explanation.en: √50=5√2 and √8=2√2; difference 3√2.

stem.bm: Selesaikan log₂(x−1)+log₂(x+1)=3, dalam nombor nyata.
stem.en: Solve log₂(x−1)+log₂(x+1)=3 over the reals.

explanation.bm: log₂(x²−1)=3 ⇒ x²−1=8. Domain x>1 menolak −3, maka x=3.
explanation.en: log₂(x²−1)=3 ⇒ x²−1=8. Domain x>1 excludes −3, so x=3.

stem.bm: Janjang aritmetik bermula 7,11,15,… Cari sebutan ke-12.
stem.en: An arithmetic progression starts 7,11,15,… Find its 12th term.

stem.bm: Cari hasil tambah lima sebutan pertama janjang geometri 3,6,12,…
stem.en: Find the sum of the first five terms of the geometric progression 3,6,12,…

stem.bm: Janjang geometri tak terhingga mempunyai sebutan pertama 8 dan nisbah −1/2. Cari hasil tambah.
stem.en: An infinite geometric progression has first term 8 and ratio −1/2. Find its sum.

stem.bm: y=ax²+b. Jika Y=y dan X=x², apakah kecerunan graf Y terhadap X?
stem.en: y=ax²+b. With Y=y and X=x², what is the gradient of Y against X?

explanation.bm: Hubungan menjadi Y=aX+b; kecerunan ialah a.
explanation.en: The relationship becomes Y=aX+b; the gradient is a.

stem.bm: y=ab^x, a,b>0. Graf log₁₀ y terhadap x mempunyai pintasan 0.3 dan kecerunan 0.2. Cari b.
stem.en: y=ab^x, a,b>0. The graph of log₁₀ y against x has intercept 0.3 and gradient 0.2. Find b.

explanation.bm: log₁₀y=log₁₀a+x log₁₀b. Kecerunan log₁₀b=0.2 ⇒ b=10^0.2.
explanation.en: log₁₀y=log₁₀a+x log₁₀b. Gradient log₁₀b=0.2 ⇒ b=10^0.2.

stem.bm: Graf 1/y terhadap x melalui (1,3) dan (3,7). Apakah hubungan asal?
stem.en: The graph of 1/y against x passes through (1,3) and (3,7). What is the original relationship?

explanation.bm: Kecerunan 2, pintasan 1, jadi 1/y=2x+1 ⇒ y=1/(2x+1).
explanation.en: Gradient 2, intercept 1, so 1/y=2x+1 ⇒ y=1/(2x+1).

stem.bm: P membahagi AB secara dalaman dengan AP:PB=2:1. A=(1,2), B=(7,8). Cari P.
stem.en: P divides AB internally with AP:PB=2:1. A=(1,2), B=(7,8). Find P.

stem.bm: Cari kecerunan garis serenjang dengan 2y=3x−4.
stem.en: Find the gradient of a line perpendicular to 2y=3x−4.

explanation.bm: Kecerunan asal 3/2; hasil darab kecerunan serenjang ialah −1, jadi −2/3.
explanation.en: Original gradient 3/2; perpendicular gradients multiply to −1, giving −2/3.

stem.bm: Cari luas segi tiga dengan bucu (0,0),(4,0),(1,3).
stem.en: Find the area of the triangle with vertices (0,0),(4,0),(1,3).

explanation.bm: Tapak 4 dan tinggi serenjang 3; luas=½×4×3=6.
explanation.en: Base 4, perpendicular height 3; area=½×4×3=6.

stem.bm: a=(3,4). Cari vektor unit searah dengan a.
stem.en: a=(3,4). Find the unit vector in the direction of a.

explanation.bm: |a|=√(9+16)=5. Bahagi komponen dengan 5.
explanation.en: |a|=√(9+16)=5. Divide the components by 5.

stem.bm: Vektor (2,k) selari dengan (6,9). Cari k.
stem.en: Vector (2,k) is parallel to (6,9). Find k.

explanation.bm: Faktor daripada 6 ke 2 ialah 1/3, jadi k=9/3=3.
explanation.en: The factor from 6 to 2 is 1/3, hence k=9/3=3.

stem.bm: OA=a, OB=b dan AP:PB=1:2 pada segmen AB. Ungkapkan OP.
stem.en: OA=a, OB=b and AP:PB=1:2 on segment AB. Express OP.

stem.bm: Dua sisi segi tiga ialah 5 cm dan 7 cm, dengan sudut kandung 60°. Cari sisi bertentangan sudut itu.
stem.en: Two triangle sides are 5 cm and 7 cm with included angle 60°. Find the opposite side.

stem.bm: Dua sisi bersebelahan sudut 30° ialah 8 cm dan 10 cm. Cari luas segi tiga.
stem.en: The two sides adjacent to an angle of 30° are 8 cm and 10 cm. Find the triangle area.

explanation.bm: Luas=½(8)(10)sin30°=20 cm².
explanation.en: Area=½(8)(10)sin30°=20 cm².

stem.bm: Dalam segi tiga, A=30°, a=5 cm dan b=8 cm; sisi a,b bertentangan A,B. Berapa segi tiga berbeza mungkin terbentuk?
stem.en: In a triangle, A=30°, a=5 cm and b=8 cm; a,b are opposite A,B. How many distinct triangles are possible?

explanation.bm: sin B=8sin30°/5=0.8. B≈53.13° atau126.87°; kedua-duanya bersama A memberi jumlah<180°, maka dua.
explanation.en: sin B=8sin30°/5=0.8. B≈53.13° or126.87°; both give A+B<180°, so two triangles.

stem.bm: Harga barang meningkat daripada RM40 dalam tahun asas kepada RM46. Cari indeks harga tahun semasa berasaskan tahun asas.
stem.en: An item’s price rises from RM40 in the base year to RM46. Find the current-year price index based on that year.

stem.bm: Indeks harga A=110 dan B=125 dengan pemberat 3 dan 2. Cari indeks gubahan.
stem.en: Price indices A=110 and B=125 have weights 3 and 2. Find the composite index.

stem.bm: Indeks 2025 berasaskan 2020 ialah 120; indeks 2026 berasaskan 2025 ialah 110. Cari indeks 2026 berasaskan 2020.
stem.en: The 2025 index based on 2020 is 120; the 2026 index based on 2025 is 110. Find the 2026 index based on 2020.

explanation.bm: Faktor 1.20×1.10=1.32; indeks 132. Perubahan tahun tidak dijumlahkan.
explanation.en: Factor 1.20×1.10=1.32; index 132. Changes across years multiply, not add.

prompt.bm: f(x)=3x+2, g(x)=x−4. Tentukan f∘g dan g∘f, tunjukkan bahawa kedua-duanya berbeza, kemudian cari f⁻¹ dan semak f⁻¹(f(5)).
prompt.en: f(x)=3x+2, g(x)=x−4. Find f∘g and g∘f, show they differ, then find f⁻¹ and check f⁻¹(f(5)).

prompt.bm: Luas taman ialah A(x)=−2x²+12x+8 m², 0≤x≤6. Lengkapkan kuasa dua, cari luas maksimum dan nilai x. Selesaikan A(x)≥24 dalam domain tersebut.
prompt.en: Garden area is A(x)=−2x²+12x+8 m², 0≤x≤6. Complete the square, find maximum area and x, and solve A(x)≥24 in the domain.

prompt.bm: Cari semua titik persilangan y=2x+1 dan y=x²−2. Tunjukkan penggantian, cari dua pasangan koordinat dan semak dalam kedua-dua persamaan.
prompt.en: Find every intersection of y=2x+1 and y=x²−2. Show substitution, obtain two coordinate pairs and check both equations.

modelAnswer.bm: x²−2=2x+1 ⇒ x²−2x−3=0 ⇒ (x−3)(x+1)=0. Titik (3,7),(−1,−1). Kedua-dua pasangan memenuhi kedua-dua persamaan.
modelAnswer.en: x²−2=2x+1 ⇒ x²−2x−3=0 ⇒ (x−3)(x+1)=0. Points (3,7),(−1,−1). Both pairs satisfy both equations.

prompt.bm: Selesaikan log₃(x−2)+log₃(x+2)=2. Nyatakan domain sebelum mengira dan jelaskan mengapa satu punca algebra tidak sah. Kemudian ringkaskan 6/(√5+1) tanpa surd pada penyebut.
prompt.en: Solve log₃(x−2)+log₃(x+2)=2. State the domain first and explain why one algebraic root is invalid. Then simplify 6/(√5+1) with a rational denominator.

modelAnswer.bm: Domain x>2. log₃(x²−4)=2 ⇒ x²=13 ⇒ x=√13 sahaja; −√13 melanggar domain. 6/(√5+1)=6(√5−1)/4=3(√5−1)/2.
modelAnswer.en: Domain x>2. log₃(x²−4)=2 ⇒ x²=13 ⇒ x=√13 only; −√13 violates the domain. 6/(√5+1)=6(√5−1)/4=3(√5−1)/2.

prompt.bm: Seorang murid menyimpan RM20 pada minggu pertama dan menambah RM5 pada jumlah simpanan mingguan setiap minggu berikutnya. Cari jumlah minggu ke-10, jumlah terkumpul 10 minggu dan minggu pertama jumlah terkumpul mencapai sekurang-kurangnya RM500.
prompt.en: A student saves RM20 in week 1 and increases the weekly saving by RM5 each following week. Find the week-10 saving, accumulated savings after 10 weeks and the first week accumulated savings reach at least RM500.

prompt.bm: Model y=ax²+b dianggapkan sesuai. Data: (x,y)=(1,5),(2,11),(3,21). Bentuk pemboleh ubah garis lurus, cari a,b menggunakan dua titik, semak titik ketiga dan ramalkan y apabila x=4. Nyatakan satu had ramalan.
prompt.en: Assume y=ax²+b is suitable. Data: (x,y)=(1,5),(2,11),(3,21). Choose straight-line variables, find a,b using two points, check the third point and predict y at x=4. State one prediction limitation.

modelAnswer.bm: X=x²,Y=y. Kecerunan a=(11−5)/(4−1)=2; b=3. Semakan 2(9)+3=21. Pada x=4,y=35. Ramalan di luar julat data mengandaikan hukum sama terus terpakai.
modelAnswer.en: X=x²,Y=y. Gradient a=(11−5)/(4−1)=2; b=3. Check 2(9)+3=21. At x=4,y=35. Extrapolation assumes the same relationship continues beyond the observed range.

prompt.bm: A=(2,1),B=(6,5). Cari titik tengah AB, kecerunan AB dan persamaan pembahagi dua serenjang AB. Kemudian tentukan titik pada paksi-x yang sama jarak dari A dan B, dan semak jaraknya.
prompt.en: A=(2,1),B=(6,5). Find the midpoint, gradient of AB and its perpendicular bisector. Then find the point on the x-axis equidistant from A and B, and check distances.

modelAnswer.bm: Titik tengah (4,3), m_AB=1; pembahagi dua y−3=−(x−4) ⇒ y=−x+7. Pada paksi-x, P=(7,0). PA²=(7−2)²+(0−1)²=26; PB²=(7−6)²+(0−5)²=26.

prompt.bm: OA=a, OB=b. M titik tengah AB dan P berada pada OM dengan OP:PM=2:1. Ungkapkan OM, OP dan AP dalam sebutan a,b. Jika a=(3,0), b=(0,6), cari koordinat P dan magnitud AP.
prompt.en: OA=a, OB=b. M is midpoint of AB and P lies on OM with OP:PM=2:1. Express OM, OP and AP in a,b. If a=(3,0), b=(0,6), find P and |AP|.

prompt.bm: Dalam segi tiga ABC, AB=9 m, AC=12 m dan ∠BAC=60°. Cari BC, luas dan ∠ABC. Beri sudut kepada satu tempat perpuluhan dan tunjukkan petua yang digunakan.
prompt.en: In triangle ABC, AB=9 m, AC=12 m and ∠BAC=60°. Find BC, area and ∠ABC. Give the angle to one decimal place and show the rules used.

prompt.bm: Bahan A,B,C mempunyai indeks harga 110,120,150 dan pemberat kos tahun asas 5,3,2. Cari indeks gubahan. Kos resipi pada tahun asas RM80; ramalkan kos semasa. Nyatakan andaian apabila pemberat ini digunakan dan mengapa indeks gubahan bukan purata mudah.
prompt.en: Ingredients A,B,C have price indices 110,120,150 and base-year cost weights 5,3,2. Find the composite index. Base-year recipe cost RM80; predict current cost. State an assumption in using these weights and explain why this is not a simple average.

modelAnswer.bm: Indeks=(550+360+300)/10=121. Kos=80×1.21=RM96.80. Campuran bahan/pemberat kekal; purata berwajaran mengambil kira penggunaan berbeza, bukan setiap bahan sama penting.
modelAnswer.en: Index=(550+360+300)/10=121. Cost=80×1.21=RM96.80. Assume the ingredient mix/weights stay fixed; weighted averaging accounts for unequal usage instead of treating ingredients equally.

stem.bm: Tukarkan 135° kepada radian.
stem.en: Convert 135° to radians.

stem.bm: Jejari bulatan 5 cm; sudut pusat sektor 1.2 rad. Cari luas sektor.
stem.en: A circle has radius 5 cm; a sector’s central angle is 1.2 rad. Find sector area.

explanation.bm: Luas sektor=½r²θ=½×25×1.2=15 cm².
explanation.en: Sector area=½r²θ=½×25×1.2=15 cm².

stem.bm: Bulatan jejari 4 cm mempunyai tembereng kecil dengan sudut pusat π/3. Cari luas tembereng itu.
stem.en: A circle of radius 4 cm has a minor segment with central angle π/3. Find segment area.

explanation.bm: Luas tembereng=sektor−segi tiga=½(16)(π/3)−½(16)sin(π/3)=8π/3−4√3.
explanation.en: Segment area=sector−triangle=½(16)(π/3)−½(16)sin(π/3)=8π/3−4√3.

stem.bm: y=x³−4x. Cari dy/dx pada x=2.
stem.en: y=x³−4x. Find dy/dx at x=2.

explanation.bm: dy/dx=3x²−4; pada x=2 nilainya 12−4=8.
explanation.en: dy/dx=3x²−4; at x=2 it is 12−4=8.

stem.bm: Cari persamaan tangen kepada y=x² pada x=3.
stem.en: Find the tangent to y=x² at x=3.

explanation.bm: Titik (3,9), kecerunan 2x=6; y−9=6(x−3), maka y=6x−9.
explanation.en: Point (3,9), gradient 2x=6; y−9=6(x−3), giving y=6x−9.

stem.bm: f(x)=x³−3x². Bagaimanakah titik pegun pada x=0 dikelaskan?
stem.en: f(x)=x³−3x². How is the stationary point at x=0 classified?

explanation.bm: f′=3x²−6x, f′(0)=0; f″=6x−6, f″(0)=−6<0, maka maksimum tempatan.
explanation.en: f′=3x²−6x, f′(0)=0; f″=6x−6, f″(0)=−6<0, so a local maximum.

stem.bm: Cari ∫(6x²−4x) dx.
stem.en: Find ∫(6x²−4x) dx.

explanation.bm: Kamirkan setiap sebutan: 6x³/3−4x²/2+C.
explanation.en: Integrate term by term: 6x³/3−4x²/2+C.

stem.bm: Hitung ∫₀²(3x²+1) dx.
stem.en: Evaluate ∫₀²(3x²+1) dx.

stem.bm: Cari luas di antara y=x dan y=x² untuk 0≤x≤1.
stem.en: Find the area between y=x and y=x² for 0≤x≤1.

explanation.bm: x≥x² pada selang ini; ∫₀¹(x−x²)dx=1/2−1/3=1/6.
explanation.en: x≥x² on the interval; ∫₀¹(x−x²)dx=1/2−1/3=1/6.

stem.bm: Lima buku berlainan disusun sebaris. Dua buku tertentu mesti bersebelahan. Berapa susunan?
stem.en: Five distinct books are arranged in a row. Two specified books must be adjacent. How many arrangements are possible?

explanation.bm: Anggap pasangan sebagai blok: 4! susunan blok dan 2! susunan dalam pasangan; 24×2=48.
explanation.en: Treat the pair as a block: 4! block arrangements and 2! internal orders; 24×2=48.

stem.bm: Jawatankuasa 3 orang dipilih daripada 4 lelaki dan 3 perempuan. Berapa pilihan dengan tepat 2 perempuan?
stem.en: A committee of 3 is chosen from 4 men and 3 women. How many choices have exactly 2 women?

explanation.bm: Pilih 2 daripada 3 perempuan dan 1 daripada 4 lelaki: C(3,2)C(4,1)=12.
explanation.en: Choose 2 of 3 women and 1 of 4 men: C(3,2)C(4,1)=12.

stem.bm: Kod empat digit tanpa ulangan dibentuk daripada 0,1,2,3,4. Digit pertama tidak boleh 0. Berapa kod?
stem.en: Four-digit codes with no repetition use 0,1,2,3,4. The first digit cannot be 0. How many codes are possible?

explanation.bm: Digit pertama ada 4 pilihan; seterusnya 4,3,2 pilihan. Jumlah 4×4×3×2=96.
explanation.en: First digit has 4 choices; then 4,3,2 choices. Total 4×4×3×2=96.

stem.bm: X~Bin(5,0.2). Cari P(X=2).
stem.en: X~Bin(5,0.2). Find P(X=2).

stem.bm: X~Bin(20,0.3). Apakah min dan varians X?
stem.en: X~Bin(20,0.3). What are the mean and variance of X?

explanation.en: Mean=np=6; variance=np(1−p)=20×0.3×0.7=4.2.

stem.bm: X~N(50,8²). Diberi P(Z<1.5)=0.9332 bagi normal piawai. Cari P(X>62).
stem.en: X~N(50,8²). Given P(Z<1.5)=0.9332 for the standard normal, find P(X>62).

explanation.bm: z=(62−50)/8=1.5; kebarangkalian hujung atas=1−0.9332=0.0668.

stem.bm: sin θ=3/5 dan θ berada dalam kuadran II. Cari sin 2θ.
stem.en: sin θ=3/5 and θ lies in quadrant II. Find sin 2θ.

explanation.bm: cos θ=−4/5. sin2θ=2sinθ cosθ=−24/25.
explanation.en: cos θ=−4/5. sin2θ=2sinθ cosθ=−24/25.

stem.bm: Ungkapkan (1−cos2x)/sin2x dalam bentuk paling ringkas, apabila ungkapan ditakrifkan.
stem.en: Simplify (1−cos2x)/sin2x wherever the expression is defined.

explanation.bm: 1−cos2x=2sin²x dan sin2x=2sinx cosx; nisbah=tanx pada domain asal.
explanation.en: 1−cos2x=2sin²x and sin2x=2sinx cosx; the ratio is tanx on the original domain.

stem.bm: Selesaikan 2cos²x−1=0 bagi 0°≤x<360°.
stem.en: Solve 2cos²x−1=0 for 0°≤x<360°.

explanation.bm: cos²x=1/2 ⇒ cosx=±1/√2, memberi empat kuadran.
explanation.en: cos²x=1/2 ⇒ cosx=±1/√2, giving solutions in four quadrants.

stem.bm: x,y≥0, x+y≤6, x≤4. Cari nilai maksimum P=3x+2y.
stem.en: x,y≥0, x+y≤6, x≤4. Find the maximum P=3x+2y.

stem.bm: x,y≥0, x+y≤5. Untuk memaksimumkan P=2x+2y, pernyataan manakah benar?
stem.en: x,y≥0, x+y≤5. To maximise P=2x+2y, which statement is true?

options.bm: Semua titik pada x+y=5 dengan x,y≥0 adalah optimum
options.en: Every point on x+y=5 with x,y≥0 is optimal

explanation.bm: P=2(x+y)≤10; setiap titik pada sisi x+y=5 mencapai 10.
explanation.en: P=2(x+y)≤10; every point on the edge x+y=5 attains 10.

stem.bm: Kerusi x menggunakan 2 unit kayu, meja y menggunakan 5 unit. Stok paling banyak 40 unit. Kekangan manakah betul?
stem.en: Chair x uses 2 units of wood and table y uses 5. At most 40 units are available. Which constraint is correct?

explanation.bm: Jumlah penggunaan=2x+5y dan tidak boleh melebihi 40.
explanation.en: Total use=2x+5y and cannot exceed 40.

stem.bm: Sesaran s=t³−6t²+9t meter. Cari halaju apabila t=2 s.
stem.en: Displacement s=t³−6t²+9t metres. Find velocity at t=2 s.

stem.bm: Halaju v=2t−6 m/s bagi 0≤t≤5. Cari jumlah jarak dilalui.
stem.en: Velocity v=2t−6 m/s for 0≤t≤5. Find total distance travelled.

explanation.bm: Halaju bertukar tanda pada t=3. ∫₀³(6−2t)dt=9 dan ∫₃⁵(2t−6)dt=4; jumlah 13 m.
explanation.en: Velocity changes sign at t=3. ∫₀³(6−2t)dt=9 and ∫₃⁵(2t−6)dt=4; total 13 m.

stem.bm: Pecutan a=6t m/s² dan halaju awal 2 m/s. Cari halaju pada t=3 s.
stem.en: Acceleration a=6t m/s² and initial velocity is 2 m/s. Find velocity at t=3 s.

explanation.bm: v=∫6t dt=3t²+C; C=2, maka v(3)=29.

prompt.bm: Sektor bulatan berjari-jari 6 cm mempunyai sudut pusat 2 rad. Cari panjang lengkok, perimeter sektor dan luas tembereng kecil. Tunjukkan beza antara luas sektor dan segi tiga, dan beri luas akhir kepada 3 angka bererti.
prompt.en: A circle sector of radius 6 cm has central angle 2 rad. Find arc length, sector perimeter and minor segment area. Show sector area minus triangle area, giving the final area to 3 significant figures.

modelAnswer.bm: Lengkok=6×2=12 cm. Perimeter=12+12=24 cm. Luas sektor=36 cm², segi tiga=18 sin2; tembereng=36−18 sin2≈19.6 cm² (mod radian).
modelAnswer.en: Arc=6×2=12 cm. Perimeter=12+12=24 cm. Sector area=36 cm², triangle=18 sin2; segment=36−18 sin2≈19.6 cm² (radian mode).

point.bm: Tolak luas segi tiga yang betul

prompt.bm: Pagar 40 m digunakan untuk tiga sisi taman segi empat tepat di tepi tembok. Dua sisi serenjang tembok panjang x dan sisi ketiga panjang y. Bentuk luas dalam x, guna pembezaan untuk mencari luas maksimum dan dimensi, kemudian sahkan jenis optimum.
prompt.en: 40 m of fencing encloses three sides of a rectangle against a wall. The two perpendicular sides have length x and the third length y. Express area in x, differentiate to find maximum area and dimensions, then verify the optimum type.

modelAnswer.en: 2x+y=40, A=x(40−2x)=40x−2x². A′=40−4x=0 ⇒ x=10,y=20. A″=−4<0, giving maximum A=200 m². Domain 0<x<20.

prompt.bm: Rantau dibatasi oleh y=4−x², paksi-x, x=0 dan x=2. (a) Cari luas tepat. (b) Rantau diputarkan 360° sekitar paksi-x; cari isi padu tepat. Nyatakan kamiran yang digunakan.
prompt.en: A region is bounded by y=4−x², the x-axis, x=0 and x=2. (a) Find exact area. (b) Revolve the region 360° about the x-axis; find exact volume. State each integral.

modelAnswer.bm: Luas=∫₀²(4−x²)dx=[4x−x³/3]₀²=16/3 unit². Isi padu=π∫₀²(4−x²)²dx=π[16x−8x³/3+x⁵/5]₀²=256π/15 unit³.
modelAnswer.en: Area=∫₀²(4−x²)dx=[4x−x³/3]₀²=16/3 unit². Volume=π∫₀²(4−x²)²dx=π[16x−8x³/3+x⁵/5]₀²=256π/15 unit³.

point.bm: Kamiran isi padu dengan kuasa dua

prompt.bm: Daripada 5 calon lelaki dan 4 perempuan, pilih 3 orang dengan sekurang-kurangnya satu perempuan. (a) Cari bilangan jawatankuasa. (b) Jika tiga orang dipilih diberi jawatan pengerusi, setiausaha dan bendahari yang berbeza, cari bilangan penugasan. Terangkan faktor tambahan.
prompt.en: From 5 male and 4 female candidates, choose 3 with at least one woman. (a) Find the number of committees. (b) If those selected receive distinct chair, secretary and treasurer roles, find the number of assignments. Explain the extra factor.

modelAnswer.bm: Jawatankuasa=C(9,3)−C(5,3)=84−10=74. Penugasan=74×3!=444. Setiap kumpulan tiga orang boleh diberi tiga jawatan dalam 6 susunan.
modelAnswer.en: Committees=C(9,3)−C(5,3)=84−10=74. Assignments=74×3!=444. Each three-person group has 6 arrangements among three distinct roles.

prompt.bm: Empat komponen diuji secara bebas, masing-masing mempunyai kebarangkalian rosak 0.25. Takrifkan X sebagai bilangan rosak. Nyatakan taburan, cari P(X=1), P(X≥1), min dan varians. Nyatakan mengapa syarat bebas penting.
prompt.en: Four components are tested independently, each with defect probability 0.25. Let X count defects. State the distribution, find P(X=1), P(X≥1), mean and variance. Explain why independence matters.

modelAnswer.bm: X~Bin(4,0.25). P(X=1)=4(0.25)(0.75)³=27/64. P(X≥1)=1−(0.75)⁴=175/256. Min=1, varians=0.75. Bebas membolehkan kebarangkalian hasil ujian didarab tanpa berubah akibat ujian lain.
modelAnswer.en: X~Bin(4,0.25). P(X=1)=4(0.25)(0.75)³=27/64. P(X≥1)=1−(0.75)⁴=175/256. Mean=1, variance=0.75. Independence allows trial probabilities to multiply without changing because of other trials.

prompt.bm: Selesaikan 2sin²x−sinx−1=0 bagi 0°≤x<360°. Tunjukkan pemfaktoran sebagai kuadratik dalam sinx, cari semua sudut dan semak satu sudut daripada setiap nilai sinus.
prompt.en: Solve 2sin²x−sinx−1=0 for 0°≤x<360°. Factor as a quadratic in sinx, find all angles and check one angle for each sine value.

prompt.bm: Produk x,y ialah integer bukan negatif. Syarat x+y≤8 dan 2x+y≤12; keuntungan RM30 bagi x dan RM20 bagi y. Lakar rantau tersaur, senaraikan bucu, nilai keuntungan setiap bucu dan tentukan rancangan optimum.
prompt.en: Products x,y are non-negative integers. Constraints x+y≤8 and 2x+y≤12; profit RM30 per x and RM20 per y. Sketch the feasible region, list vertices, evaluate profit at each and choose the optimum plan.

modelAnswer.bm: Bucu (0,0),(6,0),(4,4),(0,8). Keuntungan 0,180,200,160. Pilihan optimum x=4,y=4 dengan RM200; koordinat optimum ialah integer.
modelAnswer.en: Vertices (0,0),(6,0),(4,4),(0,8). Profits 0,180,200,160. Optimum x=4,y=4 with RM200; the optimal coordinates are integers.

prompt.bm: Zarah bermula di O dengan v=t²−4t+3 m/s bagi 0≤t≤4. Cari masa berhenti, fungsi sesaran s(t), sesaran pada t=4 dan jumlah jarak dalam 4 s. Tunjukkan pembahagian selang berdasarkan tanda halaju.
prompt.en: A particle starts at O with v=t²−4t+3 m/s for 0≤t≤4. Find stop times, displacement s(t), displacement at t=4 and total distance over 4 s. Split intervals using velocity signs.

stem.bm: Pemilik membayar bil elektrik rumah peribadi RM 180 menggunakan bank perniagaan. Bagaimanakah perniagaan merekodkannya?
stem.en: The owner pays a RM 180 home electricity bill using the business bank account. How should the business record it?

explanation.bm: Andaian entiti berasingan membezakan belanja peribadi daripada belanja perniagaan; bayaran ialah ambilan.
explanation.en: The separate-entity assumption distinguishes personal from business expenses; the payment is drawings.

stem.bm: Mesin dibeli RM 12000. Nilai pasaran kemudian RM 15000. Dengan prinsip kos sejarah dan tanpa penilaian semula, berapakah kos yang direkod sebelum susut nilai?
stem.en: A machine costs RM 12000. Its market value later becomes RM 15000. Under historical cost without revaluation, what cost is recorded before depreciation?

explanation.bm: Kos sejarah menggunakan harga transaksi RM 12000, bukan kenaikan pasaran.
explanation.en: Historical cost uses transaction cost RM 12000, not the market increase.

stem.bm: Perkhidmatan ditempah pada November, siap Disember berjumlah RM 900 dan dibayar Januari. Akaun tamat 31 Disember dan asas akruan digunakan. Bilakah hasil diiktiraf?
stem.en: A service is booked in November, completed in December for RM 900 and paid in January. Accounts end 31 December using accrual accounting. When is revenue recognised?

options.en: December when the service is delivered

options.bm: Separuh pada setiap bulan Disember dan Januari
options.en: Half in each of December and January
November when the booking is received

explanation.bm: Asas akruan mengiktiraf hasil apabila diperoleh, walaupun penerimaan tunai kemudian.
explanation.en: Accrual accounting recognises earned revenue even when cash arrives later.

stem.bm: Aset RM 42000 dan liabiliti RM 17000. Cari ekuiti pemilik.
stem.en: Assets are RM 42000 and liabilities RM 17000. Find owner’s equity.

explanation.bm: Aset=Liabiliti+Ekuiti; ekuiti=42000−17000=25000.
explanation.en: Assets=Liabilities+Equity; equity=42000−17000=25000.

stem.bm: Peralatan RM 5000 dibeli secara kredit. Apakah kesan awal, tanpa belanja atau susut nilai?
stem.en: Equipment of RM 5000 is bought on credit. What is the initial effect, excluding expenses or depreciation?

explanation.bm: Peralatan ialah aset; hutang kepada pembekal ialah liabiliti. Kedua-duanya naik RM 5000.
explanation.en: Equipment is an asset; amount owing to the supplier is a liability. Both rise RM 5000.

stem.bm: Pemilik mengambil barang niaga kos RM 250 untuk kegunaan sendiri. Apakah kesan terhadap persamaan perakaunan?
stem.en: The owner takes trading goods costing RM 250 for personal use. What is the effect on the accounting equation?

options.bm: Liabiliti turun RM 250, ekuiti naik RM 250
options.en: Liabilities fall RM 250, equity rises RM 250

options.bm: Aset naik RM 250, liabiliti naik RM 250
options.en: Assets rise RM 250, liabilities rise RM 250

options.bm: Aset turun RM 250, untung turun RM 250
options.en: Assets fall RM 250, profit falls RM 250

options.bm: Aset turun RM 250, ekuiti turun RM 250
options.en: Assets fall RM 250, equity falls RM 250

explanation.bm: Ambilan inventori mengurangkan aset dan ekuiti pemilik; ia bukan belanja operasi.
explanation.en: Inventory drawings reduce assets and owner’s equity; they are not operating expense.

stem.bm: Invois barang RM 2000 diberi diskaun niaga 10%. Berapakah jumlah invois selepas diskaun niaga?
stem.en: An invoice for goods RM 2000 allows 10% trade discount. What is the invoice amount after trade discount?

explanation.bm: Diskaun niaga 200; invois bersih 2000−200=1800.
explanation.en: Trade discount 200; net invoice 2000−200=1800.

stem.bm: Pembeli memulangkan barang rosak dan menerima nota kredit RM 150 daripada pembekal. Apakah kesan pada hutang pembeli kepada pembekal?
stem.en: A buyer returns defective goods and receives a RM 150 credit note from the supplier. What happens to the buyer’s debt to the supplier?

explanation.bm: Nota kredit mengurangkan jumlah invois yang perlu dibayar kepada pembekal.
explanation.en: The credit note reduces the invoiced amount payable to the supplier.

stem.bm: Invois bersih RM 1600 mempunyai syarat diskaun tunai 2% jika dibayar dalam 10 hari. Bayaran dibuat pada hari ke-8. Cari bayaran.
stem.en: A net invoice RM 1600 allows 2% cash discount if paid within 10 days. Payment is on day 8. Find the payment.

explanation.bm: Diskaun tunai 1600×2%=32; bayaran 1568 kerana syarat masa dipenuhi.
explanation.en: Cash discount 1600×2%=32; pay 1568 because the timing condition is met.

stem.bm: Perniagaan membeli barang niaga secara kredit RM 800. Buku catatan pertama yang sesuai ialah?
stem.en: A business buys trading goods on credit for RM 800. Which book of prime entry is appropriate?

explanation.bm: Jurnal Belian merekod belian barang niaga secara kredit, bukan belian tunai atau aset bukan semasa.
explanation.en: Purchases Journal records credit purchases of trading goods, not cash purchases or non-current assets.

stem.bm: Tunai RM 600 dimasukkan ke akaun bank perniagaan. Apakah catatan kontra dalam Buku Tunai?
stem.en: RM 600 cash is deposited into the business bank. What is the contra entry in the Cash Book?

explanation.bm: Wang berpindah daripada tunai kepada bank, tanpa hasil atau belanja baharu.
explanation.en: Money transfers from cash to bank, with no new income or expense.

stem.bm: Pelanggan memulangkan barang yang dibeli secara kredit RM 120. Buku mana merekod pulangan ini bagi penjual?
stem.en: A customer returns goods bought on credit for RM 120. Which book records the return for the seller?

explanation.bm: Bagi penjual, transaksi mengurangkan jualan kredit dan direkod dalam Jurnal Pulangan Jualan.
explanation.en: For the seller this reduces credit sales and goes in the Sales Returns Journal.

stem.bm: Pelanggan berhutang RM 1200, membeli lagi secara kredit RM 500 dan membayar RM 800. Cari baki debit akaun pelanggan.
stem.en: A customer owes RM 1200, buys another RM 500 on credit and pays RM 800. Find the debit balance.

explanation.en: Balance=1200+500−800=900 debit.

stem.bm: Sewa pejabat RM 700 dibayar melalui bank. Catatan bergu yang mana betul?
stem.en: Office rent RM 700 is paid by bank. Which double entry is correct?

options.bm: Dr Sewa, Cr Akaun Belum Bayar

explanation.bm: Belanja sewa naik pada debit dan aset bank turun pada kredit.
explanation.en: Rent expense increases by debit and bank asset decreases by credit.

stem.bm: Pembekal mempunyai baki kredit RM 2400. Belian kredit baharu RM 600, pulangan kepada pembekal RM 200 dan bayaran RM 1000. Cari baki akhir.
stem.en: A supplier has credit balance RM 2400. New credit purchases RM 600, returns RM 200 and payment RM 1000. Find the closing balance.

explanation.bm: 2400+600−200−1000=1800 kredit; perniagaan masih berhutang.
explanation.en: 2400+600−200−1000=1800 credit; the business still owes this amount.

stem.bm: Imbangan duga mempunyai jumlah debit RM 18500. Kredit lain RM 6500, dan hanya modal belum disenaraikan. Cari modal kredit.
stem.en: A trial balance has total debits RM 18500. Other credits total RM 6500; only capital is missing. Find credit capital.

explanation.bm: Modal melengkapkan kredit kepada debit:18500−6500=12000.
explanation.en: Capital completes credits to match debits:18500−6500=12000.

stem.bm: Belian kredit RM 450 tertinggal sepenuhnya daripada semua buku. Apakah kesan pada keseimbangan imbangan duga?
stem.en: A RM 450 credit purchase is omitted completely from all books. How does this affect trial-balance agreement?

explanation.bm: Kedua-dua debit belian dan kredit pembekal tertinggal, maka jumlah sama-sama kurang 450.
explanation.en: Both purchases debit and supplier credit are omitted, reducing both totals by 450.

stem.bm: Akaun Bank berbaki debit RM 750 tersalah dimasukkan pada bahagian kredit imbangan duga. Berapa perbezaan jumlah kredit melebihi debit?
stem.en: A RM 750 debit Bank balance is wrongly listed as a trial-balance credit. By how much do total credits exceed debits?

explanation.bm: Debit kurang 750 dan kredit lebih 750, menjadikan beza 1500.
explanation.en: Debits are 750 too low and credits 750 too high, so difference 1500.

stem.bm: Inventori awal RM 3000, belian bersih RM 18000, angkutan masuk RM 500 dan inventori akhir RM 4000. Cari kos jualan.
stem.en: Opening inventory RM 3000, net purchases RM 18000, carriage inwards RM 500 and closing inventory RM 4000. Find cost of sales.

stem.bm: Jualan bersih RM 30000, kos jualan RM 18000, belanja operasi RM 7000 dan komisen diterima RM 600. Cari untung bersih.
stem.en: Net sales RM 30000, cost of sales RM 18000, operating expenses RM 7000 and commission received RM 600. Find net profit.

explanation.bm: Untung kasar 12000; tambah komisen 600, tolak belanja 7000→5600.
explanation.en: Gross profit 12000; add commission 600, subtract expenses 7000→5600.

stem.bm: Modal awal RM 20000, untung bersih RM 4500 dan ambilan RM 1800, tanpa modal tambahan. Cari modal akhir.
stem.en: Opening capital RM 20000, net profit RM 4500 and drawings RM 1800, with no extra capital. Find closing capital.

stem.bm: Insurans RM 1200 dibayar pada 1 Oktober untuk 12 bulan. Akaun tamat 31 Disember. Cari belanja insurans tahun ini dan prabayar.
stem.en: Insurance RM 1200 is paid on 1 October for 12 months. Year-end 31 December. Find this year’s insurance expense and prepayment.

explanation.bm: Tiga bulan digunakan:1200×3/12=300; baki 9 bulan=900 prabayar.
explanation.en: Three months used:1200×3/12=300; remaining 9 months=900 prepaid.

stem.bm: Kenderaan kos RM 20000, susut nilai terkumpul awal RM 6000. Kadar baki berkurangan 20% bagi setahun penuh. Cari susut nilai tahun ini.
stem.en: Vehicle cost RM 20000, opening accumulated depreciation RM 6000. Reducing-balance rate 20% for a full year. Find this year’s depreciation.

explanation.en: Opening carrying amount 14000;20%×14000=2800.

stem.bm: Akaun belum terima RM 10000; peruntukan hutang ragu awal RM 300. Peruntukan baharu 5% diperlukan dan tiada hutang dihapus kira. Cari tambahan belanja peruntukan.
stem.en: Receivables RM 10000; opening doubtful-debt allowance RM 300. A new 5% allowance is required with no write-offs. Find the additional allowance expense.

explanation.bm: Peruntukan akhir 500; tambahan 500−300=200.
explanation.en: Closing allowance 500; increase 500−300=200.

stem.bm: Belian komputer pejabat RM 2400 tersalah didebit ke Belian, kredit Bank betul. Catatan pembetulan yang mana sesuai?
stem.en: An office computer purchase RM 2400 is wrongly debited to Purchases; Bank credit is correct. Which correcting entry is appropriate?

options.bm: Dr Peralatan, Cr Bank sekali lagi

explanation.bm: Pindah debit daripada Belian kepada Peralatan; catatan bank tidak perlu diulang.
explanation.en: Move the debit from Purchases to Equipment; do not repeat the correct bank entry.

stem.bm: Jualan kredit RM 320 direkod RM 230 pada kedua-dua akaun pelanggan dan jualan. Apakah pembetulan?
stem.en: Credit sales RM 320 are recorded as RM 230 in both customer and sales accounts. What is the correction?

explanation.bm: Kedua-dua catatan kurang 90; tambah debit pelanggan dan kredit jualan 90.
explanation.en: Both entries are 90 too low; add customer debit and sales credit 90.

stem.bm: Belanja sewa RM 600 direkod sebagai belanja gaji RM 600 dengan kredit bank betul. Apakah kesan pembetulan pada untung bersih?
stem.en: Rent expense RM 600 is recorded as wages expense RM 600 with bank correctly credited. What effect does correction have on net profit?

explanation.bm: Pindahan antara dua akaun belanja tidak mengubah jumlah belanja 600.
explanation.en: Reclassification between two expense accounts leaves total expense 600 unchanged.

prompt.bm: Tahun akaun tamat 31 Disember. Pemilik mengeluarkan RM 300 tunai untuk peribadi. Pada Disember perniagaan menyiapkan perkhidmatan RM 800 yang dibayar Januari. Jelaskan catatan dan kesan setiap transaksi terhadap untung serta aset/ekuiti pada 31 Disember.
prompt.en: Year-end is 31 December. The owner withdraws RM 300 cash personally. In December the business completes an RM 800 service paid in January. Explain entries and each effect on profit and assets/equity at year-end.

modelAnswer.bm: Dr Ambilan 300, Cr Tunai 300: tunai dan ekuiti turun 300, bukan belanja/untung. Dr Akaun Belum Terima 800, Cr Hasil Perkhidmatan 800: aset dan untung/ekuiti naik 800 pada Disember.
modelAnswer.en: Dr Drawings 300, Cr Cash 300: cash and equity fall 300; profit unchanged. Dr Receivables 800, Cr Service Revenue 800: assets and profit/equity increase 800 in December.

point.bm: Kesan aset dan ekuiti serta tempoh

prompt.bm: Baki awal: aset RM 30000, liabiliti RM 8000. Kemudian pemilik menambah tunai RM 4000, peralatan RM 6000 dibeli secara kredit dan hutang RM 2000 dibayar dari bank. Tunjukkan A=L+E selepas setiap transaksi.
prompt.en: Opening assets RM 30000 and liabilities RM 8000. The owner adds RM 4000 cash, equipment RM 6000 is bought on credit and RM 2000 debt is paid from bank. Show A=L+E after each transaction.

modelAnswer.bm: Ekuiti awal 22000. Selepas modal:34000=8000+26000. Selepas kredit peralatan:40000=14000+26000. Selepas bayaran:38000=12000+26000.
modelAnswer.en: Opening equity 22000. After capital:34000=8000+26000. After credit equipment:40000=14000+26000. After payment:38000=12000+26000.

prompt.bm: Invois asal RM 3000, diskaun niaga 10%. Barang bernilai invois bersih RM 200 dipulangkan dan nota kredit diterima. Baki dijelaskan dalam tempoh diskaun tunai 2%. Cari invois bersih, baki selepas pulangan, diskaun tunai dan bayaran akhir. Bezakan tujuan dua diskaun.
prompt.en: Original invoice RM 3000, trade discount 10%. Goods with net invoice value RM 200 are returned and a credit note received. The balance is paid within the 2% cash-discount period. Find net invoice, balance after return, cash discount and final payment. Distinguish both discounts.

modelAnswer.bm: Invois 2700; baki 2500; diskaun tunai 50; bayaran 2450. Diskaun niaga mengurangkan harga senarai, diskaun tunai menggalakkan pembayaran awal.
modelAnswer.en: Invoice 2700; balance 2500; cash discount 50; payment 2450. Trade discount reduces list price; cash discount encourages prompt payment.

prompt.bm: Klasifikasikan: (i) jualan kredit barang RM 900 kepada Ali, (ii) belian tunai barang RM 400, (iii) komputer pejabat RM 1800 dibeli secara kredit, (iv) Ali memulangkan barang kredit RM 100. Nyatakan buku catatan pertama dan jumlah bersih jurnal jualan/pulangan jualan bagi transaksi ini.
prompt.en: Classify: (i) credit sale of goods RM 900 to Ali, (ii) cash goods purchase RM 400, (iii) office computer RM 1800 bought on credit, (iv) Ali returns RM 100 credit goods. State each book of prime entry and the net sales less sales-returns totals for these transactions.

modelAnswer.bm: (i)Jurnal Jualan 900;(ii)Buku Tunai 400;(iii)Jurnal Am 1800 kerana aset bukan barang niaga;(iv)Jurnal Pulangan Jualan 100. Jualan kredit bersih 800.
modelAnswer.en: (i)Sales Journal 900;(ii)Cash Book 400;(iii)General Journal 1800 because a non-current asset is not trading goods;(iv)Sales Returns Journal 100. Net credit sales 800.

prompt.bm: Baki debit awal pelanggan Sara RM 600. Jualan kredit RM 900, pulangan jualan RM 100 dan Sara membayar RM 1200. Sediakan akaun Sara berbentuk T dengan baki h/b dan baki b/b, dan jelaskan makna baki akhir.
prompt.en: Sara’s opening debit balance is RM 600. Credit sale RM 900, sales return RM 100 and Sara pays RM 1200. Prepare Sara’s T account with balance carried down and brought down, explaining the closing balance.

modelAnswer.bm: Debit: baki b/b 600, jualan 900 (jumlah 1500). Kredit: pulangan 100, bank 1200, baki h/b 200 (jumlah 1500). Baki b/b baharu 200 debit; Sara masih berhutang 200.
modelAnswer.en: Debit: opening balance 600, sales 900 (total 1500). Credit: returns 100, bank 1200, balance c/d 200 (total 1500). New balance b/d 200 debit; Sara still owes 200.

prompt.bm: Baki: Bank debit 6000, Peralatan debit 10000, Belian debit 4000, Jualan kredit 7000, Akaun Belum Bayar kredit 3000, Modal tidak diketahui. Sediakan imbangan duga, cari modal dan terangkan dengan contoh mengapa imbangan seimbang tidak membuktikan semua transaksi betul.
prompt.en: Balances: Bank debit 6000, Equipment debit 10000, Purchases debit 4000, Sales credit 7000, Payables credit 3000, Capital unknown. Prepare a trial balance, find capital and explain with an example why agreement does not prove every transaction is correct.

modelAnswer.bm: Jumlah debit 20000; modal 10000; kredit 7000+3000+10000=20000. Contoh: transaksi ditinggalkan sepenuhnya atau belian aset didebit ke belian masih menghasilkan debit/kredit sama tetapi maklumat salah.
modelAnswer.en: Debits 20000; capital 10000; credits 7000+3000+10000=20000. Complete omission or an asset purchase debited to Purchases can leave equal totals despite incorrect information.

prompt.bm: Jualan 24000, pulangan jualan 1000, inventori awal 2000, belian 14000, pulangan belian 500, angkutan masuk 300, inventori akhir 2800, sewa 1800, gaji 2200. Tiada pelarasan. Sediakan pengiraan jualan bersih, kos jualan, untung kasar dan untung bersih.
prompt.en: Sales 24000, sales returns 1000, opening inventory 2000, purchases 14000, purchases returns 500, carriage inwards 300, closing inventory 2800, rent 1800, wages 2200. No adjustments. Calculate net sales, cost of sales, gross profit and net profit.

modelAnswer.bm: Jualan bersih 23000. Belian bersih 13500; kos jualan 2000+13500+300−2800=13000. Untung kasar 10000. Untung bersih 10000−1800−2200=6000.
modelAnswer.en: Net sales 23000. Net purchases 13500; cost of sales 2000+13500+300−2800=13000. Gross profit 10000. Net profit 10000−1800−2200=6000.

prompt.bm: Untung sebelum pelarasan RM 9000. Sewa dibayar RM 2400 termasuk prabayar RM 400; gaji terakru belum direkod RM 600; susut nilai tahun ini RM 1000 belum direkod. Kira untung terselaras, nyatakan aset/liabiliti bagi sewa dan gaji, dan beri catatan pelarasan.
prompt.en: Profit before adjustments RM 9000. Rent paid RM 2400 includes RM 400 prepaid; unrecorded accrued wages RM 600; unrecorded current-year depreciation RM 1000. Find adjusted profit, identify rent/wage assets or liabilities and give adjusting entries.

modelAnswer.bm: Untung=9000+400−600−1000=7800. Dr Sewa Prabayar 400 Cr Sewa 400; Dr Gaji 600 Cr Gaji Terakru 600; Dr Susut Nilai 1000 Cr Susut Nilai Terkumpul 1000. Sewa prabayar aset semasa, gaji terakru liabiliti semasa.
modelAnswer.en: Profit=9000+400−600−1000=7800. Dr Prepaid Rent 400 Cr Rent 400; Dr Wages 600 Cr Accrued Wages 600; Dr Depreciation 1000 Cr Accumulated Depreciation 1000. Prepaid rent is a current asset; accrued wages a current liability.

prompt.bm: Untung sebelum pembetulan RM 5000. Belian peralatan tunai RM 1000 tersalah masuk Belian; bank betul. Jualan kredit RM 800 direkod RM 500 pada kedua-dua akaun. Abaikan susut nilai. Sediakan dua jurnal pembetulan dan hitung untung betul; jelaskan sama ada kesilapan ini menyebabkan imbangan duga tidak seimbang.
prompt.en: Profit before correction RM 5000. Cash equipment purchase RM 1000 is wrongly in Purchases; bank correct. Credit sale RM 800 is recorded as RM 500 in both accounts. Ignore depreciation. Prepare two correcting journals and correct profit; explain whether these errors cause trial-balance disagreement.

modelAnswer.bm: Dr Peralatan 1000 Cr Belian 1000; Dr Akaun Belum Terima 300 Cr Jualan 300. Untung betul 5000+1000+300=6300. Kedua-dua kesilapan mengekalkan jumlah debit dan kredit sama, jadi imbangan masih seimbang.
modelAnswer.en: Dr Equipment 1000 Cr Purchases 1000; Dr Receivables 300 Cr Sales 300. Correct profit 5000+1000+300=6300. Both errors retain equal debit/credit totals, so the trial balance still agrees.
