stem.bm: Aset semasa RM 24000, inventori RM 6000 dan liabiliti semasa RM 12000. Cari nisbah ujian asid.
stem.en: Current assets RM 24000, inventory RM 6000 and current liabilities RM 12000. Find the acid-test ratio.

explanation.bm: (Aset semasa−inventori)/liabiliti semasa=(24000−6000)/12000=1.5:1.
explanation.en: (Current assets−inventory)/current liabilities=(24000−6000)/12000=1.5:1.

stem.bm: Jualan bersih RM 50000 dan untung kasar RM 15000. Cari margin untung kasar.
stem.en: Net sales RM 50000 and gross profit RM 15000. Find gross-profit margin.

explanation.bm: Margin=untung kasar/jualan bersih×100=30%; tokokan menggunakan kos jualan, bukan jualan.
explanation.en: Margin=gross profit/net sales×100=30%; markup instead uses cost of sales.

stem.bm: Kos jualan RM 48000. Inventori awal RM 6000 dan akhir RM 10000. Cari kadar pusing ganti inventori.
stem.en: Cost of sales RM 48000. Opening inventory RM 6000 and closing RM 10000. Find inventory turnover.

explanation.bm: Inventori purata 8000; pusing ganti 48000/8000=6 kali.
explanation.en: Average inventory 8000; turnover 48000/8000=6 times.

stem.bm: Modal awal RM 18000, modal akhir RM 25000, ambilan RM 3000 dan modal tambahan RM 4000. Cari untung.
stem.en: Opening capital RM 18000, closing capital RM 25000, drawings RM 3000 and extra capital RM 4000. Find profit.

explanation.bm: Untung=modal akhir−modal awal+ambilan−modal tambahan=25000−18000+3000−4000=6000.
explanation.en: Profit=closing−opening capital+drawings−extra capital=25000−18000+3000−4000=6000.

stem.bm: Penghutang awal RM 5000, akhir RM 6500; kutipan RM 20000; pulangan jualan RM 1000; tiada hutang lapuk atau diskaun. Cari jualan kredit.
stem.en: Opening receivables RM 5000, closing RM 6500; collections RM 20000; sales returns RM 1000; no bad debts or discounts. Find credit sales.

stem.bm: Untung kasar ialah 25% daripada kos jualan. Jualan bersih RM 50000. Cari kos jualan.
stem.en: Gross profit is 25% of cost of sales. Net sales RM 50000. Find cost of sales.

explanation.en: Sales=cost+0.25 cost=1.25 cost; cost=50000/1.25=40000.

stem.bm: Baki debit Buku Tunai RM 5000. Caj bank RM 50 dan faedah bank diterima RM 20 belum direkod. Cari baki Buku Tunai terselaras.
stem.en: Cash Book debit balance RM 5000. Unrecorded bank charges RM 50 and bank interest received RM 20. Find adjusted Cash Book balance.

explanation.bm: 5000−50+20=4970; kedua-duanya transaksi yang perlu catatan Buku Tunai.
explanation.en: 5000−50+20=4970; both require Cash Book entries.

stem.bm: Baki kredit dalam Penyata Bank (wang milik perniagaan) RM 7200. Deposit belum dikreditkan RM 1000 dan cek belum dikemukakan RM 600. Cari baki bank menurut Buku Tunai, andaikan tiada perkara lain.
stem.en: Bank Statement credit balance (business funds) RM 7200. Deposits not yet credited RM 1000 and unpresented cheques RM 600. Find Cash Book bank balance, assuming no other items.

explanation.bm: Buku Tunai sudah memasukkan deposit dan mengurangkan cek:7200+1000−600=7600.
explanation.en: Cash Book already adds deposits and subtracts cheques:7200+1000−600=7600.

stem.bm: Pegawai sama menerima tunai, merekod penerimaan dan menyediakan penyesuaian bank. Kawalan manakah secara langsung menangani penumpuan tiga tugas ini?
stem.en: One employee receives cash, records receipts and prepares bank reconciliation. Which control directly addresses this concentration of all three duties?

options.bm: Gunakan resit bernombor tetapi pegawai sama mengawal semua tugas
options.en: Use numbered receipts but retain the same employee for all duties

options.bm: Sediakan penyesuaian lebih kerap oleh pegawai yang sama
options.en: Have the same employee reconcile more frequently

options.bm: Pisahkan penerimaan, rekod dan semakan bebas
options.en: Separate receipt, recording and independent review

options.bm: Tetapkan deposit harian tetapi pegawai sama menerima, merekod dan menyemak
options.en: Require daily deposits but retain the same employee to receive, record and review

explanation.bm: Pengasingan tugas dan semakan bebas mengurangkan peluang menyembunyikan kesilapan atau penyelewengan.
explanation.en: Segregation and independent review reduce opportunities to hide errors or misappropriation.

stem.bm: Untung boleh diagih selepas semua faedah/gaji pekongsi ialah RM 24000. Nisbah untung A:B=3:2. Cari bahagian B.
stem.en: Residual profit after all partner interest/salaries is RM 24000. Profit ratio A:B=3:2. Find B’s share.

explanation.bm: B menerima 2/5 daripada 24000=9600.
explanation.en: B receives 2/5 of 24000=9600.

stem.bm: Modal tetap pekongsi RM 30000, kadar faedah atas modal 6% bagi setahun penuh. Cari faedah modal.
stem.en: A partner’s fixed capital is RM 30000 with 6% annual interest on capital for a full year. Find interest.

explanation.bm: 30000×0.06=1800; faedah modal ialah pengagihan untung mengikut perjanjian.
explanation.en: 30000×0.06=1800; interest on capital appropriates profit under the agreement.

stem.bm: Untung bersih RM 20000, faedah ambilan RM 500, gaji pekongsi RM 4000 dan faedah modal RM 2500. Cari untung baki untuk dibahagi.
stem.en: Net profit RM 20000, interest on drawings RM 500, partner salary RM 4000 and interest on capital RM 2500. Find residual profit.

explanation.bm: Tambah faedah ambilan kepada untung:20000+500−4000−2500=14000.
explanation.en: Add drawings interest to profit:20000+500−4000−2500=14000.

stem.bm: Syarikat menerbitkan 10000 syer pada harga terbitan RM 2 setiap satu dan semua tunai diterima. Berapakah modal syer yang dikreditkan?
stem.en: A company issues 10000 shares at issue price RM 2 each and receives all cash. What share capital is credited?

explanation.bm: Modal syer 10000×2=20000; ini harga terbitan diberi, bukan nilai tara yang diandaikan.
explanation.en: Share capital 10000×2=20000; this is the stated issue price, not an assumed par value.

stem.bm: Dividen tunai diluluskan RM 0.08 sesyer untuk 50000 syer biasa. Cari jumlah dividen.
stem.en: A cash dividend of RM 0.08 per share is approved for 50000 ordinary shares. Find total dividend.

stem.bm: Syarat syer keutamaan contoh menetapkan dividen tahunan 6% daripada modal syer keutamaan RM 80000. Jika dividen tahun ini diluluskan penuh, berapakah amaunnya?
stem.en: Sample preference-share terms specify annual dividend 6% of preference capital RM 80000. If the full current-year dividend is approved, what is its amount?

explanation.bm: 80000×0.06=4800. Syarat 6% diberi, bukan kadar diwajibkan bagi semua syer.
explanation.en: 80000×0.06=4800. The 6% is a stated term, not a compulsory rate for all shares.

stem.bm: Yuran diterima RM 9000 termasuk yuran awal tahun RM 500 yang telah terakru tahun lalu. Yuran terakru akhir RM 700; tiada yuran awal/akhir prabayar. Cari hasil yuran tahun ini.
stem.en: Subscriptions received RM 9000 include RM 500 opening arrears earned last year. Closing arrears RM 700; no opening/closing advances. Find current-year subscription income.

explanation.bm: Hasil=9000−500+700=9200; asingkan kutipan tahun lalu dan tambah hasil belum diterima.
explanation.en: Income=9000−500+700=9200; exclude prior-year collections and add current earned arrears.

stem.bm: Kelab mempunyai hasil pendapatan RM 18000 dan belanja hasil RM 15000. Apakah lebihan dalam Akaun Pendapatan dan Perbelanjaan?
stem.en: A club has revenue income RM 18000 and revenue expenditure RM 15000. What is its Income and Expenditure surplus?

explanation.bm: Lebihan=18000−15000=3000; kelab menggunakan istilah lebihan, bukan agihan untung pekongsi.
explanation.en: Surplus=18000−15000=3000; clubs report surplus rather than partnership profit allocation.

stem.bm: Kelab membeli peralatan sukan tahan lama RM 2400 melalui bank. Apakah layanan awal dalam Akaun Pendapatan dan Perbelanjaan sebelum susut nilai?
stem.en: A club buys durable sports equipment RM 2400 by bank. What is the initial Income and Expenditure treatment before depreciation?

options.bm: Perbelanjaan modal; tidak caj keseluruhan sebagai belanja hasil
options.en: Capital expenditure; do not charge full amount as revenue expense

explanation.bm: Peralatan ialah aset; bayaran masuk Akaun Penerimaan dan Pembayaran tetapi tidak seluruhnya belanja hasil.
explanation.en: Equipment is an asset; payment appears in Receipts and Payments but is not wholly revenue expenditure.

stem.bm: Bahan langsung RM 12000, buruh langsung RM 8000, belanja langsung RM 2000 dan overhed kilang RM 5000. Cari kos prima.
stem.en: Direct materials RM 12000, direct labour RM 8000, direct expenses RM 2000 and factory overhead RM 5000. Find prime cost.

explanation.bm: Kos prima=12000+8000+2000=22000; overhed tidak termasuk kos prima.
explanation.en: Prime cost=12000+8000+2000=22000; overhead is excluded from prime cost.

stem.bm: Kos tetap RM 18000, harga jualan seunit RM 50, kos berubah seunit RM 30. Cari titik pulang modal dalam unit.
stem.en: Fixed cost RM 18000, selling price per unit RM 50, variable cost per unit RM 30. Find break-even units.

explanation.bm: Sumbangan seunit=50−30=20; TPM=18000/20=900 unit.
explanation.en: Contribution per unit=50−30=20; break-even=18000/20=900 units.

stem.bm: Kos prima RM 22000, overhed kilang RM 7000, kerja dalam proses awal RM 3000 dan akhir RM 2000. Cari kos pengeluaran barang siap.
stem.en: Prime cost RM 22000, factory overhead RM 7000, opening work in progress RM 3000 and closing RM 2000. Find finished-goods production cost.

prompt.bm: Jualan 80000, kos jualan 50000, untung bersih 12000, aset semasa 30000 (inventori 10000), liabiliti semasa 15000. Hitung margin kasar, margin bersih, nisbah semasa dan ujian asid. Pembekal mahu dibayar segera: jelaskan mengapa nisbah semasa sahaja tidak mencukupi untuk menilai kemampuan tunai.
prompt.en: Sales 80000, cost of sales 50000, net profit 12000, current assets 30000 (inventory 10000), current liabilities 15000. Find gross margin, net margin, current ratio and acid-test ratio. A supplier wants prompt payment: explain why current ratio alone does not establish cash-paying ability.

modelAnswer.bm: Untung kasar 30000; margin 37.5%. Margin bersih 15%. Semasa 2:1; ujian asid 20000/15000=4/3:1≈1.33:1. Inventori mungkin lambat dijual dan penghutang belum dikutip; perlu aliran tunai/kematangan hutang, bukan hanya aset semasa.
modelAnswer.en: Gross profit 30000; margin 37.5%. Net margin 15%. Current 2:1; acid test 20000/15000=4/3:1≈1.33:1. Inventory may sell slowly and receivables may remain unpaid; cash flows and debt timing matter, not only current assets.

point.bm: Had tafsiran dan bukti tunai diperlukan
point.en: Interpretation limit and cash evidence needed

prompt.bm: Awal tahun aset 28000, liabiliti 8000; akhir tahun aset 36000, liabiliti 9000. Ambilan tunai 2500 dan barang 500; modal tambahan 4000. Sediakan penyata modal awal/akhir dan hitung untung. Jelaskan mengapa kenaikan aset 8000 bukan terus untung 8000.
prompt.en: Opening assets 28000, liabilities 8000; closing assets 36000, liabilities 9000. Drawings:cash 2500 and goods 500; extra capital 4000. Prepare opening/closing capital calculations and find profit. Explain why the 8000 asset increase is not automatically 8000 profit.

modelAnswer.bm: Modal awal 20000, akhir 27000. Ambilan 3000. Untung 27000−20000+3000−4000=6000. Aset juga berubah kerana hutang, modal tambahan dan ambilan; untung mesti mengasingkan kesan ini.
modelAnswer.en: Opening capital 20000, closing 27000. Drawings 3000. Profit 27000−20000+3000−4000=6000. Assets also change with debts, extra capital and drawings; profit isolates these effects.

point.en: Why asset change is not profit

prompt.bm: Buku Tunai debit 8400. Penyata Bank kredit 9000. Caj bank 80 dan debit terus utiliti 220 belum direkod Buku Tunai. Deposit belum dikreditkan 1500, cek belum dikemukakan 2400. (a) Kemas kini Buku Tunai. (b) Sediakan penyesuaian bermula Penyata Bank. (c) Bezakan catatan baharu dengan perbezaan masa.
prompt.en: Cash Book debit 8400. Bank Statement credit 9000. Bank charges 80 and direct utility debit 220 are not in Cash Book. Deposits not credited 1500, unpresented cheques 2400. (a) Update Cash Book. (b) Reconcile starting from Bank Statement. (c) Distinguish new entries from timing differences.

modelAnswer.bm: Buku Tunai terselaras=8400−80−220=8100. Penyata Bank 9000+deposit 1500−cek 2400=8100. Caj/debit terus memerlukan catatan; deposit/cek sudah direkod Buku Tunai, jadi hanya perbezaan masa dan jangan dicatat dua kali.
modelAnswer.en: Adjusted Cash Book=8400−80−220=8100. Statement 9000+deposit 1500−cheques 2400=8100. Charges/direct debit need entries; deposits/cheques are already recorded, so timing differences must not be entered again.

prompt.bm: Untung bersih RM 30000. A menerima gaji RM 6000. Faedah modal:A 2000, B 1000. Faedah ambilan:A 600, B 400. Untung baki dibahagi A:B=3:2. Sediakan pengagihan dan hitung jumlah kredit untung/faedah/gaji ke akaun semasa setiap pekongsi, kemudian tolak faedah ambilan (abaikan ambilan sebenar dan baki awal).
prompt.en: Net profit RM 30000. A receives salary RM 6000. Capital interest:A 2000, B 1000. Drawings interest:A 600, B 400. Residual profit shared A:B=3:2. Prepare appropriation and calculate total profit/interest/salary credits to each current account, then deduct drawings interest (ignore actual drawings and opening balances).

modelAnswer.bm: Untung untuk diagih 31000; tolak 6000+3000→baki 22000. Bahagian:A 13200, B 8800. Kredit A=6000+2000+13200=21200; B=1000+8800=9800. Selepas faedah ambilan:A 20600, B 9400, jumlah 30000.
modelAnswer.en: Profit available 31000; deduct 6000+3000→residual 22000. Shares:A 13200, B 8800. Credits A=6000+2000+13200=21200; B=1000+8800=9800. After drawings interest:A 20600, B 9400, total 30000.

prompt.bm: Syarikat menerbitkan 20000 syer biasa pada RM 1.50 sesyer dan menerima tunai penuh. Kemudian meluluskan dividen RM 0.05 sesyer, belum dibayar pada akhir tahun. Sediakan catatan terbitan dan pengisytiharan dividen, nyatakan modal syer serta liabiliti dividen, dan jelaskan mengapa dividen bukan belanja operasi.
prompt.en: A company issues 20000 ordinary shares at RM 1.50 each and receives all cash. It later approves RM 0.05 dividend per share, unpaid at year-end. Give entries for issue and declared dividend, state share capital and dividend liability, and explain why dividend is not operating expense.

modelAnswer.bm: Dr Bank 30000 Cr Modal Syer 30000. Dr Keuntungan Tertahan/Dividen Diisytiharkan 1000 Cr Dividen Belum Bayar 1000 (akaun penutup mengurangkan keuntungan tertahan). Modal syer 30000, liabiliti dividen 1000. Dividen ialah agihan untung kepada pemilik, bukan kos memperoleh hasil.
modelAnswer.en: Dr Bank 30000 Cr Share Capital 30000. Dr Retained Earnings/Declared Dividends 1000 Cr Dividends Payable 1000 (closing the dividend account reduces retained earnings). Share capital 30000, dividend liability 1000. Dividend distributes profit to owners rather than a cost of earning revenue.

prompt.bm: Yuran tunai diterima 12000. Awal: yuran terakru 600, yuran diterima terdahulu 400. Akhir: yuran terakru 900, yuran diterima terdahulu 700. Hasil lain 2000, belanja hasil 9000. Kira hasil yuran akruan dan lebihan tahun ini; nyatakan aset/liabiliti yuran akhir.
prompt.en: Cash subscriptions 12000. Opening:arrears 600, advances 400. Closing:arrears 900, advances 700. Other income 2000, revenue expenses 9000. Find accrual subscription income and surplus; identify closing subscription asset/liability.

modelAnswer.bm: Hasil yuran=12000−600+400+900−700=12000. Lebihan=12000+2000−9000=5000. Yuran terakru 900 aset semasa; yuran terdahulu 700 liabiliti semasa.
modelAnswer.en: Subscription income=12000−600+400+900−700=12000. Surplus=12000+2000−9000=5000. Arrears 900 current asset; advances 700 current liability.

prompt.bm: Harga jualan seunit RM 40, kos berubah RM 24, kos tetap RM 16000. Kira sumbangan seunit, titik pulang modal dan unit untuk sasaran untung RM 8000. Pada jualan 1500 unit, cari margin keselamatan dalam unit dan peratus. Nyatakan satu andaian model ini.
prompt.en: Selling price per unit RM 40, variable cost RM 24, fixed cost RM 16000. Find unit contribution, break-even and units for target profit RM 8000. At sales 1500 units, find margin of safety in units and percent. State one model assumption.

modelAnswer.bm: Sumbangan 16; TPM 16000/16=1000. Sasaran(16000+8000)/16=1500. Margin keselamatan 1500−1000=500 unit;500/1500×100=33⅓%. Andaian: harga dan kos berubah seunit malar, kos tetap kekal dalam julat relevan.
modelAnswer.en: Contribution 16; break-even 16000/16=1000. Target(16000+8000)/16=1500. Safety margin 1500−1000=500 units;500/1500×100=33⅓%. Assume constant unit price/variable cost and unchanged fixed cost within relevant range.

stem.bm: Seorang pedagang Melaka membawa pertikaian hutang ke mahkamah. Ciri negara bangsa yang paling langsung ditunjukkan ialah apa?
stem.en: A Melaka merchant brings a debt dispute to court. Which feature of the state is most directly illustrated?

options.bm: Wilayah pengaruh yang diperluas melalui perkahwinan
options.en: A sphere of influence expanded through marriage

explanation.bm: Mahkamah menyelesaikan pertikaian menggunakan peraturan. Contoh ini menguji fungsi undang-undang, bukan keluasan wilayah atau istiadat.
explanation.en: Courts resolve disputes through rules. This example concerns law rather than territorial extent or ceremony.

stem.bm: Mengapakah Undang-Undang Laut Melaka penting kepada perdagangan?
stem.en: Why were the Maritime Laws of Melaka important for trade?

options.en: They fixed all agricultural land taxes
They removed the need to manage ship safety

options.bm: Memindahkan kuasa pelabuhan kepada pedagang asing
options.en: They transferred port authority to foreign traders

explanation.bm: Peraturan maritim mengatur kegiatan dan kesalahan di atas kapal. Undang-undang ini tidak sama dengan cukai tanah.
explanation.en: Maritime rules governed activities and offences aboard ships; they were not agricultural tax rules.

stem.bm: Rakyat membekalkan tenaga untuk pertahanan; pemerintah menjaga keselamatan. Apakah tafsiran paling munasabah?
stem.en: People supplied labour for defence while rulers maintained security. What is the most reasonable interpretation?

options.bm: Keselamatan hanya bergantung pada hubungan perdagangan
options.en: Security depended solely on trade relations
The existence of law eliminated the people’s role
Rulers’ and people’s duties are connected

options.bm: Semua rakyat mempunyai kuasa pemerintahan yang sama dengan sultan
options.en: Every subject held the same governing power as the sultan

explanation.bm: Kedua-dua tindakan menyokong kestabilan, walaupun kuasa dan tugas mereka berbeza.
explanation.en: Both roles supported stability even though their powers and duties differed.

stem.bm: Sebuah akhbar membincangkan pendidikan dan hak penduduk di bawah penjajahan. Mengapa medium ini dapat meningkatkan kesedaran nasionalisme?
stem.en: A newspaper discusses education and local rights under colonial rule. Why could this medium develop nationalist awareness?

options.bm: Semua pembaca sudah mempunyai pandangan politik seragam
options.en: All readers already held identical political views

options.bm: Akhbar secara automatik menamatkan pemerintahan penjajah
options.en: A newspaper automatically ended colonial government

options.bm: Penerbitan menggantikan semua bentuk organisasi masyarakat
options.en: Publishing replaced every form of social organisation

explanation.bm: Penyebaran idea menghubungkan pengalaman masyarakat. Kesan politik memerlukan tindakan lanjut, bukan berlaku secara automatik.
explanation.en: Circulating ideas connected people’s experiences; political change still required further action.

stem.bm: Seorang pengkaji menemui surat yang menyeru penduduk membela maruah bangsa. Bukti tambahan manakah paling baik untuk menilai kesan surat itu?
stem.en: A researcher finds a letter urging people to defend national dignity. What further evidence best tests its influence?

options.en: An assumption that all inhabitants agreed
Records of reading, reception and action
The colour of the paper alone

options.bm: Jumlah halaman buku sejarah moden sahaja
options.en: Only the page count of a modern history book

explanation.bm: Kesan sesuatu idea perlu dinilai melalui penerimaan dan tindakan, bukan hanya kewujudan teks.
explanation.en: Influence requires evidence of reception and action, not merely the text’s existence.

stem.bm: Apakah perbezaan penting antara cinta akan negara dan nasionalisme anti-penjajahan?
stem.en: What distinguishes general love of country from anti-colonial nationalism?

options.bm: Cinta akan negara sentiasa melibatkan perjuangan bersenjata
options.en: Love of country always involved armed struggle

options.bm: Nasionalisme tidak mempunyai kaitan dengan identiti bersama
options.en: Nationalism had no connection with shared identity

options.bm: Tuntutan perubahan kuasa atau hak di bawah penjajahan
options.en: Claims for power or rights under colonial rule

explanation.bm: Dalam konteks penjajahan, tuntutan politik dan hak memberi tujuan khusus kepada kesedaran kebangsaan.
explanation.en: Under colonial rule, demands for political power and rights gave nationalism a specific purpose.

stem.bm: Sebuah peta menunjukkan Jepun mara ke kawasan pengeluar bahan mentah. Penjelasan manakah paling berkaitan dengan peluasan kuasa Jepun?
stem.en: A map shows Japan advancing towards raw-material-producing areas. Which explanation most directly relates to Japanese expansion?

options.en: A wish to create the Federation of Malaya in 1948

explanation.bm: Sumber dan kepentingan strategik membantu menjelaskan peluasan kuasa. Pilihan lain ialah peristiwa kemudian yang berlainan konteks.
explanation.en: Resources and strategic interests help explain expansion; the other events belong to later contexts.

stem.bm: Catatan keluarga menyebut bekalan beras sukar diperoleh dan wang semakin kurang bernilai ketika pendudukan. Apakah kesimpulan yang disokong?
stem.en: A family account mentions rice shortages and declining currency value during occupation. Which conclusion is supported?

options.bm: Semua daerah mengalami keadaan yang sama tepat
options.en: Every district experienced exactly identical conditions
Occupation did not affect food supplies

explanation.bm: Catatan menyokong kesukaran ekonomi keluarga itu. Generalisasi mutlak untuk semua daerah memerlukan lebih banyak bukti.
explanation.en: The account supports that family’s economic hardship; a universal claim about all districts requires more evidence.

stem.bm: Apakah langkah paling baik ketika membandingkan catatan Jepun dan catatan penduduk tempatan tentang peristiwa sama?
stem.en: What is the best approach when comparing Japanese and local accounts of the same event?

options.bm: Semak tujuan, tarikh dan bukti catatan
options.en: Check the accounts’ purpose, dates and evidence

options.bm: Terima catatan pihak yang menang perang sahaja
options.en: Accept only the account of the war’s victor

options.bm: Gabungkan semua dakwaan tanpa menilai percanggahan
options.en: Combine all claims without examining contradictions

options.bm: Tolak semua sumber yang menunjukkan emosi

explanation.bm: Sumber perlu dikritik berdasarkan asal dan bukti. Sudut pandang atau emosi tidak dengan sendirinya menentukan ketepatan.
explanation.en: Accounts need source criticism; perspective or emotion alone does not determine accuracy.

stem.bm: Mengapa isu kuasa Raja-raja Melayu menjadi sebab penentangan terhadap Malayan Union?
stem.en: Why did the authority of the Malay rulers become an issue in opposition to the Malayan Union?

options.bm: Malayan Union menyerahkan semua kuasa kepada pilihan raya tempatan
options.en: The Malayan Union transferred all authority to local elections

options.bm: Malayan Union telah melaksanakan kemerdekaan penuh
options.en: The Malayan Union had introduced full independence

options.bm: Malayan Union menggabungkan Sarawak dalam semua negeri Melayu
options.en: The Malayan Union merged Sarawak with all Malay states
The rulers’ political position was weakened

explanation.bm: Penentangan melibatkan struktur kuasa dan kedudukan Raja-raja, selain isu kewarganegaraan.
explanation.en: Opposition concerned the power structure and rulers’ position, alongside citizenship issues.

stem.bm: Apakah hubungan paling tepat antara British Military Administration dan Malayan Union?
stem.en: What most accurately relates the British Military Administration to the Malayan Union?

options.en: Both were created by the independent government in 1957

options.bm: Pentadbiran tentera ialah kabinet pilihan raya 1955
options.en: Military administration was the elected 1955 cabinet
The Malayan Union replaced the 1963 Federation of Malaysia

explanation.bm: Urutan ini membezakan pentadbiran sementara selepas perang daripada rancangan awam berikutnya.
explanation.en: This sequence distinguishes temporary post-war military administration from the subsequent civilian scheme.

stem.bm: Seorang pelajar menyamakan gerakan antipenyerahan Sarawak dengan semua penentangan Malayan Union. Apakah pembetulan paling penting?
stem.en: A pupil treats Sarawak’s anti-cession movement as identical to all Malayan Union opposition. What is the key correction?

options.bm: Anggap semua pemimpin dan tuntutan mereka sama
options.en: Treat all their leaders and demands as identical

options.bm: Gunakan tarikh kemerdekaan sahaja untuk menjelaskan kedua-duanya
options.en: Explain both solely through the independence date

options.bm: Padam semua peristiwa Sarawak daripada garis masa
options.en: Remove every Sarawak event from the timeline

explanation.bm: Gerakan menentang perubahan kuasa boleh dibandingkan, tetapi latar pentadbiran Sarawak berbeza daripada negeri-negeri dalam Malayan Union.
explanation.en: Opposition movements can be compared, but Sarawak’s administrative context differed from states in the Malayan Union.

stem.bm: Apakah perubahan asas apabila Malayan Union digantikan oleh Persekutuan Tanah Melayu 1948?
stem.en: What basic change occurred when the Malayan Union was replaced by the Federation of Malaya in 1948?

options.bm: Singapura menjadi sebuah negeri dalam persekutuan 1948
options.en: Singapore became a state in the 1948 federation

options.bm: Semua negeri mendapat kemerdekaan asing secara berasingan
options.en: All states became separate independent foreign countries

explanation.bm: Persekutuan 1948 menggantikan Malayan Union dan memulihkan kedudukan Raja-raja dalam struktur baharu.
explanation.en: The 1948 federation replaced the Malayan Union and restored the rulers’ position within a new structure.

stem.bm: Perjanjian ditandatangani pada 21 Januari 1948 dan berkuat kuasa pada 1 Februari 1948. Tarikh manakah patut digunakan sebagai tarikh mula pelaksanaan?
stem.en: The agreement was signed on 21 January 1948 and took effect on 1 February 1948. Which date marks implementation?

explanation.bm: Tarikh tandatangan dan tarikh kuat kuasa berlainan; pelaksanaan bermula pada tarikh kuat kuasa yang dinyatakan.
explanation.en: Signature and commencement dates differ; implementation begins on the stated effective date.

stem.bm: Mengapakah rundingan penting dalam pembentukan Persekutuan 1948?
stem.en: Why did negotiation matter in establishing the 1948 federation?

options.bm: Ia menjamin semua kumpulan menyokong setiap syarat
options.en: It guaranteed that every group accepted every condition

options.bm: Ia menjadikan semua syarat kewarganegaraan tidak diperlukan
options.en: It made every citizenship condition unnecessary

options.bm: Ia terus menghapuskan pemerintahan British pada 1948
options.en: It immediately ended British rule in 1948

explanation.bm: Rundingan menghasilkan susunan baharu tetapi tidak bermakna persetujuan mutlak atau kemerdekaan serta-merta.
explanation.en: Negotiation produced a new arrangement; it did not establish universal agreement or immediate independence.

stem.bm: Rancangan Briggs memindahkan penduduk ke petempatan baharu. Apakah matlamat keselamatan utama tindakan itu?
stem.en: The Briggs Plan relocated residents to new settlements. What was its main security purpose?

options.en: To establish the first general election

explanation.bm: Petempatan semula bertujuan mengurangkan hubungan bekalan gerila. Kesan sosialnya perlu dinilai berasingan.
explanation.en: Resettlement aimed to reduce guerrilla supply links; its social effects require separate evaluation.

stem.bm: Kempen keselamatan turut menawarkan kemudahan kesihatan dan pendidikan. Apakah logik pendekatan memenangi hati dan fikiran?
stem.en: A security campaign also offered health and education facilities. What was the logic of winning hearts and minds?

options.en: To eliminate information supplied by residents
To prove no military operations were needed

options.bm: Menggantikan semua pasukan keselamatan dengan sekolah
options.en: To replace all security forces with schools

explanation.bm: Sokongan awam dan maklumat melengkapi tindakan keselamatan; pendekatan ini bukan pengganti mutlak bagi semua operasi.
explanation.en: Public support and information complemented security measures rather than replacing every operation.

stem.bm: Mengapa penilaian Darurat perlu mempertimbangkan keselamatan dan kesan terhadap orang awam?
stem.en: Why should an evaluation of the Emergency consider both security and civilian effects?

options.bm: Kesan orang awam membuktikan semua ancaman tidak berlaku
options.en: Civilian effects prove no threat existed

options.bm: Buktikan keberkesanan dan kos sosial secara berasingan
options.en: Establish effectiveness and social costs separately

options.bm: Satu kejayaan tentera membuktikan semua dasar adil
options.en: One military success proves every policy was fair

options.bm: Matlamat keselamatan menjadikan semua pengalaman awam tidak relevan
options.en: Security aims make all civilian experience irrelevant

explanation.bm: Penilaian berimbang membezakan tujuan, hasil dan kesan; satu aspek tidak secara automatik meniadakan yang lain.
explanation.en: Balanced evaluation distinguishes aims, outcomes and effects; one does not automatically cancel another.

stem.bm: Apakah tujuan utama Sistem Ahli yang diperkenalkan pada 1951?
stem.en: What was the main purpose of the Member System introduced in 1951?

options.bm: Menubuhkan Malaysia bersama Sabah dan Sarawak pada 1951
options.en: To form Malaysia with Sabah and Sarawak in 1951
To replace all rulers with a president

options.bm: Menjadikan semua Ahli wakil yang dipilih melalui pilihan raya umum
options.en: To make all members representatives elected at a general election

explanation.bm: Sistem Ahli menyediakan latihan pentadbiran; ia berbeza daripada kabinet berasaskan pilihan raya umum 1955.
explanation.en: The system provided administrative training and differed from the cabinet following the 1955 election.

stem.bm: Mengapa Jawatankuasa Hubungan Antara Kaum penting dalam usaha menuju kemerdekaan?
stem.en: Why was the Communities Liaison Committee important in efforts towards independence?

options.bm: Ia menjadi mahkamah untuk semua kes jenayah
options.en: It served as the court for every criminal case

options.bm: Ia menyusun gerakan antipenyerahan Sarawak sahaja
options.en: It organised only Sarawak’s anti-cession movement

options.bm: Ia melaksanakan pengundian untuk setiap penduduk
options.en: It conducted voting for every resident

explanation.bm: Perbincangan antara pemimpin membantu menangani perbezaan kepentingan dan membina kerjasama.
explanation.en: Discussion among leaders helped address differing interests and build cooperation.

stem.bm: Dua cadangan pendidikan mempunyai pendekatan bahasa yang berlainan tetapi kedua-duanya membincangkan pembinaan masyarakat bersama. Apakah kaedah perbandingan terbaik?
stem.en: Two education proposals use different language approaches but both discuss building a common society. What is the best comparison method?

options.bm: Tolak tujuan perpaduan kerana pendekatan berbeza
options.en: Reject the unity aim because approaches differ

options.bm: Andaikan semua cadangan mempunyai kandungan serupa
options.en: Assume all proposals have identical content

explanation.bm: Tujuan bersama boleh dicapai melalui cadangan berbeza; analisis perlu membezakan tujuan dengan cara.
explanation.en: A common aim may involve different proposals; analysis distinguishes goals from methods.

stem.bm: Mengapakah pilihan raya Majlis Perundangan Persekutuan 1955 penting kepada persediaan kemerdekaan?
stem.en: Why was the 1955 Federal Legislative Council election important in preparing for independence?

options.bm: Ia membubarkan semua peranan British serta-merta
options.en: It immediately dissolved every British role

options.bm: Ia menjadi pilihan raya umum pertama Malaysia pada 1963
options.en: It was Malaysia’s first general election in 1963

options.bm: Ia menyatukan Sabah dan Sarawak dengan Tanah Melayu
options.en: It united Sabah and Sarawak with Malaya

explanation.bm: Pilihan raya 1955 mengukuhkan mandat tempatan sebelum kemerdekaan 1957.
explanation.en: The 1955 election strengthened a local mandate before independence in 1957.

stem.bm: Dalam urutan pilihan raya, apakah sebab penamaan calon berlaku sebelum pengundian?
stem.en: Why does candidate nomination precede polling in the election sequence?

options.en: Voters need to know the candidates

options.bm: Keputusan rasmi perlu diumumkan sebelum calon dikenali
options.en: Official results must be announced before candidates are known

options.bm: Penamaan calon menggantikan proses pengiraan undi
Kempen hanya boleh bermula selepas semua undi dikira
options.en: Campaigning can only begin after all votes are counted

explanation.bm: Penamaan menentukan pilihan yang akan dipertimbangkan pengundi; pengiraan dan keputusan datang selepas pengundian.
explanation.en: Nomination establishes voters’ choices; counting and results follow polling.

stem.bm: Mengapa kemenangan dalam pilihan raya tidak bermaksud semua rakyat bersetuju dengan setiap dasar pemenang?
stem.en: Why does electoral victory not mean every person agrees with every winning policy?

options.bm: Mandat pilihan raya tidak bermaksud persetujuan mutlak
options.en: An electoral mandate is not unanimity

options.bm: Semua pengundi wajib mengundi calon sama
options.en: Every voter must choose the same candidate

options.bm: Pilihan raya tidak melibatkan sebarang pilihan calon
options.en: An election involves no choice of candidates

explanation.bm: Pilihan raya menghasilkan mandat melalui undi; pandangan rakyat tetap pelbagai.
explanation.en: Voting produces a mandate while public views remain diverse.

stem.bm: Apakah peranan Suruhanjaya Reid dalam proses kemerdekaan?
stem.en: What was the Reid Commission’s role in the independence process?

options.en: Constitutional proposals for an independent federation
To conduct the Cobbold survey in Sarawak
To establish the Malayan Union in 1946

explanation.bm: Suruhanjaya Reid berkaitan penggubalan perlembagaan; Cobbold berkaitan pembentukan Malaysia pada dekad berikutnya.
explanation.en: Reid concerned constitutional drafting; Cobbold concerned Malaysia’s formation in the following decade.

stem.bm: Mengapa memorandum daripada pelbagai pihak penting semasa penggubalan perlembagaan?
stem.en: Why did memoranda from different groups matter during constitutional drafting?

options.en: Memoranda removed the need for negotiation

options.bm: Setiap memorandum secara automatik menjadi undang-undang

explanation.bm: Memorandum ialah input kepada pertimbangan dan rundingan, bukan undang-undang secara automatik.
explanation.en: Memoranda were inputs to consideration and negotiation, not automatically law.

stem.bm: Sebuah esei menyamakan cadangan awal suruhanjaya dengan teks perlembagaan akhir. Apakah kelemahan analisis itu?
stem.en: An essay equates initial commission proposals with the final constitutional text. What is the analytical weakness?

options.bm: Ia terlalu menekankan tarikh kuat kuasa

options.en: It proves no memoranda were submitted

options.bm: Ia menggunakan lebih daripada satu sumber
options.en: It uses more than one source

explanation.bm: Cadangan boleh disemak sebelum dimuktamadkan. Draf dan teks akhir perlu dibezakan.
explanation.en: Proposals can be revised before finalisation; drafts and final texts must be distinguished.

stem.bm: Pernyataan manakah membezakan kemerdekaan Tanah Melayu daripada pembentukan Malaysia?
stem.en: Which statement distinguishes Malaya’s independence from Malaysia’s formation?

options.bm: Kemerdekaan bermaksud tiada institusi kerajaan lagi
options.en: Independence meant government institutions ceased to exist

explanation.bm: Kedua-duanya ialah peristiwa berkaitan tetapi berbeza dalam tarikh dan skop wilayah.
explanation.en: The events are connected but differ in date and territorial scope.

stem.bm: Apakah perubahan kuasa yang paling berkaitan dengan kemerdekaan 1957?
stem.en: What change in authority is most directly associated with independence in 1957?

options.en: Every state became a foreign country
All laws were cancelled without replacement

options.bm: Rakyat tidak lagi mempunyai tanggungjawab awam
options.en: People no longer had civic responsibilities

explanation.bm: Kemerdekaan membawa kuasa pemerintahan sendiri dan tanggungjawab membina negara.
explanation.en: Independence brought self-government and responsibilities for nation building.

stem.bm: Untuk menilai sambutan kemerdekaan, gabungan sumber manakah paling kukuh?
stem.en: Which combination best supports investigation of independence celebrations?

options.bm: Cerita yang tidak diketahui penuturnya sahaja
options.en: Only a story with an unidentified narrator

options.bm: Satu poster moden tanpa rujukan sahaja
Bilangan tanda suka pada hantaran media sosial sahaja
Sumber sezaman dengan tarikh dan asal jelas
options.en: Contemporary sources with clear dates and provenance

explanation.bm: Sumber sezaman dengan asal yang diketahui boleh dibandingkan bagi menguji gambaran sesuatu peristiwa.
explanation.en: Contemporary sources with known provenance can be compared to test depictions of an event.

prompt.bm: Terangkan satu fungsi undang-undang Melaka dan satu tanggungjawab rakyat. Kemudian jelaskan bagaimana kedua-duanya membantu kestabilan. Bezakan fakta sejarah daripada iktibar moden.
prompt.en: Explain one function of Melaka law and one responsibility of subjects. Show how both contributed to stability, and distinguish historical facts from a modern lesson.

modelAnswer.bm: Undang-undang memberi aturan untuk menyelesaikan pertikaian. Rakyat menyumbang kepada pertahanan. Aturan dan kerjasama mengurangkan konflik. Iktibar moden ialah tanggungjawab bersama perlu dilaksanakan mengikut undang-undang; ini ialah tafsiran, bukan petikan sumber lama.
modelAnswer.en: Law supplied rules for resolving disputes; subjects contributed to defence. Rules and cooperation reduced conflict. A modern lesson is shared responsibility under law, clearly labelled as interpretation.

point.en: State an accurate function of law
Explain subjects’ role and its effect

point.bm: Bezakan fakta dan iktibar dengan alasan
point.en: Distinguish fact from lesson with reasoning

prompt.bm: Bandingkan peranan akhbar dan persatuan dalam mengembangkan nasionalisme. Beri satu mekanisme bagi setiap medium dan satu batas bukti yang perlu diakui oleh pengkaji.
prompt.en: Compare newspapers and associations in developing nationalism. Explain one mechanism for each and one limitation a researcher must acknowledge.

modelAnswer.bm: Akhbar menyebarkan idea; persatuan mengatur pertemuan dan tindakan. Kedua-duanya boleh menghubungkan masyarakat. Namun kewujudan akhbar sahaja tidak membuktikan semua orang menerima idea; rekod sambutan diperlukan.
modelAnswer.en: Newspapers circulated ideas; associations organised meetings and action. Both connected communities. The presence of a newspaper does not establish universal acceptance; response records are needed.

prompt.bm: Catatan A: keluarga mencatu makanan. Catatan B: laporan pentadbiran menekankan pengeluaran. Kedua-duanya ialah ringkasan rekaan untuk latihan. Jelaskan satu persamaan, satu perbezaan sudut pandang dan satu bukti tambahan yang diperlukan.
prompt.en: Account A: a family rationed food. Account B: an administrative report stressed production. Both are invented summaries for practice. Explain one connection, one perspective difference and one additional source needed.

modelAnswer.bm: Kedua-duanya berkaitan bekalan makanan. A menumpukan pengalaman pengguna, B matlamat pentadbiran. Rekod harga atau pengagihan boleh menguji keadaan bekalan. Ringkasan rekaan tidak boleh dijadikan dokumen sejarah sebenar.
modelAnswer.en: Both concern food supply. A foregrounds consumers’ experience; B concerns administrative aims. Price or distribution records could test supply conditions. Invented summaries are not authentic historical documents.

point.en: Suggest evidence and explain its use

prompt.bm: Bandingkan satu kebimbangan dalam penentangan Malayan Union dengan isu penyerahan Sarawak. Jelaskan sebab kedua-duanya tidak wajar dianggap gerakan yang serupa sepenuhnya.
prompt.en: Compare one concern in Malayan Union opposition with Sarawak’s cession issue. Explain why the movements should not be treated as completely identical.

modelAnswer.bm: Penentangan Malayan Union melibatkan kedudukan Raja-raja dan kewarganegaraan. Di Sarawak, penyerahan kepada British menimbulkan persoalan hak dan pemerintahan. Wilayah dan institusi berbeza, walaupun kedua-duanya berkaitan perubahan kuasa.
modelAnswer.en: Malayan Union opposition concerned rulers’ status and citizenship. Sarawak’s cession raised questions of rights and government. The territories and institutions differed although both involved changes of power.

prompt.bm: Bezakan tarikh tandatangan dan kuat kuasa Perjanjian 1948. Huraikan satu perubahan daripada Malayan Union dan mengapa Persekutuan 1948 tidak sama dengan kemerdekaan 1957.
prompt.en: Distinguish the 1948 agreement’s signature and effective dates. Explain one change from the Malayan Union and why 1948 was not equivalent to independence in 1957.

modelAnswer.bm: 21 Januari ialah tandatangan, 1 Februari ialah kuat kuasa. Struktur persekutuan memulihkan kedudukan Raja-raja. British masih memegang kuasa; kemerdekaan berlaku pada 1957.
modelAnswer.en: 21 January was signature; 1 February was commencement. Federal arrangements restored the rulers’ position. British authority remained; independence came in 1957.

prompt.bm: Terangkan matlamat Rancangan Briggs, satu kesan kepada penduduk dan satu jenis bukti yang boleh digunakan untuk menilai keberkesanannya. Elakkan dakwaan bahawa semua pengalaman penduduk sama.
prompt.en: Explain the Briggs Plan’s aim, one civilian effect and a type of evidence that could assess effectiveness. Avoid assuming identical experiences for all residents.

modelAnswer.bm: Tujuannya memutuskan bekalan gerila. Perpindahan boleh mengganggu mata pencarian dan hubungan sosial. Rekod bekalan, keselamatan serta pengalaman penduduk membantu penilaian; data dari beberapa tempat diperlukan.
modelAnswer.en: It aimed to disrupt guerrilla supplies. Relocation could affect livelihoods and social connections. Supply, security and resident records help assessment; evidence from several places is needed.

point.en: Relevant evidence and limits on generalisation

prompt.bm: Jelaskan bagaimana Sistem Ahli dan perbincangan antara kaum menyumbang kepada persediaan kemerdekaan melalui mekanisme yang berbeza. Beri satu batas bagi dakwaan bahawa kemerdekaan berpunca daripada satu faktor sahaja.
prompt.en: Explain how the Member System and inter-community discussion supported preparation for independence through different mechanisms. Give a limitation of a single-factor explanation.

modelAnswer.bm: Sistem Ahli membina pengalaman mentadbir; rundingan membina persefahaman. Kemerdekaan juga melibatkan pilihan raya, perlembagaan dan rundingan dengan British, maka satu faktor sahaja tidak mencukupi.
modelAnswer.en: The Member System developed administrative experience; discussion built understanding. Elections, constitutional work and negotiations with Britain also mattered, so a single factor is insufficient.

prompt.bm: Susun penamaan calon, pengundian, pengiraan dan pengumuman keputusan. Jelaskan kepentingan pilihan raya 1955 serta satu batas tafsiran kemenangan pilihan raya.
prompt.en: Sequence nomination, polling, counting and declaration of results. Explain the 1955 election’s significance and one limit on interpreting electoral victory.

modelAnswer.bm: Penamaan, pengundian, pengiraan, keputusan. Pilihan raya memberi mandat kepada pemimpin tempatan dan pengalaman berkerajaan. Mandat tidak membuktikan semua rakyat menerima semua dasar.
modelAnswer.en: Nomination, polling, counting, results. The election gave local leaders a mandate and governing experience. A mandate does not establish that everyone accepts all policies.

prompt.bm: Terangkan peranan Suruhanjaya Reid, kegunaan memorandum dan mengapa pengkaji perlu membandingkan cadangan dengan teks akhir.
prompt.en: Explain the Reid Commission’s role, the use of memoranda and why researchers should compare proposals with the final text.

modelAnswer.bm: Suruhanjaya menyediakan cadangan. Memorandum menyampaikan pandangan pihak berkepentingan. Perbandingan draf dan teks akhir menunjukkan perubahan melalui rundingan; setiap cadangan tidak semestinya diterima.
modelAnswer.en: The commission prepared proposals; memoranda conveyed stakeholder views. Comparing drafts and the final text reveals negotiated changes; not every proposal was necessarily accepted.

point.bm: Alasan membandingkan draf dan teks akhir
point.en: Reason to compare drafts and final text

prompt.bm: Bina garis masa tiga peristiwa: Persekutuan 1948, pilihan raya 1955 dan kemerdekaan 1957. Jelaskan bagaimana satu peristiwa membantu persediaan bagi yang berikutnya tanpa mendakwa proses itu tidak menghadapi cabaran.
prompt.en: Build a timeline of the 1948 federation, the 1955 election and 1957 independence. Explain how one prepared for the next, without implying the process faced no challenges.

modelAnswer.bm: 1948 membentuk susunan persekutuan; 1955 memberi mandat pilihan raya; 1957 menandakan kemerdekaan. Pengalaman pentadbiran dan mandat membantu rundingan, tetapi masih terdapat perbezaan kepentingan dan kerja perlembagaan.
modelAnswer.en: 1948 established federal arrangements; 1955 supplied an electoral mandate; 1957 marked independence. Administrative experience and mandate supported negotiations, alongside competing interests and constitutional work.

point.bm: Akui cabaran dan elak sebab tunggal
point.en: Acknowledge challenges and avoid single-cause claims

stem.bm: Negara membuat keputusan pentadbiran dalam wilayahnya berdasarkan undang-undang sendiri. Konsep manakah paling langsung diterangkan?
stem.en: A state makes administrative decisions within its territory under its own laws. Which concept is illustrated?

explanation.bm: Kedaulatan merujuk kuasa pemerintahan tertinggi dan kebebasan negara, bukan jumlah perdagangan.
explanation.en: Sovereignty concerns supreme governing authority and national independence, not trade volume.

stem.bm: Negara berdaulat masih menandatangani perjanjian antarabangsa. Apakah penjelasan paling tepat?
stem.en: A sovereign state signs an international agreement. Which explanation is most accurate?

options.bm: Pengiktirafan antarabangsa menggantikan semua undang-undang negara
options.en: International recognition replaces all national laws

options.bm: Semua perjanjian bermaksud negara telah dijajah
options.en: Every agreement means the state has been colonised

explanation.bm: Negara boleh memilih kerjasama sambil mempertahankan kuasa dan kepentingannya.
explanation.en: A state can choose cooperation while maintaining its authority and interests.

stem.bm: Apakah tindakan rakyat yang paling membantu mengekalkan kedaulatan dalam masyarakat majmuk?
stem.en: Which civic action best supports sovereignty in a diverse society?

options.bm: Menganggap semua perbezaan budaya sebagai ancaman
options.en: Treating every cultural difference as a threat

options.bm: Mengabaikan institusi awam kerana negara sudah merdeka
options.en: Ignoring public institutions because the country is independent

explanation.bm: Perpaduan dan penghormatan terhadap aturan bersama membantu kestabilan negara.
explanation.en: Unity and respect for shared rules support national stability.

stem.bm: Mengapa perlembagaan menjadi asas pentadbiran negara?
stem.en: Why is the constitution a foundation for national administration?

options.bm: Ia hanya menyenaraikan nama menteri semasa
options.en: It only lists current ministers’ names

options.bm: Ia menggantikan keperluan semua pilihan raya
options.en: It replaces the need for every election
Framework for institutions, powers and governance

options.bm: Ia berubah mengikut setiap keputusan seorang pegawai
options.en: It changes with every decision of one official

explanation.bm: Perlembagaan menyediakan aturan asas yang lebih kekal daripada keputusan pentadbiran harian.
explanation.en: The constitution supplies foundational rules beyond day-to-day administrative decisions.

stem.bm: Apakah sebab pindaan perlembagaan perlu mengikuti prosedur tertentu?
stem.en: Why must constitutional amendments follow specified procedures?

options.bm: Pindaan memerlukan proses dan kuasa sah
options.en: Amendments require lawful authority and procedure

options.bm: Perlembagaan tidak mempunyai sebarang aturan pindaan
options.en: The constitution has no amendment rules

options.bm: Semua pindaan boleh dibuat melalui iklan
options.en: Every amendment can be made through an advertisement

explanation.bm: Aturan pindaan menjaga kesahan perubahan. Ambang khusus bergantung pada perkara yang dipinda.
explanation.en: Amendment procedures preserve legality; specific thresholds depend on the provision concerned.

stem.bm: Sebuah esei mendakwa semua peruntukan perlembagaan hanya berasal daripada 1963. Apakah pembetulan paling baik?
stem.en: An essay claims every constitutional provision originated only in 1963. What is the best correction?

options.bm: Padam semua unsur sejarah daripada kajian perlembagaan
options.en: Remove all historical elements from constitutional study

options.bm: Samakan semua pindaan dengan Malayan Union
options.en: Equate every amendment with the Malayan Union

options.bm: Anggap perlembagaan bermula daripada pilihan raya 1955 sahaja
options.en: Assume the constitution began only with the 1955 election

explanation.bm: Perlembagaan berkembang; asas 1957 dan perubahan 1963 ialah tahap berlainan.
explanation.en: The constitution developed over time; its 1957 foundation and 1963 changes are different stages.

stem.bm: Dalam Raja Berperlembagaan, apakah asas pelaksanaan kuasa raja?
stem.en: In a constitutional monarchy, what governs the exercise of royal power?

options.en: A public vote on every palace decision

explanation.bm: Raja Berperlembagaan menjalankan kuasa dalam kerangka perlembagaan.
explanation.en: A constitutional monarch exercises powers within the constitutional framework.

stem.bm: Apakah pembezaan fungsi yang paling tepat?
stem.en: Which distinction of functions is most accurate?

options.bm: Pengundi terus mengadili setiap kes jenayah
options.en: Voters directly judge every criminal case

options.bm: Parlimen menggubal; kehakiman mentafsir dan mengadili
options.en: Parliament legislates; the judiciary interprets and adjudicates

options.bm: Mahkamah mengendalikan semua kempen pilihan raya

options.en: The cabinet replaces every court function

explanation.bm: Penggubalan, pelaksanaan dan pengadilan ialah fungsi yang dibezakan dalam struktur pemerintahan.
explanation.en: Law-making, administration and adjudication are distinct governmental functions.

stem.bm: Mengapa perbahasan Parlimen penting selepas pilihan raya?
stem.en: Why does parliamentary debate matter after elections?

options.bm: Perbahasan secara automatik membatalkan semua undang-undang
Wakil meneliti dasar dan kepentingan awam
options.en: Representatives scrutinise policy and public interests

options.bm: Pilihan raya menghapuskan keperluan meneliti dasar
options.en: Elections remove any need for policy scrutiny

options.bm: Setiap perbahasan mesti menghasilkan persetujuan sebulat suara

explanation.bm: Mandat pilihan raya disusuli tanggungjawab perwakilan dan penelitian dasar.
explanation.en: An electoral mandate is followed by responsibilities of representation and scrutiny.

stem.bm: Apakah ciri utama sistem persekutuan?
stem.en: What is the main feature of a federal system?

options.bm: Kuasa persekutuan dan negeri dibahagi mengikut perlembagaan
options.en: Federal and state powers are constitutionally divided

options.bm: Kerajaan persekutuan hanya mengurus satu bandar
options.en: The federal government manages only one town

options.bm: Semua negeri menjadi negara asing tanpa hubungan
options.en: Every state becomes an unrelated foreign country

options.bm: Kerajaan negeri menjalankan semua dasar luar
options.en: State governments conduct all foreign policy

explanation.bm: Persekutuan menggabungkan pemerintahan pusat dan negeri dengan pembahagian kuasa.
explanation.en: Federalism combines central and state government with an allocation of powers.

stem.bm: Projek bekalan air melibatkan beberapa agensi dengan tanggungjawab berbeza. Apakah keperluan pentadbiran yang paling jelas?
stem.en: A water-supply project involves agencies with different responsibilities. What administrative need is most evident?

options.bm: Andaian bahawa satu agensi memiliki semua kuasa
options.en: An assumption that one agency holds all powers

explanation.bm: Projek bersama memerlukan penyelarasan, bukan andaian kuasa tanpa batas.
explanation.en: Joint projects require coordination rather than an assumption of unlimited power.

stem.bm: Apakah faedah membandingkan Senarai Persekutuan, Negeri dan Bersama?
stem.en: Why compare the Federal, State and Concurrent Lists?

options.bm: Untuk menunjukkan setiap negeri mempunyai dasar luar berasingan
options.en: To show each state has separate foreign policy

options.bm: Untuk menggantikan teks perlembagaan dengan andaian
options.en: To replace constitutional text with assumptions

options.bm: Kenal pasti pembahagian kuasa dan kerjasama
Untuk menentukan budaya mana lebih tinggi

explanation.bm: Senarai bidang kuasa membantu membezakan tanggungjawab dan kerjasama.
explanation.en: The jurisdictional lists distinguish responsibilities and cooperation.

stem.bm: Apakah tujuan Suruhanjaya Cobbold?
stem.en: What was the purpose of the Cobbold Commission?

options.en: To draft the Malayan Union in 1946

options.bm: Pandangan Borneo Utara dan Sarawak tentang Malaysia
options.en: North Borneo and Sarawak views on Malaysia

explanation.bm: Cobbold berkaitan pandangan penduduk dua wilayah Borneo sebelum Malaysia dibentuk.
explanation.en: Cobbold investigated views in the two Borneo territories before Malaysia formed.

stem.bm: Apakah urutan peristiwa yang tepat?
stem.en: Which sequence is correct?

explanation.bm: Susunan kronologi membezakan proses kemerdekaan Tanah Melayu dan pembentukan Malaysia.
explanation.en: Chronology distinguishes Malayan independence from Malaysia’s formation.

stem.bm: Mengapa jaminan kepentingan wilayah penting dalam rundingan Malaysia?
stem.en: Why were safeguards for territorial interests important in Malaysia negotiations?

options.bm: Untuk membuktikan semua wilayah mempunyai sejarah yang sama
options.en: To prove every territory had identical history

options.bm: Untuk menolak semua bentuk kerjasama persekutuan
options.en: To reject every form of federal cooperation

explanation.bm: Rundingan perlu mempertimbangkan kepentingan dan keadaan berbeza bagi pembentukan yang dipersetujui.
explanation.en: Negotiation considered differing interests and conditions in reaching agreement.

stem.bm: Apakah cabaran yang paling langsung berkaitan dengan Konfrontasi?
stem.en: Which challenge most directly related to Confrontation?

options.en: Creation of the Malayan Union after 1963

explanation.bm: Konfrontasi ialah cabaran serantau berkaitan pembentukan Malaysia.
explanation.en: Confrontation was a regional challenge linked to Malaysia’s formation.

stem.bm: Mengapa pemisahan Singapura pada 1965 perlu dibezakan daripada pembentukan Malaysia 1963?
stem.en: Why distinguish Singapore’s separation in 1965 from Malaysia’s formation in 1963?

options.bm: Singapura tidak pernah menyertai Malaysia pada 1963
Kedua-dua peristiwa mempunyai tarikh dan kesan sama
options.en: Both events had identical dates and effects

explanation.bm: Singapura menyertai pada pembentukan dan berpisah kemudian; kronologi penting.
explanation.en: Singapore joined at formation and separated later; chronology matters.

stem.bm: Untuk menilai usaha memulihkan perpaduan selepas konflik, data manakah paling relevan?
stem.en: Which data best evaluates efforts to restore unity after conflict?

options.bm: Bilangan warna pada poster rasmi sahaja
options.en: Only the number of colours on official posters

options.bm: Andaian bahawa satu ucapan menyelesaikan semua masalah
options.en: An assumption that one speech solved every problem

options.bm: Hubungan komuniti, dasar dan pengalaman masyarakat
options.en: Community relations, policies and lived experience

explanation.bm: Keberkesanan usaha perpaduan perlu dinilai melalui pelaksanaan dan perubahan sosial.
explanation.en: Unity efforts should be evaluated through implementation and social change.

stem.bm: Apakah hubungan paling munasabah antara dasar pendidikan dan integrasi nasional?
stem.en: What is the most reasonable link between education policy and national integration?

options.bm: Integrasi memerlukan semua tradisi setempat dihapuskan
options.en: Integration requires eliminating every local tradition

options.bm: Satu dasar menghapuskan semua perbezaan masyarakat serta-merta
options.en: One policy instantly removes every social difference

explanation.bm: Pengalaman bersama menyokong persefahaman; integrasi tidak bermakna semua identiti mesti hilang.
explanation.en: Shared experiences support understanding; integration does not require every identity to disappear.

stem.bm: Rukun Negara diperkenalkan sebagai panduan kehidupan bersama. Tindakan manakah paling sesuai dengan kedaulatan undang-undang?
stem.en: The Rukun Negara guides shared civic life. Which action best reflects the rule of law?

options.en: Accepting every action because it is popular

options.bm: Menganggap jawatan tinggi membolehkan seseorang mengabaikan undang-undang
options.en: Assuming high office permits disregard for law

options.bm: Menghukum seseorang berdasarkan khabar angin sahaja

explanation.bm: Kedaulatan undang-undang menuntut aturan dan proses yang sah, bukan hukuman berdasarkan populariti.
explanation.en: The rule of law requires lawful rules and process rather than popularity-based punishment.

stem.bm: Sebuah kejohanan membentuk pasukan campuran komuniti. Apakah mekanisme perpaduan yang paling jelas?
stem.en: A tournament creates mixed-community teams. What is the clearest mechanism supporting unity?

options.bm: Semua perbezaan bahasa hilang selepas satu perlawanan
options.en: All language differences vanish after one match

explanation.bm: Interaksi dan kerjasama boleh mengurangkan jarak sosial tanpa menjamin perubahan serta-merta.
explanation.en: Interaction and cooperation can reduce social distance without guaranteeing instant change.

stem.bm: Apakah dua matlamat utama Dasar Ekonomi Baru?
stem.en: What were the two central objectives of the New Economic Policy?

options.bm: Basmi kemiskinan tanpa mengira kaum; susun semula masyarakat
options.en: Reduce poverty regardless of ethnicity; restructure society

options.bm: Membina tentera asing dan menamatkan perdagangan
options.en: Building a foreign army and ending trade

options.bm: Mengekalkan semua jurang pendapatan dan pekerjaan
options.en: Maintaining every income and occupational disparity

options.bm: Meningkatkan pelancongan sahaja dan memansuhkan sekolah
options.en: Only increasing tourism and abolishing schools

explanation.bm: Strategi serampang dua mata membezakan pembasmian kemiskinan dan penyusunan semula masyarakat.
explanation.en: The two-pronged strategy distinguishes poverty eradication from societal restructuring.

stem.bm: Program latihan membuka peluang pekerjaan baharu kepada keluarga berpendapatan rendah. Matlamat DEB manakah paling langsung disokong?
stem.en: Training creates employment opportunities for low-income families. Which NEP aim is most directly supported?

options.en: Elimination of every form of farming

explanation.bm: Peluang pekerjaan dan kemahiran boleh meningkatkan pendapatan serta mengurangkan kemiskinan.
explanation.en: Employment and skills can increase income and reduce poverty.

stem.bm: Mengapa pertumbuhan jumlah pendapatan negara sahaja tidak mencukupi untuk menilai kemakmuran?
stem.en: Why is growth in total national income alone insufficient to assess prosperity?

options.bm: Semua isi rumah pasti mendapat manfaat sama rata
Kaji agihan pendapatan dan taraf hidup
options.en: Examine income distribution and living standards

options.bm: Data kemiskinan tidak pernah membantu penilaian
Jumlah pendapatan tidak berkaitan ekonomi langsung
options.en: Total income has no economic relevance

explanation.bm: Pertumbuhan agregat boleh berlaku bersama jurang agihan; beberapa penunjuk diperlukan.
explanation.en: Aggregate growth may coexist with distributional gaps; several indicators are needed.

stem.bm: Mengapa lokasi dan keselamatan serantau mempengaruhi dasar luar?
stem.en: Why do location and regional security affect foreign policy?

options.bm: Lokasi menentukan semua keputusan tanpa pilihan politik
options.en: Location determines every decision without political choice

options.bm: Hubungan jiran mempengaruhi keselamatan dan perdagangan
options.en: Neighbour relations affect security and trade

options.bm: Dasar luar hanya berkaitan majlis kebudayaan
options.en: Foreign policy only concerns cultural ceremonies

options.bm: Keselamatan negara tidak mempunyai unsur antarabangsa
options.en: National security has no international dimension

explanation.bm: Faktor geografi dan keselamatan membentuk kepentingan negara tetapi bukan satu-satunya faktor.
explanation.en: Geography and security shape national interests but are not the sole factors.

stem.bm: Apakah perbezaan paling jelas antara ASEAN dan PBB?
stem.en: What is the clearest distinction between ASEAN and the UN?

options.bm: Kedua-duanya hanya mengurus mata wang Malaysia
ASEAN serantau Asia Tenggara; PBB global
options.en: ASEAN is Southeast Asian; the UN is global

options.bm: PBB ditubuhkan oleh semua sekolah ASEAN
options.en: The UN was founded by ASEAN schools

options.bm: ASEAN ialah mahkamah domestik; PBB ialah kerajaan negeri
options.en: ASEAN is a domestic court; the UN is a state government

explanation.bm: Skop serantau dan global membezakan organisasi walaupun terdapat tujuan kerjasama yang berkait.
explanation.en: Regional and global scope distinguish the organisations despite related cooperation goals.

stem.bm: Apakah bukti paling sesuai untuk menilai pendirian Malaysia dalam satu isu antarabangsa tertentu?
stem.en: What best establishes Malaysia’s position on a particular international issue?

options.bm: Anggapan bahawa pendirian tidak pernah berubah
options.en: An assumption that positions never change
Only the organisation’s name without context

options.bm: Pendapat seorang pengguna media sosial sahaja

explanation.bm: Dasar boleh berkembang; sumber bertarikh dan tindakan sebenar perlu diteliti.
explanation.en: Policy can develop; dated statements and actual actions need scrutiny.

stem.bm: Bagaimana penyertaan dalam misi keamanan boleh menyumbang kepada peranan Malaysia di dunia?
stem.en: How can participation in peacekeeping support Malaysia’s world role?

options.en: By replacing every participating country’s government
By permanently ending the need for diplomacy

options.bm: Membuktikan setiap konflik selesai dengan segera
options.en: By proving every conflict ends immediately

explanation.bm: Sumbangan keamanan ialah peranan kerjasama; keberkesanan sesuatu misi perlu dinilai melalui bukti.
explanation.en: Peacekeeping is a cooperative contribution; mission effectiveness requires evidence.

stem.bm: Sebuah projek serantau berkongsi kemahiran dan membuka peluang ekonomi. Kesan manakah paling munasabah?
stem.en: A regional project shares skills and creates economic opportunities. Which effect is most reasonable?

options.bm: Ia menjadikan sempadan semua negara tidak sah
Ia pasti menghapuskan semua kemiskinan selepas satu projek
options.en: It certainly removes all poverty after one project

explanation.bm: Kerjasama boleh memberi manfaat tanpa jaminan bahawa semua masalah selesai.
explanation.en: Cooperation can bring benefits without guaranteeing that every problem is solved.

stem.bm: Mengapa sumbangan global perlu dinilai melalui hasil dan bukan publisiti sahaja?
stem.en: Why evaluate global contributions through outcomes rather than publicity alone?

options.bm: Semua laporan rasmi mesti ditolak sebelum dibaca
options.en: All official reports must be rejected before reading

options.bm: Hasil tidak boleh diteliti dengan bukti
options.en: Outcomes cannot be investigated with evidence

options.bm: Liputan ialah perhatian; hasil ialah perubahan
options.en: Coverage indicates attention; outcomes indicate change

explanation.bm: Penilaian memerlukan hubungan antara tindakan dan kesan serta batas bukti.
explanation.en: Evaluation requires a link between actions and effects, with evidence limitations.

prompt.bm: Jelaskan maksud kedaulatan, satu ciri negara berdaulat dan bagaimana kerjasama antarabangsa boleh serasi dengan kedaulatan.
prompt.en: Define sovereignty, explain one feature of a sovereign state and show how international cooperation can coexist with sovereignty.

modelAnswer.bm: Negara mempunyai kuasa pemerintahan dalam wilayahnya. Undang-undang mengatur pentadbiran. Kerjasama dipersetujui untuk kepentingan bersama dan tidak semestinya memindahkan kuasa pemerintahan kepada negara lain.
modelAnswer.en: A state exercises governing authority in its territory. Laws organise administration. Cooperation is agreed for shared interests and does not necessarily transfer governing authority to another state.

prompt.bm: Terangkan satu fungsi perlembagaan dan bezakan kesinambungan asas 1957 daripada perubahan berkaitan pembentukan Malaysia 1963. Jangan menyatakan semua perkara boleh dipinda dengan ambang yang sama.
prompt.en: Explain one constitutional function and distinguish continuity from the 1957 foundation and changes related to Malaysia’s formation in 1963. Do not assume a single amendment threshold applies to everything.

modelAnswer.bm: Perlembagaan membahagikan kuasa dan menyusun institusi. Asas pemerintahan merdeka 1957 diteruskan dengan perubahan bagi pembentukan Malaysia. Prosedur pindaan bergantung pada peruntukan, maka generalisasi satu ambang tidak tepat.
modelAnswer.en: The constitution allocates power and organises institutions. The 1957 foundation continued with changes for Malaysia’s formation. Amendment procedures depend on the provision, so one universal threshold is inaccurate.

prompt.bm: Bezakan fungsi Parlimen, badan eksekutif dan badan kehakiman. Jelaskan mengapa pembahagian fungsi membantu pentadbiran yang bertanggungjawab.
prompt.en: Distinguish Parliament, the executive and the judiciary. Explain how different functions support accountable government.

modelAnswer.bm: Parlimen menggubal undang-undang; eksekutif mentadbir serta melaksanakan dasar; kehakiman mentafsir undang-undang dan mengadili. Pembahagian memberi ruang penelitian dan mengelakkan semua fungsi dihimpunkan dalam satu badan.
modelAnswer.en: Parliament makes laws; the executive administers and implements policy; the judiciary interprets law and adjudicates. Distinct functions enable scrutiny and prevent every function being concentrated in one body.

prompt.bm: Sebuah projek jalan, saliran dan kemudahan awam melibatkan beberapa peringkat kerajaan. Cadangkan cara menyelaras projek dengan menghormati bidang kuasa dan menerangkan manfaat kepada penduduk.
prompt.en: A roads, drainage and public-facilities project involves several levels of government. Propose coordination that respects jurisdiction and explain benefits to residents.

modelAnswer.bm: Kenal pasti tanggungjawab setiap agensi, bentuk mesyuarat bersama dan kongsi jadual serta maklumat. Penyelarasan mengurangkan pertindihan dan gangguan serta menjelaskan pihak yang bertanggungjawab.
modelAnswer.en: Identify each agency’s responsibilities, hold joint meetings and share schedules and information. Coordination reduces duplication and disruption and clarifies accountability.

prompt.bm: Jelaskan fungsi Cobbold dan mengapa tinjauan pandangan serta jaminan kepentingan wilayah penting. Bezakan sokongan majoriti dalam laporan daripada dakwaan bahawa setiap penduduk bersetuju.
prompt.en: Explain Cobbold’s function and the importance of consultation and territorial safeguards. Distinguish reported majority support from a claim that every resident agreed.

modelAnswer.bm: Cobbold meninjau pandangan Borneo Utara dan Sarawak. Tinjauan dan jaminan menangani kebimbangan penduduk. Majoriti tidak bermakna sebulat suara; pandangan berbeza perlu diakui.
modelAnswer.en: Cobbold examined views in North Borneo and Sarawak. Consultation and safeguards addressed residents’ concerns. A majority is not unanimity; differing views must be recognised.

prompt.bm: Pilih satu cabaran selepas 1963, nyatakan konteks dan jelaskan satu tindak balas yang munasabah. Cadangkan bukti untuk menilai kesan tindak balas itu.
prompt.en: Choose one post-1963 challenge, state its context and explain a reasonable response. Suggest evidence for evaluating its effect.

modelAnswer.bm: Konfrontasi mengancam keselamatan dan hubungan serantau. Tindak balas melibatkan langkah keselamatan serta diplomasi. Rekod rundingan dan perkembangan keselamatan boleh dibandingkan untuk menilai perubahan.
modelAnswer.en: Confrontation challenged security and regional relations. Responses involved security measures and diplomacy. Negotiation records and security developments can be compared to assess change.

prompt.bm: Cadangkan satu program sekolah yang menyokong integrasi melalui bahasa, pendidikan atau sukan. Jelaskan mekanismenya dan satu cara mengukur kesan tanpa hanya mengira jumlah peserta.
prompt.en: Propose a school programme supporting integration through language, education or sport. Explain its mechanism and an impact measure beyond attendance totals.

modelAnswer.bm: Pasukan projek campuran bekerjasama menyelesaikan masalah komuniti. Pembahagian tugas membina interaksi. Soal selidik sebelum dan selepas serta pemerhatian kerjasama memberi maklumat tentang kesan, bukan kehadiran sahaja.
modelAnswer.en: Mixed project teams solve a community problem. Shared tasks create interaction. Before-and-after surveys and observations of cooperation reveal effects beyond attendance.

prompt.bm: Jelaskan dua matlamat DEB. Cadangkan dua penunjuk untuk menilai hasil dan terangkan mengapa angka agregat sahaja boleh mengelirukan.
prompt.en: Explain the NEP’s two objectives. Suggest two outcome indicators and explain why an aggregate figure alone can mislead.

modelAnswer.bm: DEB menumpukan kemiskinan tanpa mengira kaum dan penyusunan masyarakat. Kadar kemiskinan serta agihan pendapatan atau pekerjaan membantu menilai hasil. Pendapatan keseluruhan meningkat tidak bermakna semua kelompok mendapat manfaat sama.
modelAnswer.en: The NEP focused on poverty irrespective of ethnicity and societal restructuring. Poverty rates and income or occupational distribution help assess outcomes. Rising total income does not imply equal gains for every group.

prompt.bm: Huraikan dua faktor yang mempengaruhi dasar luar Malaysia. Bezakan satu tujuan ASEAN daripada skop PBB dan cadangkan sumber untuk meneliti satu pendirian tertentu.
prompt.en: Explain two factors shaping Malaysia’s foreign policy. Distinguish an ASEAN purpose from the UN’s scope and suggest a source for researching a specific position.

modelAnswer.bm: Keselamatan dan ekonomi mempengaruhi hubungan luar. ASEAN menyokong kerjasama serantau; PBB mempunyai skop global. Kenyataan rasmi bertarikh serta rekod tindakan membantu menguji pendirian terhadap isu tertentu.
modelAnswer.en: Security and the economy shape external relations. ASEAN supports regional cooperation; the UN has global scope. Dated official statements and action records help establish a position on a particular issue.

prompt.bm: Pilih keamanan, alam sekitar atau kerjasama ekonomi. Cadangkan satu sumbangan Malaysia yang berkaitan dengan bidang itu dan dua ukuran hasil. Bezakan cadangan anda daripada dakwaan tentang program sebenar.
prompt.en: Choose peace, environment or economic cooperation. Propose a Malaysian contribution and two outcome measures. Distinguish your proposal from a claim about an actual programme.

modelAnswer.bm: Cadangan: perkongsian kepakaran mengurus banjir serantau. Ukuran: bilangan pasukan yang menguasai kemahiran dan perubahan masa respons. Ini cadangan rekaan; pelaksanaan sebenar memerlukan sumber dan persetujuan rakan.
modelAnswer.en: Proposal: share regional flood-management expertise. Measures: teams mastering skills and changes in response time. This is an invented proposal; actual implementation requires resources and partners’ agreement.

point.bm: Cadangan relevan dan dinyatakan sebagai cadangan

stem.bm:
Penduduk biasanya menggunakan pembesar suara untuk acara. Seorang jiran bekerja syif malam, dan pusat jagaan berdekatan memerlukan suasana tenang. Penganjur mahu mengekalkan tradisi sambil mengurangkan gangguan.
Keputusan manakah paling memenuhi keperluan yang dinyatakan?
stem.en:
Residents traditionally use loudspeakers at celebrations. A neighbour works nights and a nearby care centre needs quiet. Organisers want to retain the tradition while reducing disruption.
Which decision best meets the stated needs?

options.bm: Ikut waktu biasa tanpa menilai keadaan baharu
options.en: Keep customary hours without assessing the new circumstances

options.bm: Minta jiran berpindah sementara tanpa membincangkan alternatif
options.en: Ask neighbours to move temporarily without discussing alternatives

options.bm: Batalkan semua acara masyarakat untuk setahun
options.en: Cancel every community event for a year

explanation.bm: Pilihan ini mengimbangi kepentingan yang relevan: Norma boleh disesuaikan dengan menjaga hormat serta kesejahteraan bersama. Penilaian mestilah berdasarkan konteks, bukan sekadar memilih kata nilai.
explanation.en: This response addresses the relevant interests: Norms can be adapted while respecting shared well-being. Judgement depends on context rather than naming a value alone.

stem.bm:
Aina tersalah merekod sumbangan dalam laporan kelab. Jika dibetulkan, jumlah kutipan kelihatan lebih rendah dan anugerah kelab mungkin terjejas. Rekod asal masih ada.
Keputusan manakah paling memenuhi keperluan yang dinyatakan?
stem.en:
Aina incorrectly recorded donations in a club report. Correcting it would reduce the reported total and may affect an award. Original records remain available.
Which decision best meets the stated needs?

options.bm: Betulkan dan jelaskan laporan dengan bukti
options.en: Correct and explain the report using evidence

options.bm: Tunggu sehingga penilaian anugerah selesai sebelum mengaku
options.en: Wait until the award assessment ends before disclosing it

options.bm: Ubah jumlah tanpa menjelaskan pembetulan kepada bendahari
options.en: Change the total without explaining the correction to the treasurer

options.bm: Minta rakan menerima tanggungjawab supaya reputasi kelab terjaga
options.en: Ask a friend to take responsibility to protect the club’s reputation

explanation.bm: Pilihan ini mengimbangi kepentingan yang relevan: Kejujuran dan tanggungjawab memerlukan pembetulan walaupun ada kos kepada reputasi. Penilaian mestilah berdasarkan konteks, bukan sekadar memilih kata nilai.
explanation.en: This response addresses the relevant interests: Honesty and responsibility require correction despite reputational cost. Judgement depends on context rather than naming a value alone.

stem.bm:
Pasukan hanya mampu menaja empat yuran pertandingan. Dua pelajar berpendapatan rendah tidak mampu membayar. Semua calon memenuhi syarat prestasi. Pemilihan mesti telus dan mengambil kira keperluan.
Keputusan manakah paling memenuhi keperluan yang dinyatakan?
stem.en:
A team can sponsor only four competition fees. Two low-income pupils cannot pay. All candidates meet performance requirements. Selection must be transparent and consider need.
Which decision best meets the stated needs?

options.bm: Bahagikan sama rata walaupun tiada seorang pun mampu membayar baki

prompt.en:
Residents traditionally use loudspeakers at celebrations. A neighbour works nights and a nearby care centre needs quiet. Organisers want to retain the tradition while reducing disruption.
Propose an agreement that retains the event and respects neighbours. Explain an action, its justification and consequences; a value label alone is insufficient.

modelAnswer.bm: Berunding tentang masa dan had bunyi dengan pihak terjejas. Alasan: Norma boleh disesuaikan dengan menjaga hormat serta kesejahteraan bersama. Kesan boleh dinilai melalui maklum balas jiran dan rekod pematuhan had bunyi semasa acara.
modelAnswer.en: Agree on timing and sound limits with those affected. Reason: Norms can be adapted while respecting shared well-being. Assess effects using neighbours’ feedback and compliance with sound limits during events.

modelAnswer.en: Correct the report using supporting records and inform the relevant people. Reason: Honesty and responsibility require correction despite reputational cost. Assess effects using a report reconciled to original records and verified by the treasurer.

title.bm: Dilema: Prinsip Keadilan dan Keprihatinan dalam Membuat Keputusan
title.en: Dilemma: Justice and Care in Decision-making

prompt.bm:
Pasukan hanya mampu menaja empat yuran pertandingan. Dua pelajar berpendapatan rendah tidak mampu membayar. Semua calon memenuhi syarat prestasi. Pemilihan mesti telus dan mengambil kira keperluan.
Bina prosedur pemilihan yang menerangkan keadilan dan keprihatinan. Huraikan tindakan, alasan dan akibat; istilah nilai sahaja tidak mencukupi.
prompt.en:
A team can sponsor only four competition fees. Two low-income pupils cannot pay. All candidates meet performance requirements. Selection must be transparent and consider need.
Design a selection procedure explaining fairness and care. Explain an action, its justification and consequences; a value label alone is insufficient.

modelAnswer.bm: Gunakan kriteria prestasi dan keperluan yang diumumkan serta sediakan semakan. Alasan: Keadilan proses boleh digabungkan dengan keprihatinan terhadap halangan sebenar. Kesan boleh dinilai melalui keputusan mengikut kriteria, akses peserta dan maklum balas semakan.
modelAnswer.en: Apply announced performance and need criteria with a review process. Reason: Procedural fairness can be combined with care for real barriers. Assess effects using criteria compliance, participation access and review feedback.
