stem.bm: Yis digunakan dalam pembuatan roti kerana menghasilkan gas yang mana?
stem.en: Yeast is used in bread making because it produces which gas?

explanation.bm: Fermentasi gula oleh yis menghasilkan karbon dioksida yang mengembangkan doh.
explanation.en: Yeast fermentation produces carbon dioxide that expands dough.

stem.bm: Mengapa pengeringan boleh memanjangkan jangka simpan makanan?
stem.en: Why can drying extend food storage life?

options.bm: Mengurangkan air tersedia untuk pertumbuhan mikroorganisma
options.en: It reduces water available for microbial growth

explanation.bm: Kurang air tersedia menghalang pertumbuhan banyak mikroorganisma; pengeringan bukan pensterilan lengkap.
explanation.en: Less available water inhibits many microorganisms; drying is not complete sterilisation.

stem.bm: Label menunjukkan 8 g protein bagi setiap 100 g. Berapakah protein dalam hidangan 150 g?
stem.en: A label gives 8 g protein per 100 g. How much protein is in a 150 g serving?

stem.bm: Apakah tujuan pempasteuran susu?
stem.en: What is the purpose of milk pasteurisation?

options.bm: Mengurangkan mikroorganisma berbahaya melalui pemanasan terkawal
options.en: To reduce harmful microorganisms using controlled heating

options.bm: Menyingkirkan semua bakteria tanpa memerlukan penyejukan
options.en: Removing every bacterium without a need for refrigeration

options.bm: Mensterilkan susu sepenuhnya untuk penyimpanan tanpa had
options.en: Completely sterilising milk for indefinite storage

explanation.bm: Pempasteuran menggunakan suhu dan masa terkawal; penyimpanan sesuai masih diperlukan.
explanation.en: Pasteurisation uses controlled temperature and time; suitable storage is still needed.

stem.bm: Apakah kesan awal kemasukan terlalu banyak nitrat ke tasik?
stem.en: What is an early effect of excessive nitrate entering a lake?

options.en: Death of every alga before growth
A permanent oxygen rise without decomposition
A decrease in all available nutrients

explanation.bm: Nutrien berlebihan menggalakkan ledakan alga; pereputan kemudian boleh mengurangkan oksigen.
explanation.en: Excess nutrients promote algal blooms; later decomposition can reduce oxygen.

stem.bm: Pembakaran terbuka plastik paling berkait dengan risiko yang mana?
stem.en: Open burning of plastic is most associated with which risk?

options.en: A reduction in all carbon emissions

options.bm: Peningkatan mutu udara kerana sisa hilang
options.en: Better air quality because waste disappears

options.bm: Pencemaran udara oleh asap dan bahan berbahaya
options.en: Air pollution from smoke and harmful substances

explanation.bm: Pembakaran tidak terkawal boleh melepaskan zarah dan bahan berbahaya.
explanation.en: Uncontrolled burning can release particles and harmful substances.

stem.bm: Untuk membandingkan jejak karbon dua perjalanan, maklumat manakah paling relevan?
stem.en: To compare the carbon footprints of two journeys, which information is most relevant?

options.bm: Harga tiket sahaja tanpa penggunaan tenaga
options.en: Ticket price alone without energy use

options.bm: Jarak, jenis kenderaan dan bilangan penumpang
options.en: Distance, vehicle type and passenger number

explanation.bm: Pelepasan per penumpang bergantung pada perjalanan, penggunaan tenaga dan perkongsian pengangkutan.
explanation.en: Emissions per passenger depend on the journey, energy use and shared transport.

stem.bm: Gas terkumpul 48 cm³ dalam 24 s. Berapakah kadar purata pembentukan gas?
stem.en: 48 cm³ of gas is collected in 24 s. What is the average rate of gas formation?

explanation.bm: Kadar purata = perubahan isi padu/masa = 48/24.
explanation.en: Average rate = volume change/time = 48/24.

stem.bm: Jisim sama batu kapur serbuk bertindak lebih cepat daripada ketulan dengan asid sama. Mengapa?
stem.en: Equal masses of powdered limestone react faster than lumps with the same acid. Why?

options.bm: Serbuk mempunyai lebih banyak mol walaupun jisim sama
options.en: Powder contains more moles despite equal mass

options.bm: Serbuk menaikkan kepekatan asid dengan sendirinya
options.en: Powder raises acid concentration by itself

options.bm: Tenaga pengaktifan mesti berkurang apabila dihancurkan
options.en: Activation energy must decrease when crushed

explanation.bm: Lebih banyak permukaan membolehkan lebih banyak perlanggaran pada masa sama.
explanation.en: More surface permits more collisions in the same time.

stem.bm: Dua tindak balas menggunakan jumlah bahan terhad sama. Mangkin ditambah kepada satu. Apakah kesan lazim?
stem.en: Two reactions use the same quantity of limiting reactant. A catalyst is added to one. What is the usual effect?

options.bm: Kadar meningkat kerana mangkin digunakan habis sebagai bahan utama
options.en: Rate rises because catalyst is consumed as the main reactant

options.bm: Produk akhir sama tetapi dicapai lebih cepat
options.en: The same final product amount is reached faster

options.bm: Produk akhir berganda kerana mangkin menambah bahan terhad
options.en: Final product doubles because catalyst adds limiting reactant

options.bm: Produk akhir berkurang kerana mangkin menyerapnya
options.en: Final product decreases because catalyst absorbs it

explanation.bm: Mangkin mengubah kadar, bukan jumlah produk yang ditentukan oleh bahan terhad.
explanation.en: A catalyst changes rate, not the product amount set by the limiting reactant.

stem.bm: Sebatian C₃H₈ tergolong dalam siri homolog yang mana?
stem.en: C₃H₈ belongs to which homologous series?

explanation.bm: Formula alkana ialah CₙH₂ₙ₊₂; bagi n = 3, H = 8.
explanation.en: The alkane formula is CₙH₂ₙ₊₂; for n = 3, H = 8.

stem.bm: Apakah hasil utama tindak balas alkohol dengan asid karboksilik dalam pengesteran?
stem.en: What are the main products when an alcohol reacts with a carboxylic acid in esterification?

explanation.bm: Pengesteran menggabungkan alkohol dan asid untuk membentuk ester serta air.
explanation.en: Esterification combines an alcohol and an acid to form an ester and water.

stem.bm: Mengapa minyak tak tepu boleh dinyahwarnakan oleh air bromin dalam ujian terkawal?
stem.en: Why can unsaturated oil decolourise bromine water in a controlled test?

options.bm: Ikatan C=C tidak bertindak balas dan bromin hanya dicairkan
options.en: C=C does not react and bromine is merely diluted

options.bm: Bromin bertindak balas hanya dengan kumpulan karboksil minyak
options.en: Bromine reacts only with the oil’s carboxyl groups

options.bm: Ikatan C=C mengalami tindak balas penambahan
Ikatan tunggal C–C menjalani penambahan tanpa ikatan C=C
options.en: Single C–C bonds undergo addition without C=C bonds

explanation.bm: Ikatan ganda dua bertindak balas dengan bromin; jangan jalankan ujian tanpa penyeliaan.
explanation.en: Double bonds react with bromine; do not perform the test without supervision.

stem.bm: Mengapa natrium klorida lebur mengalirkan elektrik tetapi pepejalnya tidak?
stem.en: Why does molten sodium chloride conduct electricity while the solid does not?

options.bm: Ion pepejal bergerak sama bebas tetapi casnya sifar
options.en: Solid ions are equally mobile but have zero charge

options.bm: Elektron bebas bergerak antara semua ion seperti logam
options.en: Free electrons move between every ion as in metals
Ions can move in the melt

explanation.bm: Ion tetap dalam kekisi pepejal tetapi bergerak bebas dalam leburan.
explanation.en: Ions are fixed in the solid lattice but mobile in the melt.

stem.bm: Dalam sel elektrolisis, ion positif bergerak ke elektrod yang mana?
stem.en: In an electrolytic cell, positive ions move to which electrode?

explanation.bm: Kation tertarik kepada katod negatif dan menerima elektron.
explanation.en: Cations are attracted to the negative cathode and gain electrons.

stem.bm: Sel kimia menukarkan tenaga yang mana?
stem.en: Which energy conversion occurs in a chemical cell?

options.en: Electrical to chemical as in electrolysis

options.bm: Haba kepada elektrik tanpa tindak balas kimia
options.en: Heat to electricity without a chemical reaction

explanation.bm: Tindak balas kimia spontan menghasilkan aliran elektron dalam litar luar.
explanation.en: A spontaneous chemical reaction produces electron flow in the external circuit.

stem.bm: Objek terletak lebih jauh daripada 2f di hadapan kanta cembung. Imej terbentuk bagaimana?
stem.en: An object is farther than 2f in front of a convex lens. What image forms?

explanation.bm: Imej terbentuk antara f dan 2f pada sisi bertentangan kanta.
explanation.en: The image forms between f and 2f on the opposite side of the lens.

stem.bm: Kanta cekung digunakan untuk membetulkan rabun jauh kerana ia melakukan apa?
stem.en: A concave lens corrects short-sightedness because it does what?

options.bm: Menumpukan cahaya lebih awal di hadapan retina
options.en: Converges light earlier in front of the retina
Diverges light before it enters the eye
Increases the converging power of the eye system

options.bm: Menjadikan imej kabur di hadapan retina lebih besar tanpa mengubah fokus
options.en: Enlarges the blurred image in front of the retina without changing the focus

explanation.bm: Pencapahan membantu fokus jatuh pada retina, bukan di hadapannya.
explanation.en: Divergence helps the focus fall on the retina rather than in front of it.

stem.bm: Mengapa kanta kamera mengubah kedudukan semasa memfokus objek pada jarak berbeza?
stem.en: Why does a camera lens change position when focusing objects at different distances?

options.bm: Jarak imej berubah mengikut jarak objek
options.en: Image distance changes with object distance

options.bm: Untuk mengekalkan jarak imej yang sentiasa sifar
options.en: To keep image distance always zero

options.bm: Untuk menukar imej nyata kepada maya pada sensor
options.en: To turn a real image into a virtual image on the sensor

options.bm: Kerana objek lebih jauh sentiasa memerlukan jarak imej lebih besar
options.en: Because a farther object always needs a larger image distance

explanation.bm: Kedudukan kanta dilaras agar imej nyata tajam terbentuk pada sensor.
explanation.en: The lens is adjusted so a sharp real image forms on the sensor.

stem.bm: Daya 120 N bertindak pada luas 0.03 m². Berapakah tekanan?
stem.en: A 120 N force acts over 0.03 m². What is the pressure?

stem.bm: Dalam sistem hidraulik ideal, luas omboh keluaran empat kali luas masukan. Daya masukan 50 N. Berapakah daya keluaran?
stem.en: In an ideal hydraulic system, the output piston area is four times the input area. Input force is 50 N. What is the output force?

explanation.bm: Tekanan sama: F₂/F₁ = A₂/A₁ = 4.
explanation.en: Equal pressure gives F₂/F₁ = A₂/A₁ = 4.

stem.bm: Bagi aliran mantap bendalir ideal tak termampat pada garis arus yang sama dan ketinggian sama, bagaimanakah tekanan statik di kawasan lebih laju berbanding kawasan lebih perlahan?
stem.en: For steady incompressible ideal flow along the same streamline at the same height, how does static pressure in the faster region compare with the slower region?

options.bm: Sama kerana kedua-dua bahagian pada aras sama
options.en: Equal because both regions are at the same height

options.bm: Lebih rendah hanya jika bendalir berhenti
options.en: Lower only if the fluid stops

explanation.bm: Prinsip Bernoulli mengaitkan laju lebih tinggi dengan tekanan statik lebih rendah pada syarat ini.
explanation.en: Bernoulli’s principle relates higher speed to lower static pressure under these conditions.

stem.bm: Apakah ciri satelit geopegun?
stem.en: What characterises a geostationary satellite?

options.bm: Orbit bulat di satah khatulistiwa dengan tempoh dan arah putaran Bumi
options.en: A circular equatorial orbit with Earth’s rotation period and direction

options.bm: Orbit kutub dengan tempoh sama putaran Bumi
options.en: A polar orbit with Earth’s rotation period

options.bm: Orbit khatulistiwa dengan arah bertentangan putaran Bumi
options.en: An equatorial orbit opposite Earth’s rotation

options.bm: Orbit khatulistiwa dengan tempoh separuh putaran Bumi
options.en: An equatorial orbit with half Earth’s rotation period

explanation.bm: Syarat tersebut mengekalkan kedudukan tampak di atas satu titik khatulistiwa.
explanation.en: These conditions keep its apparent position above one equatorial point.

stem.bm: Untuk menilai perubahan litupan hutan selama sepuluh tahun, set data penderiaan jauh manakah paling berguna?
stem.en: To assess forest-cover change over ten years, which remote-sensing dataset is most useful?

options.bm: Satu imej terkini sahaja tanpa imej lebih awal
options.en: Only one recent image without earlier images

options.bm: Imej kawasan sama pada tarikh berbeza dengan resolusi setanding
options.en: Images of the same area at different dates with comparable resolution
Only the signal strength of a communications satellite

options.bm: Imej dua kawasan berbeza pada satu tarikh
options.en: Images of two different areas on one date

explanation.bm: Imej setanding bagi kawasan sama membolehkan perubahan litupan dipetakan; perbezaan resolusi dan musim juga perlu dinilai.
explanation.en: Comparable images of the same area allow cover changes to be mapped; resolution and seasonal differences must also be evaluated.

stem.bm: Mengapa serpihan angkasa berbahaya kepada satelit yang beroperasi?
stem.en: Why is space debris dangerous to operating satellites?

options.bm: Serpihan kecil tidak berbahaya tanpa mengira laju
options.en: Small debris is harmless regardless of speed

options.bm: Perlanggaran pada laju relatif tinggi boleh merosakkan satelit
options.en: Collisions at high relative speeds can damage satellites

options.bm: Semua serpihan jatuh ke Bumi sebelum boleh berlanggar
options.en: All debris falls to Earth before collisions are possible

options.bm: Satelit berorbit tidak mempunyai tenaga kinetik
options.en: Orbiting satellites have no kinetic energy

explanation.bm: Objek kecil pada laju tinggi boleh memindahkan tenaga besar dalam perlanggaran.
explanation.en: Small objects at high speed can transfer substantial energy in a collision.

prompt.bm: Data rekaan bilangan koloni selepas tempoh sama: 10°C: 12; 30°C: 80; 60°C: 3. Nyatakan trend, satu pemboleh ubah dikawal dan sebab data tidak membuktikan semua bakteria mati pada 60°C. Analisis data sahaja.
prompt.en: Fictional colony counts after equal time: 10°C: 12; 30°C: 80; 60°C: 3. State the trend, one controlled variable and why these data do not show all bacteria die at 60°C. Analyse data only.

modelAnswer.bm: Pertumbuhan tertinggi pada 30°C bagi kultur ini; jenis bakteria/nutrien/tempoh dikawal; 3 koloni masih direkod dan spesies lain mungkin berbeza.
modelAnswer.en: Growth is greatest at 30°C for this culture; control bacterial type/nutrients/time; 3 colonies remain and other species may differ.

prompt.bm: Sampel A mengandungi 4 g protein/100 g; B 9 g/100 g. Untuk hidangan 200 g, kira protein kedua-duanya. Terangkan mengapa protein sahaja tidak menentukan makanan paling seimbang.
prompt.en: Sample A contains 4 g protein/100 g; B contains 9 g/100 g. For 200 g servings, calculate their protein contents. Explain why protein alone does not determine the most balanced food.

modelAnswer.bm: A 8 g; B 18 g. Penilaian diet turut mengambil kira tenaga, lemak, gula, serat dan nutrien lain serta keperluan individu.
modelAnswer.en: A has 8 g; B has 18 g. Diet assessment also considers energy, fats, sugars, fibre and other nutrients and individual needs.

prompt.bm: Pelepasan rekaan: kereta 12 kg CO₂ dengan 1 penumpang; bas 40 kg dengan 20 penumpang untuk jarak sama. Kira pelepasan per penumpang dan beri satu had perbandingan.
prompt.en: Fictional emissions: car 12 kg CO₂ with 1 passenger; bus 40 kg with 20 passengers over the same distance. Calculate emissions per passenger and give a comparison limitation.

modelAnswer.bm: Kereta 12 kg; bas 2 kg seorang. Keputusan bergantung pada muatan, laluan dan data penggunaan tenaga sebenar.
modelAnswer.en: Car: 12 kg; bus: 2 kg per passenger. Results depend on occupancy, routes and actual energy-use data.

prompt.bm: Data rekaan gas pada 0, 10, 20, 30 s ialah 0, 24, 40, 48 cm³. Kira kadar bagi 0–10 s dan 20–30 s, kemudian jelaskan perbezaan.
prompt.en: Fictional gas volumes at 0, 10, 20, 30 s are 0, 24, 40, 48 cm³. Calculate rates for 0–10 s and 20–30 s, then explain the difference.

modelAnswer.bm: 2.4 dan 0.8 cm³ s⁻¹. Kadar menurun apabila bahan tindak balas digunakan dan perlanggaran berkesan berkurang.
modelAnswer.en: 2.4 and 0.8 cm³ s⁻¹. Rate decreases as reactants are used up and effective collisions become less frequent.

prompt.bm: Dua sebatian mempunyai formula C₂H₆ dan C₂H₄. Namakan siri homolognya, kenal pasti sebatian tak tepu dan ramalkan pemerhatian air bromin bagi sebatian tak tepu. Analisis sahaja.
prompt.en: Two compounds have formulas C₂H₆ and C₂H₄. Name their homologous series, identify the unsaturated compound and predict its bromine-water observation. Analysis only.

modelAnswer.bm: C₂H₆ alkana; C₂H₄ alkena dan tak tepu; air bromin dinyahwarnakan melalui penambahan pada ikatan C=C.
modelAnswer.en: C₂H₆ is an alkane; C₂H₄ is an alkene and unsaturated; bromine water is decolourised by addition across C=C.

prompt.bm: Dalam model elektrolisis CuCl₂ lebur, ion hadir ialah Cu²⁺ dan Cl⁻. Nyatakan arah pergerakan ion, produk katod dan produk anod. Tugasan teori sahaja.
prompt.en: In a model of molten CuCl₂ electrolysis, the ions are Cu²⁺ and Cl⁻. State their directions of movement, the cathode product and the anode product. Theory only.

modelAnswer.bm: Cu²⁺ ke katod menghasilkan kuprum; Cl⁻ ke anod menghasilkan klorin.
modelAnswer.en: Cu²⁺ moves to the cathode and produces copper; Cl⁻ moves to the anode and produces chlorine.

prompt.bm: Objek pada jarak melebihi 2f dilihat melalui kanta cembung dan imejnya dapat ditangkap pada skrin. Nyatakan dua sifat imej dan jelaskan bukti bahawa imej itu nyata.
prompt.en: An object farther than 2f is viewed through a convex lens and its image can be captured on a screen. State two image properties and explain the evidence that it is real.

modelAnswer.bm: Imej songsang dan lebih kecil; boleh diproyeksikan pada skrin kerana sinar cahaya benar-benar bertemu.
modelAnswer.en: The image is inverted and smaller; it can be projected on a screen because light rays actually meet.

prompt.bm: Sistem hidraulik ideal mempunyai luas masukan 2 cm² dan keluaran 10 cm². Jika daya masukan 30 N, kira daya keluaran. Jelaskan mengapa ini tidak menghasilkan tenaga percuma.
prompt.en: An ideal hydraulic system has input area 2 cm² and output area 10 cm². With input force 30 N, calculate output force. Explain why this does not create free energy.

modelAnswer.bm: Daya keluaran 150 N; omboh besar bergerak jarak lebih kecil, maka kerja ideal kekal sama.
modelAnswer.en: Output force is 150 N; the larger piston moves a smaller distance, so ideal work remains equal.

prompt.bm: Sebuah agensi mahu memantau banjir pada kawasan luas setiap beberapa hari. Cadangkan jenis aplikasi satelit, satu maklumat yang diperoleh dan satu had data.
prompt.en: An agency wants to monitor flooding over a large area every few days. Suggest a satellite application, one piece of information obtained and one data limitation.

modelAnswer.bm: Penderiaan jauh; peta kawasan ditenggelami air; had termasuk resolusi, sela masa imej atau awan untuk imej optik.
modelAnswer.en: Remote sensing; maps of inundated areas; limits include resolution, image intervals or cloud for optical images.

title.zh: 中四物理

description.bm: Kuantiti fizik, unit dan penyiasatan saintifik.
description.en: Physical quantities, units and scientific investigations.

description.bm: Kinematik, momentum, impuls dan hukum Newton.
description.en: Kinematics, momentum, impulse and Newton’s laws.

description.bm: Daya graviti, orbit dan hukum Kepler.
description.en: Gravitational force, orbits and Kepler’s laws.

description.bm: Muatan haba, haba pendam dan hukum gas.
description.en: Heat capacity, latent heat and gas laws.

description.bm: Jenis, ciri, pembiasan, interferens dan bunyi.
description.en: Types, properties, refraction, interference and sound.

description.bm: Pembiasan, pantulan dalam penuh, kanta dan alat optik.
description.en: Refraction, total internal reflection, lenses and optical instruments.

stem.bm: Unit SI bagi ketumpatan ialah apa?
stem.en: What is the SI unit of density?

explanation.bm: Ketumpatan = jisim/isi padu.
explanation.en: Density = mass/volume.

stem.bm: Graf F melawan x mempunyai titik (0.02 m, 1 N) dan (0.06 m, 3 N). Berapakah kecerunannya?
stem.en: A graph of F against x has points (0.02 m, 1 N) and (0.06 m, 3 N). What is its gradient?

stem.bm: Bacaan alat sama berulang kali tetapi menyimpang daripada nilai piawai. Apakah masalah yang paling mungkin?
stem.en: An instrument repeatedly gives similar readings that differ from a standard value. Which problem is most likely?

options.bm: Alat bebas ralat kerana ulangan rapat
options.en: An error-free instrument because repeats are close

explanation.bm: Kejituan rendah dengan bacaan konsisten mencadangkan bias sistematik.
explanation.en: Low accuracy with consistent readings suggests systematic bias.

stem.bm: Troli 2 kg bergerak 3 m s⁻¹ lalu bergabung dengan troli 1 kg pegun. Tanpa daya luar mendatar, berapakah halaju bersama?
stem.en: A 2 kg trolley moving at 3 m s⁻¹ joins a stationary 1 kg trolley. With no external horizontal force, what is their common velocity?

explanation.bm: Momentum awal 6 kg m s⁻¹; jumlah jisim 3 kg.
explanation.en: Initial momentum is 6 kg m s⁻¹; total mass is 3 kg.

stem.bm: Beg udara memanjangkan masa menghentikan penumpang untuk perubahan momentum sama. Apakah kesannya?
stem.en: An airbag lengthens the stopping time for the same momentum change. What is its effect?

options.bm: Daya purata meningkat kerana masa lebih panjang
options.en: Average force increases because time is longer

options.bm: Momentum awal meningkat tanpa daya sebelum perlanggaran
options.en: Initial momentum increases without a pre-collision force

options.bm: Impuls berkurang walaupun perubahan momentum sama
options.en: Impulse decreases despite equal momentum change

explanation.bm: F purata = perubahan momentum/masa.
explanation.en: Average F = momentum change/time.

stem.bm: Objek 4 kg menerima daya paduan 12 N. Berapakah pecutannya?
stem.en: A 4 kg object experiences a 12 N resultant force. What is its acceleration?

stem.bm: Jarak antara pusat dua jisim digandakan. Jisim kekal. Bagaimanakah daya graviti berubah?
stem.en: The centre-to-centre distance between two masses doubles while masses stay fixed. How does gravitational force change?

explanation.bm: F berkadar songsang dengan kuasa dua jarak.
explanation.en: F is inversely proportional to distance squared.

stem.bm: Apakah yang membekalkan daya memusat kepada satelit dalam orbit bulat?
stem.en: What supplies the centripetal force for a satellite in a circular orbit?

options.en: A centripetal force separate from gravity

options.bm: Daya tujahan berterusan diperlukan dalam orbit ideal
options.en: Continuous thrust is required in an ideal orbit

options.bm: Daya graviti sifar kerana satelit jatuh bebas
options.en: Zero gravity because the satellite is in free fall

explanation.bm: Graviti menarik ke pusat Bumi dan mengubah arah halaju.
explanation.en: Gravity acts toward Earth’s centre and changes velocity direction.

stem.bm: Dua planet mengorbit bintang sama. Jejari orbit bulat B ialah 4 kali A. Berapakah nisbah tempoh T_B/T_A?
stem.en: Two planets orbit the same star. B’s circular orbital radius is 4 times A’s. What is T_B/T_A?

explanation.bm: T² berkadar dengan r³; nisbah tempoh = √(4³) = 8.
explanation.en: T² is proportional to r³; period ratio = √(4³) = 8.

stem.bm: Air 0.50 kg dipanaskan 10°C. Jika c = 4200 J kg⁻¹ °C⁻¹, berapakah haba diserap?
stem.en: 0.50 kg of water is heated by 10°C. If c = 4200 J kg⁻¹ °C⁻¹, how much heat is absorbed?

stem.bm: Semasa ais tulen melebur pada tekanan tetap, mengapa suhu kekal?
stem.en: While pure ice melts at constant pressure, why does its temperature remain constant?

options.en: No heat is absorbed during melting

options.bm: Semua haba menambah tenaga kinetik purata
options.en: All heat raises mean kinetic energy

options.bm: Tenaga digunakan untuk perubahan susunan/ikatan antara zarah
Haba hanya menaikkan suhu termometer, bukan ais
options.en: Heat only raises thermometer temperature, not ice temperature

explanation.bm: Haba pendam mengubah keadaan tanpa kenaikan suhu.
explanation.en: Latent heat changes state without a temperature increase.

stem.bm: Sampel gas tertutup pada isi padu tetap dipanaskan daripada 300 K kepada 450 K. Tekanan awal 100 kPa. Berapakah tekanan akhir?
stem.en: A sealed gas sample at fixed volume is heated from 300 K to 450 K. Initial pressure is 100 kPa. What is final pressure?

explanation.bm: P/T tetap untuk jumlah gas dan isi padu tetap.
explanation.en: P/T is constant for a fixed amount and volume of gas.

stem.bm: Gelombang berfrekuensi 5 Hz mempunyai panjang gelombang 0.8 m. Berapakah lajunya?
stem.en: A 5 Hz wave has wavelength 0.8 m. What is its speed?

stem.bm: Gelombang air memasuki kawasan lebih cetek dan menjadi lebih perlahan. Apakah yang kekal?
stem.en: Water waves enter a shallower region and slow down. What remains unchanged?

explanation.bm: Frekuensi ditetapkan oleh sumber; panjang gelombang berkurang.
explanation.en: Frequency is set by the source; wavelength decreases.

stem.bm: Dua gelombang koheren sama amplitud bertemu dengan beza fasa 180°. Apakah hasil ideal?
stem.en: Two coherent waves of equal amplitude meet with a 180° phase difference. What is the ideal result?

options.bm: Amplitud sama kerana gelombang tidak bertindih
options.en: Unchanged amplitude because waves do not overlap
Zero frequency because the source stops

explanation.bm: Puncak dan lembangan sama magnitud saling membatalkan.
explanation.en: Equal-magnitude crests and troughs cancel.

stem.bm: Cahaya bergerak 2.0 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹ dalam kaca. Ambil c = 3.0 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹. Berapakah indeks biasan?
stem.en: Light travels at 2.0 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹ in glass. Take c = 3.0 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹. What is refractive index?

explanation.bm: n = c/v.
explanation.en: n = c/v.

stem.bm: Syarat pantulan dalam penuh ialah apa?
stem.en: What are the conditions for total internal reflection?

options.bm: Dua medium berindeks biasan sama dengan sudut tuju besar
options.en: Equal-index media with a large incidence angle

options.bm: Dari medium indeks lebih tinggi ke lebih rendah dan sudut tuju melebihi sudut genting
options.en: From higher to lower refractive index, with incidence above the critical angle

options.bm: Dari indeks biasan tinggi ke rendah dengan sudut tuju kurang daripada sudut genting
options.en: From higher to lower refractive index with incidence below the critical angle

options.bm: Dari indeks biasan rendah ke tinggi dengan sudut tuju melebihi sudut genting
options.en: From lower to higher refractive index with incidence above the critical angle

explanation.bm: Kedua-dua syarat diperlukan.
explanation.en: Both conditions are required.

stem.bm: Kanta cembung mempunyai f = 10 cm dan u = 30 cm. Berapakah jarak imej nyata?
stem.en: A convex lens has f = 10 cm and u = 30 cm. What is the real image distance?

prompt.bm: Masa lima ayunan ialah 7.2, 7.4 dan 7.3 s. Kira purata masa dan tempoh satu ayunan. Terangkan sebab mengukur beberapa ayunan.
prompt.en: Times for five oscillations are 7.2, 7.4 and 7.3 s. Calculate mean time and period of one oscillation. Explain why several oscillations are timed.

modelAnswer.bm: Purata 7.3 s; tempoh 1.46 s; masa lebih panjang mengurangkan pecahan ralat masa tindak balas.
modelAnswer.en: Mean 7.3 s; period 1.46 s; a longer total time reduces the relative effect of reaction-time error.

prompt.bm: Bola 0.20 kg bergerak 10 m s⁻¹ ke kanan dan melantun 6 m s⁻¹ ke kiri dalam 0.04 s. Ambil kanan positif. Kira perubahan momentum dan daya purata serta arah daya.
prompt.en: A 0.20 kg ball moves at 10 m s⁻¹ right and rebounds at 6 m s⁻¹ left in 0.04 s. Take right as positive. Calculate momentum change and average force, including direction.

modelAnswer.en: Δp = 0.20(−6 − 10) = −3.2 kg m s⁻¹; F = −80 N, to the left.

prompt.bm: Daya antara dua jisim ialah F pada jarak r. Jika satu jisim digandakan dan jarak menjadi 3r, nyatakan daya baharu dalam sebutan F. Jelaskan dua faktor perubahan.
prompt.en: The force between two masses is F at separation r. If one mass doubles and separation becomes 3r, express the new force in terms of F. Explain both factors.

modelAnswer.bm: Jisim memberi faktor 2; jarak memberi faktor 1/9; daya baharu 2F/9.
modelAnswer.en: Mass gives a factor 2; distance gives a factor 1/9; new force is 2F/9.

prompt.bm: Logam 0.20 kg menyerap 900 J dan suhunya meningkat 15°C. Abaikan kehilangan haba. Kira muatan haba tentu dan nyatakan kesan kehilangan haba jika 900 J ialah tenaga pembekal.
prompt.en: A 0.20 kg metal absorbs 900 J and warms by 15°C. Ignore heat loss. Calculate specific heat capacity and state the effect of heat loss if 900 J is the energy supplied.

modelAnswer.bm: c = 900/(0.20 × 15) = 300 J kg⁻¹ °C⁻¹. Menggunakan semua tenaga pembekal ketika sebahagian hilang akan melebihanggarkan c.
modelAnswer.en: c = 900/(0.20 × 15) = 300 J kg⁻¹ °C⁻¹. Using all supplied energy when some is lost overestimates c.

prompt.bm: Gema diterima 0.60 s selepas bunyi dikeluarkan. Laju bunyi 340 m s⁻¹. Kira jarak pemantul dan jelaskan faktor 2 dalam pengiraan.
prompt.en: An echo arrives 0.60 s after a sound is emitted. Sound speed is 340 m s⁻¹. Calculate reflector distance and explain the factor 2.

modelAnswer.bm: Jarak pergi-balik 204 m; jarak pemantul 102 m kerana bunyi pergi dan kembali.
modelAnswer.en: Round-trip distance is 204 m; reflector distance is 102 m because sound travels out and back.

prompt.bm: Kanta cembung f = 12 cm membentuk imej objek pada u = 24 cm. Kira v dan pembesaran linear; nyatakan orientasi imej.
prompt.en: A convex lens of f = 12 cm images an object at u = 24 cm. Calculate v and linear magnification; state image orientation.

modelAnswer.bm: 1/v = 1/12 − 1/24; v = 24 cm; |m| = v/u = 1; imej songsang.
modelAnswer.en: 1/v = 1/12 − 1/24; v = 24 cm; |m| = v/u = 1; image inverted.

title.zh: 中五物理

description.bm: Keseimbangan daya, momen dan keanjalan.
description.en: Force equilibrium, moments and elasticity.

description.bm: Tekanan cecair, gas, Pascal, Archimedes dan Bernoulli.
description.en: Liquid and gas pressure, Pascal, Archimedes and Bernoulli.

description.bm: Medan, beza keupayaan, rintangan, tenaga dan d.g.e.
description.en: Fields, potential difference, resistance, energy and e.m.f.

description.bm: Daya magnet, aruhan dan transformer.
description.en: Magnetic forces, induction and transformers.

description.bm: Diod, transistor dan litar kawalan.
description.en: Diodes, transistors and control circuits.

description.bm: Radioaktiviti, separuh hayat dan tenaga nuklear.
description.en: Radioactivity, half-life and nuclear energy.

description.bm: Foton, kuanta dan kesan fotoelektrik.
description.en: Photons, quanta and the photoelectric effect.

stem.bm: Daya 6 N ke timur dan 8 N ke utara bertindak pada objek. Magnitud daya paduan ialah berapa?
stem.en: Forces of 6 N east and 8 N north act on an object. What is the resultant magnitude?

explanation.bm: Daya serenjang: √(6² + 8²) = 10 N.
explanation.en: Perpendicular forces: √(6² + 8²) = 10 N.

stem.bm: Spring dengan pemalar 200 N m⁻¹ memanjang 0.03 m dalam had kenyal. Berapakah daya?
stem.en: A spring of constant 200 N m⁻¹ extends 0.03 m within its elastic limit. What is the force?

explanation.bm: F = kx.
explanation.en: F = kx.

stem.bm: Untuk objek tegar berada dalam keseimbangan statik, syarat yang mana diperlukan?
stem.en: For a rigid body to be in static equilibrium, which conditions are needed?

options.bm: Daya paduan sifar dan momen paduan sifar
options.en: Zero resultant force and zero resultant moment
Every individual force must be zero

explanation.bm: Keseimbangan translasi dan putaran kedua-duanya diperlukan.
explanation.en: Both translational and rotational equilibrium are required.

stem.bm: Air berkepadatan 1000 kg m⁻³ sedalam 2 m. Ambil g = 10 m s⁻². Berapakah tekanan tolok?
stem.en: Water of density 1000 kg m⁻³ is 2 m deep. Take g = 10 m s⁻². What is gauge pressure?

explanation.bm: p = ρgh; tekanan tolok tidak termasuk atmosfera.
explanation.en: p = ρgh; gauge pressure excludes atmospheric pressure.

stem.bm: Objek menggantikan 0.004 m³ air. Ambil ρ = 1000 kg m⁻³ dan g = 10 m s⁻². Berapakah daya apungan?
stem.en: An object displaces 0.004 m³ of water. Take ρ = 1000 kg m⁻³ and g = 10 m s⁻². What is the buoyant force?

explanation.bm: Daya apungan = berat air diganti = ρVg.
explanation.en: Buoyant force = weight of displaced water = ρVg.

stem.bm: Objek terapung pegun di air. Apakah hubungan daya apungan dengan beratnya?
stem.en: An object floats at rest in water. How does buoyancy compare with its weight?

options.bm: Sifar kerana objek tidak tenggelam sepenuhnya
options.en: Zero because the object is not fully submerged

options.bm: Lebih besar kerana objek berada di permukaan
options.en: Greater because the object is at the surface

options.bm: Lebih kecil kerana sebahagian objek di udara
options.en: Smaller because some of the object is in air

explanation.bm: Keseimbangan menegak memberikan daya paduan sifar.
explanation.en: Vertical equilibrium gives zero resultant force.

stem.bm: Perintang 6 Ω dan 3 Ω disambung selari. Berapakah rintangan setara?
stem.en: 6 Ω and 3 Ω resistors are connected in parallel. What is equivalent resistance?

stem.bm: Sel berd.g.e. 12 V dan rintangan dalam 1 Ω membekalkan arus 2 A. Berapakah voltan terminal?
stem.en: A cell of e.m.f. 12 V and internal resistance 1 Ω supplies 2 A. What is terminal voltage?

stem.bm: Pemanas 2 kW digunakan 15 minit. Berapakah tenaga elektrik?
stem.en: A 2 kW heater runs for 15 minutes. What is the electrical energy?

explanation.bm: 15 minit = 0.25 jam; E = Pt.

prompt.bm: Daya 20 N bertindak dengan lengan momen serenjang 0.30 m dari pangsi. Daya bertentangan mempunyai lengan momen serenjang 0.50 m. Hitung daya kedua untuk keseimbangan momen. Abaikan berat rod.

modelAnswer.en: First moment is 6 N m; F × 0.50 = 6; F = 12 N.

prompt.bm: Voltan selepas penerus naik turun antara 0 dan 8 V. Selepas kapasitor ditambah, ia naik turun antara 6 dan 8 V. Nyatakan perubahan riak, terangkan peranan kapasitor dan sebab keluaran belum benar-benar malar.

modelAnswer.en: Ripple falls from 8 V to 2 V; the capacitor stores charge and supplies it between peaks; it still discharges through the load.

modelAnswer.en: Three half-lives: 64/8 = 8 mg; decay products and other material remain in the container.

prompt.bm: Logam mempunyai fungsi kerja 2.0 eV. Bandingkan cahaya A dengan foton 1.5 eV dan B dengan foton 3.5 eV. Nyatakan sama ada elektron foto dikeluarkan dan tenaga kinetik maksimum jika ada.

modelAnswer.bm: A: tiada kerana 1.5 < 2.0. B: ada dengan K maks = 1.5 eV.
modelAnswer.en: A: none because 1.5 < 2.0. B: emitted with maximum K = 1.5 eV.

prompt.bm: Bandingkan pengaliran elektrik NaCl pepejal dan lebur dengan kuprum pepejal. Jelaskan pembawa cas dan pergerakannya.

modelAnswer.bm: NaCl pepejal tidak mengalir kerana ion terikat; lebur mengalir melalui ion bergerak; kuprum pepejal mengalir melalui elektron dinyahsetempat.
modelAnswer.en: Solid NaCl does not conduct because ions are fixed; molten NaCl conducts through mobile ions; solid copper conducts through delocalised electrons.

prompt.bm: Tulis persamaan ion peneutralan asid kuat dengan alkali kuat. Jika 0.010 mol H⁺ dicampur dengan 0.006 mol OH⁻, tentukan ion berlebihan dan mol yang berbaki.
prompt.en: Write the ionic equation for strong-acid/strong-alkali neutralisation. If 0.010 mol H⁺ mixes with 0.006 mol OH⁻, identify the excess ion and remaining amount.

modelAnswer.bm: H⁺ + OH⁻ → H₂O; H⁺ berlebihan; baki 0.004 mol.
modelAnswer.en: H⁺ + OH⁻ → H₂O; H⁺ is in excess; 0.004 mol remains.

prompt.bm: Tindak balas A dan B menghasilkan 60 cm³ gas akhir yang sama. A selesai dalam 30 s, B 60 s. Bandingkan kadar purata dan jelaskan mengapa isi padu akhir tidak membuktikan kadar sama.
prompt.en: Reactions A and B both produce a final 60 cm³ of gas. A finishes in 30 s, B in 60 s. Compare average rates and explain why equal final volume does not imply equal rate.

modelAnswer.bm: A 2 cm³ s⁻¹; B 1 cm³ s⁻¹; jumlah produk sama tetapi masa penghasilan berbeza.
modelAnswer.en: A: 2 cm³ s⁻¹; B: 1 cm³ s⁻¹; equal product quantities are formed over different times.

prompt.bm: Jambatan memerlukan komponen yang tahan mampatan dan tegangan. Terangkan kelebihan gabungan konkrit dengan keluli dan satu faktor ketahanan yang perlu dipantau.
prompt.en: A bridge needs components resisting compression and tension. Explain the benefit of combining concrete and steel and one durability factor to monitor.

modelAnswer.bm: Konkrit kuat dalam mampatan; keluli menahan tegangan; gabungan saling melengkapi. Pantau kakisan keluli/retakan konkrit.
modelAnswer.en: Concrete is strong in compression; steel resists tension; the combination is complementary. Monitor steel corrosion/concrete cracking.

prompt.bm: Anak benih rawatan A bertambah tinggi 3, 4, 5 cm; rawatan B 6, 7, 8 cm. Kira purata setiap rawatan, nyatakan kesimpulan yang disokong dan satu kawalan tambahan.
prompt.en: Seedlings in treatment A gain 3, 4, 5 cm; in B, 6, 7, 8 cm. Calculate each mean, state a supported conclusion and one additional control.

modelAnswer.bm: A 4 cm, B 7 cm; dalam kajian ini B mempunyai purata pertumbuhan lebih besar; kawal spesies, umur, air atau tempoh.
modelAnswer.en: A: 4 cm, B: 7 cm; B has greater mean growth in this investigation; control species, age, water or duration.

prompt.bm: Bandingkan sel tumbuhan fotosintetik dengan sel haiwan dari segi dinding sel, kloroplas dan vakuol besar. Hubungkan satu struktur dengan fungsi.
prompt.en: Compare a photosynthetic plant cell with an animal cell for a cell wall, chloroplasts and a large vacuole. Link one structure to a function.

modelAnswer.bm: Sel tumbuhan mempunyai dinding sel, kloroplas dan vakuol pusat besar; sel haiwan tiada dinding sel/kloroplas dan tiada vakuol pusat besar. Kloroplas menjalankan fotosintesis.
modelAnswer.en: The plant cell has a cell wall, chloroplasts and a large central vacuole; the animal cell lacks a cell wall/chloroplasts and a large central vacuole. Chloroplasts perform photosynthesis.

prompt.bm: Jisim kentang asal 5.0 g berubah menjadi 5.5 g dalam A dan 4.4 g dalam B. Kira perubahan peratus dan tentukan arah pergerakan air bersih.
prompt.en: A potato sample’s initial mass is 5.0 g; it becomes 5.5 g in A and 4.4 g in B. Calculate percentage changes and determine net water movement.

modelAnswer.bm: A +10%, air masuk; B −12%, air keluar secara osmosis.
modelAnswer.en: A: +10%, water enters; B: −12%, water leaves by osmosis.

prompt.bm: Padankan kanji, protein dan trigliserida dengan unit pembinanya. Nyatakan satu fungsi setiap bahan dalam organisma.
prompt.en: Match starch, protein and triglyceride to their building units. State one function of each in an organism.

modelAnswer.bm: Kanji: glukosa, simpanan tenaga tumbuhan; protein: asid amino, enzim/struktur; trigliserida: gliserol dan asid lemak, simpanan tenaga.
modelAnswer.en: Starch: glucose, plant energy storage; protein: amino acids, enzymes/structure; triglyceride: glycerol and fatty acids, energy storage.

prompt.bm: Data aktiviti enzim pada 10, 30, 40, 70°C ialah 2, 8, 12, 0 unit. Kenal pasti suhu optimum yang diuji, jelaskan kadar rendah pada 10°C dan sifar pada 70°C.
prompt.en: Enzyme activities at 10, 30, 40, 70°C are 2, 8, 12, 0 units. Identify the tested optimum, explain the low rate at 10°C and zero at 70°C.

modelAnswer.bm: 40°C tertinggi antara suhu diuji; 10°C mengurangkan tenaga kinetik/perlanggaran; 70°C boleh menyahasli enzim. Optimum tepat memerlukan lebih banyak suhu diuji.
modelAnswer.en: 40°C is highest among tested temperatures; 10°C lowers kinetic energy/collisions; 70°C can denature the enzyme. An exact optimum needs more temperatures.

prompt.bm: Organisma mempunyai 2n = 12. Bandingkan mitosis dan meiosis dari segi bilangan sel anak, bilangan kromosom dan keserupaan genetik.
prompt.en: An organism has 2n = 12. Compare mitosis and meiosis for daughter-cell number, chromosome number and genetic similarity.

modelAnswer.bm: Mitosis: 2 sel dengan 12 kromosom, biasanya sama genetik; meiosis: 4 sel dengan 6 kromosom, berbeza genetik.
modelAnswer.en: Mitosis: 2 cells with 12 chromosomes, usually genetically identical; meiosis: 4 cells with 6 chromosomes, genetically varied.

prompt.bm: Bandingkan respirasi aerob dengan fermentasi yis dari segi keperluan oksigen, produk dan hasil ATP relatif.
prompt.en: Compare aerobic respiration with yeast fermentation for oxygen requirement, products and relative ATP yield.

modelAnswer.bm: Aerob menggunakan O₂, menghasilkan CO₂ dan air serta lebih banyak ATP; fermentasi yis tanpa O₂, menghasilkan etanol dan CO₂ serta kurang ATP.
modelAnswer.en: Aerobic respiration uses O₂, produces CO₂ and water and more ATP; yeast fermentation proceeds without O₂, produces ethanol and CO₂ and less ATP.

prompt.bm: Terangkan bagaimana alveolus mempunyai luas permukaan besar, dinding nipis dan bekalan darah yang banyak. Kaitkan setiap ciri dengan pertukaran gas.
prompt.en: Explain the significance of alveoli having a large surface area, thin walls and abundant blood supply. Link each feature to gas exchange.

modelAnswer.bm: Luas besar membolehkan lebih banyak resapan; dinding nipis memendekkan jarak; aliran darah mengekalkan kecerunan gas.
modelAnswer.en: Large area permits more diffusion; thin walls shorten distance; blood flow maintains gas gradients.

prompt.bm: Bandingkan pencernaan mekanik dan kimia. Gunakan kunyahan dan tindakan amilase sebagai contoh, lalu jelaskan bagaimana kunyahan membantu enzim.
prompt.en: Compare mechanical and chemical digestion. Use chewing and amylase as examples, and explain how chewing helps enzymes.

modelAnswer.bm: Kunyahan memecahkan makanan secara fizikal; amilase menghidrolisis kanji; cebisan kecil menambah luas permukaan untuk enzim.
modelAnswer.en: Chewing physically breaks food apart; amylase hydrolyses starch; smaller pieces increase enzyme-accessible surface area.

prompt.bm: Jejaki darah dari ventrikel kanan melalui peparu hingga ventrikel kiri. Nyatakan tempat pertukaran gas dan fungsi injap atrioventrikel.
prompt.en: Trace blood from the right ventricle through the lungs to the left ventricle. State the gas-exchange location and atrioventricular valve function.

modelAnswer.bm: Ventrikel kanan → arteri pulmonari → kapilari peparu → vena pulmonari → atrium kiri → ventrikel kiri; pertukaran gas di kapilari alveolus; injap menghalang aliran songsang ke atrium.
modelAnswer.en: Right ventricle → pulmonary artery → lung capillaries → pulmonary vein → left atrium → left ventricle; gas exchange at alveolar capillaries; valves prevent backflow to atria.

prompt.bm: Bandingkan penerimaan antibodi siap terbentuk dengan pembentukan antibodi selepas pendedahan antigen dari segi jenis keimunan, masa tindak balas dan memori.
prompt.en: Compare receiving preformed antibodies with making antibodies after antigen exposure for immunity type, response time and memory.

modelAnswer.bm: Antibodi luar: pasif, perlindungan segera tetapi sementara, tiada memori sendiri bagi respons itu. Respons sendiri: aktif, mengambil masa, boleh membentuk sel memori.
modelAnswer.en: External antibodies: passive, immediate but temporary protection, no own memory from that response. Own response: active, takes time, can form memory cells.

prompt.bm: Untuk refleks penarikan tangan, senaraikan reseptor, neuron deria, pusat koordinasi, neuron motor dan efektor mengikut urutan. Terangkan kepentingan respons pantas.
prompt.en: For a hand-withdrawal reflex, list the receptor, sensory neurone, coordination centre, motor neurone and effector in order. Explain the importance of a rapid response.

modelAnswer.bm: Reseptor kulit → neuron deria → saraf tunjang → neuron motor → otot; respons pantas mengurangkan pendedahan kepada rangsangan berbahaya.
modelAnswer.en: Skin receptor → sensory neurone → spinal cord → motor neurone → muscle; rapid response reduces exposure to a harmful stimulus.

prompt.bm: Data rekaan: hari A urin 1.5 L yang cair; hari B 0.7 L yang lebih pekat selepas kurang pengambilan air. Jelaskan respons ADH, penyerapan semula air dan kaitan dengan maklum balas negatif.
prompt.en: Fictional data: on day A, 1.5 L dilute urine; on day B, 0.7 L more concentrated urine after reduced water intake. Explain ADH, water reabsorption and negative feedback.

modelAnswer.bm: Kurang air merangsang peningkatan ADH; lebih banyak air diserap semula dan urin berkurang; pemulihan keseimbangan air mengurangkan rangsangan asal.
modelAnswer.en: Reduced water promotes more ADH; more water is reabsorbed and urine decreases; restored water balance reduces the original stimulus.

prompt.bm: Terangkan mengapa pasangan otot diperlukan untuk membengkok dan meluruskan siku. Namakan otot yang mengecut bagi setiap gerakan dan jelaskan peranan tendon.
prompt.en: Explain why a muscle pair is needed to bend and straighten the elbow. Name the contracting muscle for each movement and explain tendons.

modelAnswer.bm: Otot hanya menarik; biseps mengecut untuk membengkok, triseps untuk melurus; tendon memindahkan tarikan otot ke tulang.
modelAnswer.en: Muscles only pull; biceps contracts to bend, triceps to extend; tendons transfer muscle pull to bone.

prompt.bm: Jisim segar anak benih meningkat 2 g tetapi jisim kering sampel sepadan meningkat 0.3 g. Jelaskan sebab perbezaan dan satu batas penggunaan jisim kering.
prompt.en: Fresh seedling mass increases 2 g but dry mass of matched samples rises 0.3 g. Explain the difference and one limitation of dry mass.

modelAnswer.bm: Sebahagian kenaikan jisim segar ialah air; jisim kering menilai pertambahan bahan biomas dengan kurang gangguan air; pengeringan memusnahkan sampel dan memerlukan sampel sepadan.
modelAnswer.en: Some fresh-mass gain is water; dry mass assesses biomass with less water interference; drying destroys samples and requires matched samples.

prompt.bm: Bandingkan pertumbuhan primer dengan sekunder dari segi meristem terlibat dan perubahan saiz. Nyatakan tisu yang dihasilkan kambium vaskular.
prompt.en: Compare primary and secondary growth for the meristems involved and size changes. State tissues produced by vascular cambium.

modelAnswer.bm: Primer: meristem apeks, panjang bertambah; sekunder: meristem lateral/kambium, diameter bertambah; kambium menghasilkan xilem sekunder ke dalam dan floem ke luar.
modelAnswer.en: Primary: apical meristem, increased length; secondary: lateral meristem/cambium, increased diameter; cambium produces secondary xylem inward and phloem outward.

prompt.bm: Kadar CO₂ bersih bagi tumbuhan: cahaya rendah +3 unit keluar; sederhana 0; tinggi 5 unit masuk. Kenal pasti titik pampasan dan jelaskan ketiga-tiga keadaan.
prompt.en: A plant’s net CO₂ rate: low light, 3 units out; medium, 0; high, 5 units in. Identify the compensation point and explain all three conditions.

modelAnswer.bm: Cahaya sederhana ialah pampasan; rendah: respirasi melebihi fotosintesis; sederhana sama; tinggi fotosintesis melebihi respirasi.
modelAnswer.en: Medium light is the compensation point; low: respiration exceeds photosynthesis; medium: equal; high: photosynthesis exceeds respiration.

prompt.bm: Dua kumpulan tumbuhan sama diberi larutan mineral lengkap atau tanpa nitrat. Selepas tiga minggu kumpulan tanpa nitrat terbantut. Cadangkan sebab, satu pemboleh ubah dikawal dan sebab replikasi diperlukan.
prompt.en: Two equivalent plant groups receive complete mineral solution or a solution without nitrate. After three weeks, the nitrate-free group is stunted. Suggest a reason, one control and why replication is needed.

modelAnswer.bm: Kurang nitrogen mengehadkan protein dan pertumbuhan; kawal cahaya/spesies/umur; replikasi menilai variasi individu dan kebolehpercayaan.
modelAnswer.en: Limited nitrogen restricts protein synthesis and growth; control light/species/age; replication assesses individual variation and reliability.

prompt.bm: Gelembung potometer bergerak 12 mm dalam 3 minit sebelum kipas dan 24 mm dalam 3 minit dengan kipas. Kira kadar relatif dan terangkan kesan aliran udara serta satu batas kaedah.
prompt.en: A potometer bubble moves 12 mm in 3 minutes without a fan and 24 mm in 3 minutes with a fan. Calculate relative rates, explain airflow and state one method limitation.

modelAnswer.bm: 4 dan 8 mm min⁻¹, dua kali; aliran udara mengurangkan wap air di sekitar daun; penyerapan air hanya anggaran transpirasi.
modelAnswer.en: 4 and 8 mm min⁻¹, a twofold change; airflow reduces water vapour near leaves; uptake only estimates transpiration.

prompt.bm: Pucuk diberi cahaya dari kiri. Ramalkan sisi dengan pemanjangan lebih besar, arah pembengkokan dan peranan auksin.

modelAnswer.bm: Sisi kanan terlindung memanjang lebih; pucuk membengkok ke kiri; auksin terkumpul di sisi terlindung dan menggalakkan pemanjangan pucuk.
modelAnswer.en: The shaded right side elongates more; the shoot bends left; auxin accumulates on the shaded side and promotes shoot elongation.

prompt.bm: Terangkan dua percantuman dalam persenyawaan ganda dua dan nyatakan ploidi produk serta fungsi endosperma.
prompt.en: Explain both fusions in double fertilisation, state product ploidy and the endosperm function.

modelAnswer.bm: Gamet jantan + ovum → zigot 2n; gamet jantan + dua nukleus kutub → endosperma 3n; endosperma membekalkan nutrien kepada embrio.
modelAnswer.en: Male gamete + egg → 2n zygote; male gamete + two polar nuclei → 3n endosperm; endosperm supplies nutrients to the embryo.

prompt.bm: Padankan kutikel tebal, ruang udara besar dan pneumatofor dengan habitat kering, air dan tanah bakau bertakung. Terangkan fungsi setiap satu.
prompt.en: Match thick cuticles, large air spaces and pneumatophores with dry, aquatic and waterlogged mangrove habitats. Explain each function.

modelAnswer.bm: Kering: kutikel mengurangkan kehilangan air; air: ruang udara membantu apungan/gas; bakau: pneumatofor membantu oksigen memasuki akar.
modelAnswer.en: Dry: cuticle reduces water loss; aquatic: air spaces aid buoyancy/gases; mangrove: pneumatophores help oxygen reach roots.

prompt.bm: Dua haiwan dinamakan Panthera leo dan Panthera tigris. Kenal pasti kategori yang sama dan berbeza, lalu jelaskan dua peraturan penulisan nama binomial.
prompt.en: Two animals are named Panthera leo and Panthera tigris. Identify the shared and differing categories, then explain two binomial-writing rules.

modelAnswer.bm: Genus sama, spesies berbeza; nama genus bermula huruf besar, epitet spesies huruf kecil; nama dicondongkan atau digaris berasingan jika tulisan tangan.
modelAnswer.en: Same genus, different species; genus starts with a capital, the specific epithet is lowercase; italicise names or underline each word separately when handwritten.

prompt.bm: Enam kuadrat 0.5 m² merekod 3, 0, 4, 2, 0, 3 tumbuhan spesies X. Kira kepadatan purata dan kekerapan peratus; jelaskan satu sebab kedudukan kuadrat dipilih rawak.
prompt.en: Six 0.5 m² quadrats record 3, 0, 4, 2, 0, 3 plants of species X. Calculate mean density and percentage frequency; explain why quadrat positions are random.

modelAnswer.bm: 12 tumbuhan/3 m² = 4 m⁻²; hadir dalam 4/6 kuadrat = 66.7%; rawak mengurangkan bias pemilihan.
modelAnswer.en: 12 plants/3 m² = 4 m⁻²; present in 4/6 quadrats = 66.7%; random placement reduces selection bias.

prompt.bm: Cadangkan dua strategi bagi spesies terancam akibat pemecahan habitat: satu in situ dan satu ex situ. Jelaskan manfaat dan satu batas strategi ex situ.
prompt.en: Suggest two strategies for a species threatened by habitat fragmentation: one in situ and one ex situ. Explain benefits and one ex situ limitation.

modelAnswer.bm: In situ: lindungi/sambung habitat supaya populasi liar berfungsi; ex situ: pembiakan terkawal/bank gen untuk simpanan; ex situ tidak menggantikan habitat dan perlu mengurus kepelbagaian genetik.
modelAnswer.en: In situ: protect/connect habitats to maintain wild populations; ex situ: managed breeding/gene bank as a reserve; ex situ does not replace habitat and must manage genetic diversity.

prompt.bm: Bagi kacukan Iᴬi × Iᴮi, bina empat kombinasi genotip dan tentukan kebarangkalian kumpulan darah AB serta O.
prompt.en: For Iᴬi × Iᴮi, form the four genotype combinations and determine probabilities of AB and O blood groups.

modelAnswer.bm: IᴬIᴮ, Iᴬi, Iᴮi, ii; AB 1/4; O 1/4.
modelAnswer.en: IᴬIᴮ, Iᴬi, Iᴮi, ii; AB 1/4; O 1/4.

prompt.bm: Bandingkan ketinggian dengan kumpulan darah ABO dari segi jenis variasi, cara memaparkan taburan dan sumbangan persekitaran.
prompt.en: Compare height and ABO blood group for variation type, how to display distributions and environmental contribution.

modelAnswer.bm: Ketinggian selanjar, histogram mengikut julat, dipengaruhi gen dan persekitaran; ABO tak selanjar, carta bar kategori, ditentukan gen dan bukan diubah oleh diet biasa.
modelAnswer.en: Height is continuous, shown in a histogram of ranges, influenced by genes and environment; ABO is discontinuous, shown by category bars, determined genetically and not changed by ordinary diet.

prompt.bm: Tanaman rekaan diubah suai untuk tahan serangga. Nyatakan satu manfaat, satu risiko ekologi yang perlu dinilai dan satu langkah pemantauan.
prompt.en: A fictional crop is modified for insect resistance. State one benefit, one ecological risk to evaluate and one monitoring measure.

modelAnswer.bm: Manfaat: kurang kerosakan tanaman/keperluan racun tertentu; risiko: kesan organisma bukan sasaran atau evolusi rintangan; pantau populasi serangga, organisma bukan sasaran dan rintangan dari masa ke masa.
modelAnswer.en: Benefit: less crop damage/need for some pesticides; risk: non-target effects or resistance evolution; monitor insect populations, non-target organisms and resistance over time.

stem.bm: Sebuah rumah berada pada (231,456) dan sekolah pada (234,459). Apakah arah sekolah dari rumah?
stem.en: A house is at (231,456), a school at (234,459). In which direction is the school from the house?

explanation.bm: Nilai timuran dan utaraan meningkat; arah ialah timur laut.
explanation.en: Both easting and northing increase: northeast.

stem.bm: Grid 6 angka sebuah menara ialah 267438. Apakah timurannya?
stem.en: A tower has six-figure grid reference 267438. What is its easting?

explanation.bm: Timuran ialah tiga angka pertama, 267; 438 ialah utaraan. 26 dan 43 hanya memberi grid empat angka.
explanation.en: Easting is the first three digits, 267; 438 is northing. The two-digit readings 26 and 43 are only four-figure-grid precision.

stem.bm: Kompas menunjukkan perjalanan tepat ke selatan. Apakah bearingnya?
stem.en: A journey heads due south. What is its bearing?

explanation.bm: Bearing diukur mengikut arah jam dari utara; selatan ialah 180°.
explanation.en: Bearings are clockwise from north; south is 180°.

stem.bm: Skala 1:50 000; jarak peta 6 cm. Berapakah jarak sebenar?
stem.en: Scale 1:50,000; map distance 6 cm. Find real distance.

stem.bm: Peta 1:25 000 menunjukkan kawasan segi empat 4 cm × 2 cm. Luas sebenar?
stem.en: At 1:25,000 a rectangle measures 4 cm by 2 cm. Find actual area.

explanation.bm: 4 cm = 1 km dan 2 cm = 0.5 km; luas = 0.5 km².
explanation.en: Sides are 1 km and 0.5 km, giving 0.5 km².

stem.bm: Jalan mempunyai banyak selekoh kecil pada peta. Kaedah manakah paling sesuai mengukur panjang seluruh laluan?
stem.en: A road has many small bends on a map. Which method best measures the length of the entire route?

options.bm: Ukur garis lurus antara kedua-dua hujung jalan
options.en: Measure a straight line between the road endpoints

options.bm: Sambung selekoh utama dengan beberapa garis lurus panjang
options.en: Join only the main bends with a few long straight lines

options.bm: Ukur jarak mendatar dan menegak antara hujung lalu tambah
options.en: Add the horizontal and vertical separations between endpoints

options.bm: Jejak setiap lengkung dengan benang, kemudian ukur panjangnya
options.en: Trace every curve with string, then measure its length

explanation.bm: Benang mengikut seluruh laluan; garis lurus merendahkan jarak perjalanan.
explanation.en: String follows the route; a straight line underestimates travel distance.

stem.bm: Sepanjang garisan A–B, kontur 100, 120 dan 140 m dilintasi mengikut urutan pada jarak mendatar sangat dekat. Apakah tafsirannya?
stem.en: Along line A–B, contours of 100, 120 and 140 m are crossed in that order within a very short horizontal distance. What does this indicate?

options.bm: Cerun menurun dan menaik secara berselang

explanation.bm: Perubahan tinggi besar dalam jarak mendatar pendek menunjukkan cerun curam.
explanation.en: A large elevation change over a short horizontal distance indicates a steep slope.

stem.bm: Kontur berjarak 20 m: 80,100,120,____. Nilai seterusnya?
stem.en: Contour interval is 20 m: 80,100,120,____. Next value?

explanation.bm: Tambah satu selang kontur, 20 m.
explanation.en: Add one contour interval, 20 m.

stem.bm: Garis kontur membentuk V ketika melintasi lembah sungai. V biasanya menunjuk ke mana?
stem.en: Contour lines form a V across a river valley. Where does the V usually point?

options.bm: Mengikut arah aliran sungai pada kedua-dua tebing
options.en: Along the flow direction on both banks

options.bm: Merentasi sungai, bersudut tepat dengan aliran
options.en: Across the river, at right angles to flow

explanation.bm: V menghala ke kawasan lebih tinggi, iaitu hulu sungai.
explanation.en: The V points toward higher ground, upstream.

stem.bm: Antara maklumat peta, manakah unsur budaya?
stem.en: Which map feature belongs to the cultural landscape?

explanation.bm: Landasan dibina manusia; sungai, bukit dan paya ialah unsur fizikal.
explanation.en: A railway is human-built; rivers, hills and natural swamps are physical features.

stem.bm: Peta menunjukkan rumah di dataran rendah berhampiran sungai, sementara kawasan bukit kurang rumah. Faktor fizikal manakah paling disokong oleh corak ini?
stem.en: A map shows houses on a low plain near a river, while hills have fewer houses. Which physical factor is best supported by this pattern?

options.bm: Tapak di rabung jauh daripada sumber air
options.en: A ridge site far from a water source

options.bm: Tanah rata untuk pembinaan serta sumber air berdekatan
options.en: Flat construction land and a nearby water source

options.bm: Ketinggian besar memberikan suhu yang lebih rendah

explanation.bm: Dataran memudahkan pembinaan dan sungai membekalkan air. Peta tidak menunjukkan cerun curam, altitud tinggi atau rabung sebagai lokasi utama rumah.
explanation.en: The plain supports construction and the river supplies water. Steep slopes, high elevation and ridges are not the main settlement locations shown.

stem.bm: Peta menunjukkan petak sawah berair, terusan pengairan dan dataran rendah. Aktiviti pertanian manakah paling disokong?
stem.en: A map shows water-filled field plots, irrigation canals and a low plain. Which agricultural activity is best supported?

explanation.bm: Gabungan sawah dan saliran menyokong pertanian padi, bukan aktiviti yang tiada bukti pada peta.
explanation.en: Paddy fields and irrigation support rice farming.

stem.bm: Dua plat bergerak menjauhi di dasar laut. Proses manakah dijangka?
stem.en: Two ocean-floor plates move apart. What process is expected?

options.bm: Penunjaman satu plat di bawah plat lain
options.en: Subduction of one plate beneath another
Horizontal slipping along a transform fault

options.bm: Pembentukan kerak baharu apabila magma naik
options.en: New crust formation as magma rises

explanation.bm: Di sempadan pencapahan, plat berpisah dan magma mengisi ruang lalu menyejuk menjadi kerak baharu. Pilihan lain melibatkan penumpuan atau pergeseran.
explanation.en: At a divergent boundary plates separate and magma fills the gap, cooling into new crust. The alternatives involve convergence or transform motion.

stem.bm: Plat lautan bertembung dengan plat benua. Mengapa plat lautan biasanya menjunam?
stem.en: Why does an oceanic plate generally subduct beneath a continental plate?

options.en: The continental plate has greater density

options.bm: Plat lautan lebih ringan kerana lebih nipis
options.en: The oceanic plate is lighter because it is thinner
The oceanic plate has greater density

explanation.bm: Perbezaan ketumpatan menyokong subduksi plat lautan.
explanation.en: Density differences support oceanic subduction.

stem.bm: Sempadan plat bergeser mendatar. Risiko utama yang berkaitan?
stem.en: At a transform boundary, plates slide past each other. Main associated risk?

options.bm: Pembentukan rabung dasar laut melalui pencapahan
Gempa bumi akibat pelepasan tegasan sesar

explanation.bm: Tegasan terkumpul dan dilepaskan di sesar, menghasilkan gempa.
explanation.en: Stress builds and releases along faults, producing earthquakes.

stem.bm: Magma menyejuk perlahan di bawah permukaan. Batuan lazimnya mempunyai apa?
stem.en: Magma cools slowly underground. What texture is expected?

explanation.bm: Penyejukan perlahan memberi masa untuk hablur berkembang.
explanation.en: Slow cooling allows crystals time to grow.

stem.bm: Batu kapur mengalami haba dan tekanan tinggi tanpa melebur. Hasil yang lazim?
stem.en: Limestone undergoes heat and pressure without melting. Common resulting rock?

explanation.bm: Marmar ialah batuan metamorf daripada batu kapur.
explanation.en: Marble is metamorphosed limestone.

stem.bm: Batuan mengandungi lapisan sedimen dan fosil. Asal paling mungkin?
stem.en: A rock contains sediment layers and fossils. Most likely origin?

options.bm: Penyejukan magma perlahan di bawah tanah

options.en: Rapid cooling of lava at the surface

options.bm: Penghabluran semula akibat haba dan tekanan

explanation.bm: Strata dan fosil lazim dikekalkan dalam batuan enapan.
explanation.en: Strata and fossils are commonly preserved in sedimentary rocks.

stem.bm: Air meresap dalam rekahan, membeku dan mengembang. Jenis luluhawa?
stem.en: Water enters cracks, freezes and expands. Type of weathering?

explanation.bm: Pemecahan berlaku tanpa mengubah komposisi kimia batuan.
explanation.en: The rock breaks without a chemical composition change.

stem.bm: Batu kapur lebih mudah larut dalam air hujan berasid lemah. Proses utama?
stem.en: Limestone dissolves in weakly acidic rainwater. Main process?

explanation.bm: Asid karbonik dalam air bertindak balas dengan kalsium karbonat.
explanation.en: Carbonic acid reacts with calcium carbonate.

stem.bm: Akar pokok membesarkan rekahan batu. Kategori paling sesuai?
stem.en: Tree roots widen a rock crack. Best category?

explanation.bm: Organisma menyebabkan pemecahan batu di tempat asalnya.
explanation.en: Organisms cause in-place rock breakdown.

stem.bm: Hujan lebat berterusan di cerun tanpa pokok meningkatkan risiko tanah runtuh. Mengapa?
stem.en: Why does persistent heavy rain on a bare slope increase landslide risk?

options.bm: Kelembapan meningkatkan cengkaman akar pada cerun gondol
options.en: Moisture increases root anchorage on the bare slope

options.bm: Air liang menambah geseran antara butiran tanah
options.en: Pore water increases friction between soil particles

options.bm: Ketepuan air menambah berat dan mengurangkan kestabilan cerun
options.en: Water saturation adds weight and reduces slope stability

options.bm: Air mengurangkan berat tanah lalu meningkatkan kestabilan
options.en: Water reduces soil weight and increases stability

explanation.bm: Air menambah beban dan boleh mengurangkan rintangan tanah; ketiadaan akar melemahkan cerun.
explanation.en: Water increases loading and can reduce resistance; lack of roots weakens the slope.

stem.bm: Tiang pagar condong dan tanah bergerak amat perlahan menuruni cerun. Proses?
stem.en: Fence posts tilt as soil moves very slowly downslope. Process?

explanation.bm: Pergerakan perlahan tanah oleh graviti ialah kesotan.
explanation.en: Slow gravitational soil movement is creep.

stem.bm: Kestabilan cerun terjejas oleh takungan air selepas hujan. Langkah manakah paling langsung mengalirkan air berlebihan keluar?
stem.en: Water accumulating after rain weakens a slope. Which measure most directly removes the excess water?

options.bm: Membina penghadang untuk menahan batu jatuh
options.en: Build a barrier to catch falling rocks

options.bm: Mengehadkan beban bangunan di puncak cerun
options.en: Limit building loads at the slope crest

explanation.bm: Saliran mengawal tekanan air dan ketepuan; reka bentuk memerlukan penilaian cerun.
explanation.en: Drainage controls water pressure and saturation; design needs slope assessment.

stem.bm: Selekoh sungai: tebing luar lebih deras. Proses dominan di situ?
stem.en: At a river bend the outer bank has faster flow. Dominant process?

options.bm: Pemendapan kelodak pada kedua-dua tebing secara sama
options.en: Equal silt deposition on both banks
Sand deposition on the outer bank

options.bm: Hakisan lebih kuat pada tebing dalam yang perlahan
options.en: Stronger erosion on the slower inner bank

explanation.bm: Arus lebih deras menghakis tebing luar; pemendapan lebih lazim di tebing dalam.
explanation.en: Faster flow erodes the outer bank; deposition is more common on the inner bank.

stem.bm: Sungai memasuki tasik lalu kelajuannya menurun. Apakah kemungkinan?
stem.en: A river enters a lake and slows. What is likely?

options.bm: Hakisan bertambah kerana arus semakin perlahan
options.en: More erosion because flow becomes slower

options.bm: Sedimen kekal terampai kerana arus semakin perlahan
options.en: Sediment remains suspended because flow slows

options.bm: Pemendapan sedimen apabila keupayaan mengangkut berkurang
options.en: Sediment deposition as carrying ability decreases

options.bm: Beban sungai bertambah akibat pertambahan halaju
options.en: River load increases because velocity rises

explanation.bm: Tenaga mengangkut berkurang, lalu bahan boleh mendap.
explanation.en: Reduced transport energy allows material to settle.

stem.bm: Selepas hujan, tanah dan baja dari ladang masuk ke sungai. Langkah manakah menangani kedua-dua punca pencemaran ini?
stem.en: After rain, soil and fertiliser from farms enter a river. Which measure addresses both sources of pollution?

options.bm: Benteng banjir tanpa mengubah pengurusan tanah ladang
options.en: Flood embankments without changing farm-soil management

options.bm: Zon penampan vegetasi dan pengurusan penggunaan baja
options.en: Vegetated buffers and managed fertiliser use

options.bm: Menutup tebing dengan konkrit tanpa mengawal air larian
Mengeruk dasar sungai tetapi mengekalkan tanah ladang terdedah
options.en: Dredging the river while leaving farm soil exposed

explanation.bm: Penampan dan kawalan input mengurangkan sedimen serta nutrien masuk ke sungai.
explanation.en: Buffers and controlled inputs reduce sediment and nutrient runoff.

stem.bm: Ombak membawa pasir sepanjang pantai secara zigzag. Proses?
stem.en: Waves transport sand along a coast in a zigzag. Process?

explanation.bm: Swash menyerong dan backwash menuruni cerun memindahkan sedimen sepanjang pantai.
explanation.en: Angled swash and downslope backwash move sediment alongshore.

stem.bm: Gerbang laut runtuh, meninggalkan tiang batu terasing. Bentuk muka bumi?
stem.en: A sea arch collapses, leaving an isolated rock pillar. Landform?

explanation.bm: Hakisan tanjung boleh membentuk gua, gerbang dan kemudian batu tunggul.
explanation.en: Headland erosion can form caves, arches and stacks.

stem.bm: Benteng menahan sedimen hanyutan pesisir. Kesan hilir yang perlu dinilai?
stem.en: A groyne traps drifting sediment. Which downdrift impact needs assessment?

options.bm: Kadar pemendapan sama pada kedua-dua sisi groin
options.en: Deposition rates stay equal on both sides

options.bm: Hakisan berkurang kerana semua pasir melepasi groin
options.en: Erosion falls because all sand bypasses the groyne

options.bm: Bekalan pasir bertambah kerana groin memintas hanyutan
options.en: Sand supply increases because the groyne intercepts drift

options.bm: Bekalan pasir berkurang dan hakisan mungkin meningkat
options.en: Reduced sand supply may increase erosion

explanation.bm: Pemindahan sedimen terganggu boleh mengurangkan bekalan pasir di hilir.
explanation.en: Interrupted sediment transport can reduce downdrift supply.

stem.bm: Wilayah X: 2 juta orang, 20 000 km². Kepadatan?
stem.en: Region X has 2 million people over 20,000 km². Density?

explanation.bm: Kepadatan = 2 000 000 orang ÷ 20 000 km² = 100 orang/km².
explanation.en: Density = 2,000,000 people ÷ 20,000 km² = 100 people/km².

stem.bm: Sebuah lembah sungai mempunyai dataran aluvium subur, jalan dan bekalan air. Faktor manakah menerangkan penduduk yang padat di kawasan itu?
stem.en: A river valley has a fertile alluvial plain, roads and water supply. Which factor explains its high population density?

options.bm: Bekalan air, tanih subur dan akses menyokong pertanian
options.en: Water, fertile soil and access support farming

options.bm: Altitud tinggi mewujudkan suhu lebih rendah di lembah
options.en: High altitude creates cooler temperatures in the valley

options.bm: Cerun terjal memudahkan pembinaan jalan lembah
options.en: Steep slopes facilitate valley road construction

explanation.bm: Sumber dan akses menggalakkan petempatan, walaupun risiko tempatan masih wujud.
explanation.en: Resources and access favour settlement despite local risks.

stem.bm: Dua daerah mempunyai jumlah penduduk sama tetapi luas berbeza. Apa yang pasti?
stem.en: Two districts have equal populations but different areas. What is certain?

options.bm: Daerah yang lebih besar lebih padat
options.en: The larger district has higher density

options.bm: Kepadatan tidak boleh dibandingkan tanpa kadar kelahiran
options.en: Density cannot be compared without birth rates

options.bm: Daerah yang lebih kecil lebih padat
options.en: The smaller district has higher density

explanation.bm: Kepadatan = penduduk/luas; luas lebih kecil dengan penduduk sama memberi kepadatan lebih tinggi.
explanation.en: Density is population divided by area.

stem.bm: Penduduk 100 000; kelahiran 2 000, kematian 800, migrasi bersih +300. Pertambahan?
stem.en: Population 100,000; births 2,000, deaths 800, net migration +300. Increase?

stem.bm: Kadar kelahiran 24‰ dan kematian 8‰. Kadar pertambahan semula jadi?
stem.en: Birth rate 24‰ and death rate 8‰. Natural increase rate?

explanation.bm: 24 − 8 = 16 per seribu = 1.6%, bukan 16%.
explanation.en: 24 − 8 = 16 per thousand, or 1.6%, not 16%.

stem.bm: Bahagian penduduk berumur 65 tahun ke atas meningkat sementara bahagian kanak-kanak menurun. Keperluan manakah paling langsung bertambah?
stem.en: The population share aged 65 and above rises while the share of children falls. Which need most directly increases?

options.bm: Penjagaan warga tua dan perkhidmatan kesihatan
Asrama sekolah dan kemudahan murid baharu
Perkhidmatan bersalin dan sokongan ibu muda
options.en: Maternity services and support for young mothers

explanation.bm: Keperluan penjagaan dan sokongan usia tua boleh meningkat.
explanation.en: Care and support needs may rise with ageing.

stem.bm: Penduduk berpindah kerana peluang pekerjaan di bandar. Faktor ini ialah?
stem.en: People move for urban job opportunities. This is which factor?

options.en: Migration due to a disaster at the destination

explanation.bm: Peluang di destinasi ialah faktor tarikan.
explanation.en: Destination opportunities are pull factors.

stem.bm: Kawasan menerima 2 400 orang dan kehilangan 1 700 orang. Migrasi bersih?
stem.en: An area receives 2,400 migrants and loses 1,700. Net migration?

explanation.bm: Migrasi masuk − migrasi keluar = +700.
explanation.en: In-migration minus out-migration = +700.

stem.bm: Ramai jururawat dan jurutera meninggalkan kawasan asal untuk bekerja di tempat lain. Kesan langsung pada kawasan asal?
stem.en: Many nurses and engineers leave their home region to work elsewhere. What is the direct effect on the origin?

options.bm: Peningkatan penduduk asal melalui migrasi masuk

options.en: Less need to train replacement workers

options.bm: Pertambahan tenaga mahir yang tersedia di kawasan asal
options.en: An increase in skilled workers available at the origin

options.bm: Kehilangan tenaga mahir untuk perkhidmatan tempatan
options.en: Loss of skilled workers for local services

explanation.bm: Pemergian tenaga mahir boleh mengurangkan kapasiti kemahiran tempatan.
explanation.en: Skilled out-migration can reduce local expertise.

stem.bm: Rumah tersusun sepanjang jalan utama. Pola petempatan?
stem.en: Houses follow a main road. Settlement pattern?

explanation.bm: Pembinaan sepanjang laluan menghasilkan pola berjajar.
explanation.en: Development along a route creates a linear pattern.

stem.bm: Peta bandar menunjukkan pelabuhan, gudang dan terminal kontena. Fungsi yang paling disokong?
stem.en: A town map shows a port, warehouses and container terminals. Which function is best supported?

explanation.bm: Pelabuhan memudahkan pergerakan barang dan perdagangan.
explanation.en: Ports facilitate goods movement and trade.

stem.bm: Petempatan berselerak di ladang luas. Sebab yang munasabah?
stem.en: Dispersed homes occur on extensive farms. Plausible reason?

options.bm: Semua rumah berjajar di sepanjang satu jalan
options.en: All homes arranged along one road

options.bm: Semua rumah tertumpu di simpang jalan utama
options.en: All homes concentrated at a major road junction
Homes close to separate farm plots

options.bm: Rumah tertumpu di sekeliling sebuah pasar

explanation.bm: Pembahagian dan keluasan tanah pertanian boleh memisahkan lokasi rumah.
explanation.en: Separate, extensive plots can spread residential locations.

stem.bm: Penduduk bandar 600 000 daripada 1.5 juta orang. Kadar urbanisasi?
stem.en: Urban population is 600,000 of 1.5 million. Urbanisation proportion?

stem.bm: Bandar membesar tetapi ruang hijau menyusut. Kesan berkaitan?
stem.en: A city grows while green space shrinks. Associated effect?

options.bm: Suhu bandar turun kerana lebih banyak permukaan konkrit
options.en: Urban temperature falls because there is more concrete

options.bm: Perbezaan suhu bandar dan luar bandar mengecil
Pulau haba bandar mungkin menjadi lebih kuat
options.en: The urban heat island may intensify

explanation.bm: Permukaan binaan menyimpan haba; kurang vegetasi mengurangkan penyejukan.
explanation.en: Built surfaces retain heat and reduced vegetation limits cooling.

stem.bm: Langkah mengurangkan kesesakan sambil mengekalkan akses?
stem.en: Which measure reduces congestion while retaining access?

prompt.bm: Rumah (231,456), klinik (235,456), sekolah (235,460). Nyatakan arah setiap bahagian perjalanan rumah–klinik–sekolah dan jelaskan urutan membaca grid.
prompt.en: House (231,456), clinic (235,456), school (235,460). State the direction of each leg and explain grid-reading order.

modelAnswer.bm:
Rumah ke klinik: timur, kerana hanya timuran bertambah.
Klinik ke sekolah: utara, kerana hanya utaraan bertambah.
Baca timuran dahulu, kemudian utaraan; jangan tukar paksi.
modelAnswer.en:
House to clinic: east, as only easting increases.
Clinic to school: north, as only northing increases.
Read easting before northing; do not interchange axes.

point.en: Clinic to school: north, as only northing increases.

point.bm: Baca timuran dahulu, kemudian utaraan; jangan tukar paksi.

prompt.bm: Pada skala 1:50 000, sebuah padang segi empat berukuran 3 cm × 2 cm. Hitung panjang, lebar dan luas sebenar dengan unit.
prompt.en: At 1:50,000 a rectangular field is 3 cm by 2 cm. Calculate real length, width and area with units.

modelAnswer.bm:
Panjang = 150 000 cm = 1.5 km.
Lebar = 100 000 cm = 1 km.
Luas = 1.5 × 1 = 1.5 km²; faktor luas bukan faktor panjang.
modelAnswer.en:
Length = 1.5 km.
Width = 1 km.
Area = 1.5 km²; an area scale differs from a length scale.

point.bm: Luas = 1.5 × 1 = 1.5 km²; faktor luas bukan faktor panjang.
point.en: Area = 1.5 km²; an area scale differs from a length scale.

prompt.bm: Bandingkan tapak perumahan di dataran berdekatan sungai dengan tapak di cerun curam. Beri dua kelebihan dataran dan satu risiko yang perlu diurus.
prompt.en: Compare a housing site on a riverside plain with a steep-slope site. Give two plain-site advantages and one risk.

modelAnswer.bm:
Tanah rata memudahkan pembinaan dan jaringan jalan.
Air dan akses kegiatan ekonomi berhampiran boleh menyokong petempatan.
Banjir perlu dinilai melalui aras tapak, saliran dan zon penampan; jangan anggap semua dataran selamat.
modelAnswer.en:
Flat land facilitates construction and roads.
Nearby water and economic access can support settlement.
Assess flooding through elevation, drainage and buffers; flat land is not automatically safe.

point.bm: Tanah rata memudahkan pembinaan dan jaringan jalan.

point.bm: Banjir perlu dinilai melalui aras tapak, saliran dan zon penampan; jangan anggap semua dataran selamat.
point.en: Assess flooding through elevation, drainage and buffers; flat land is not automatically safe.

prompt.bm: Terangkan bagaimana pertembungan plat lautan dengan benua boleh menghasilkan jurang lautan dan gunung berapi. Sertakan satu langkah mengurangkan risiko kepada penduduk.
prompt.en: Explain how ocean–continent convergence can form a trench and volcanoes, and give one risk-reduction measure.

modelAnswer.bm:
Plat lautan yang lebih tumpat menjunam; zon lenturan membentuk jurang.
Peleburan separa pada mantel di atas plat menjunam menghasilkan magma yang boleh naik.
Pemantauan, amaran dan pelan pemindahan mengurangkan pendedahan; ia tidak menghentikan pergerakan plat.
modelAnswer.en:
The denser oceanic plate subducts, forming a trench.
Partial melting in the mantle above the subducting slab produces rising magma.
Monitoring, warnings and evacuation reduce exposure but do not stop plate movement.

point.bm: Plat lautan yang lebih tumpat menjunam; zon lenturan membentuk jurang.

prompt.bm: Bandingkan pembentukan granit dan batu pasir, kemudian nyatakan satu kegunaan ekonomi setiap satu.
prompt.en: Compare granite and sandstone formation, then state one economic use of each.

modelAnswer.bm:
Granit terbentuk daripada magma yang menyejuk perlahan di bawah permukaan.
Batu pasir terbentuk melalui pemadatan dan penyimenan butiran pasir.
Kedua-duanya boleh digunakan sebagai batu binaan; kaitkan ketahanan dan sifat batu dengan kegunaan.
modelAnswer.en:
Granite forms from slowly cooling underground magma.
Sandstone forms by compacting and cementing sand grains.
Both can serve as building stone; relate rock properties to use.
