prompt.bm: Bandingkan luluhawa dengan hakisan menggunakan batu kapur dan aliran sungai. Terangkan satu faktor yang mempercepat luluhawa kimia.
prompt.en: Compare weathering and erosion using limestone and a river. Explain one factor accelerating chemical weathering.

modelAnswer.bm:
Luluhawa memecah atau menguraikan batu di tempat asal; pengkarbonan melarutkan batu kapur.
Hakisan menanggalkan dan mengangkut bahan oleh agen seperti air mengalir.
Iklim panas dan lembap menyediakan air serta mempercepat tindak balas kimia.
modelAnswer.en:
Weathering breaks down rock in place; carbonation dissolves limestone.
Erosion removes and transports material through agents such as moving water.
Warm, humid climates provide water and accelerate chemical reactions.

point.bm: Luluhawa memecah atau menguraikan batu di tempat asal; pengkarbonan melarutkan batu kapur.
point.en: Weathering breaks down rock in place; carbonation dissolves limestone.

point.bm: Hakisan menanggalkan dan mengangkut bahan oleh agen seperti air mengalir.

point.bm: Iklim panas dan lembap menyediakan air serta mempercepat tindak balas kimia.

prompt.bm: Cadangkan pengurusan cerun berhampiran sekolah selepas hujan berpanjangan. Kaitkan dua langkah dengan mekanisme risiko.
prompt.en: Suggest management of a slope near a school after prolonged rain. Link two measures to risk mechanisms.

modelAnswer.bm:
Selenggara saliran untuk mengurangkan takungan dan ketepuan air yang melemahkan cerun.
Kekalkan vegetasi sesuai kerana akar mengikat tanih; elak tambahan beban atau pemotongan cerun yang boleh mengurangkan kestabilan.
Hadkan akses apabila retakan atau pergerakan dikesan dan dapatkan penilaian cerun oleh pihak berkelayakan.
modelAnswer.en:
Maintain drains to reduce accumulated water and saturation that weaken the slope.
Retain suitable vegetation because roots bind soil; avoid extra loading or cutting that can reduce stability.
Restrict access when cracks or movement appear and obtain qualified slope assessment.

point.bm: Selenggara saliran untuk mengurangkan takungan dan ketepuan air yang melemahkan cerun.
point.en: Maintain drains to reduce accumulated water and saturation that weaken the slope.

prompt.bm: A: 600 000 orang/3 000 km²; B: 600 000/12 000 km². Hitung kepadatan dan jelaskan mengapa angka ini sahaja tidak membuktikan tahap kesejahteraan.
prompt.en: Calculate densities for A (600,000/3,000 km²) and B (600,000/12,000 km²). Explain why density alone cannot establish wellbeing.

modelAnswer.bm:
A = 200 orang/km².
B = 50 orang/km².
Perlu data perkhidmatan, perumahan dan pendapatan; kepadatan sahaja tidak mengukur kesejahteraan.
modelAnswer.en:
A = 200 people/km².
B = 50 people/km².
Services, housing and income data are needed; density alone does not measure wellbeing.

prompt.bm: Daerah mempunyai 200 000 orang, 3 000 kelahiran, 1 000 kematian dan migrasi bersih −500 setahun. Hitung pertambahan semula jadi, perubahan keseluruhan dan satu implikasi perancangan.
prompt.en: A district has 200,000 people, 3,000 births, 1,000 deaths and net migration −500. Calculate natural increase, total change and one planning implication.

modelAnswer.bm:
Pertambahan semula jadi = 3 000 − 1 000 = 2 000 orang.
Perubahan keseluruhan = 2 000 − 500 = +1 500 orang; kadar = 1 500/200 000 × 100% = 0.75%.
Rancang kapasiti klinik dan perumahan untuk penduduk yang bertambah; semak taburan umur serta lokasi sebelum menentukan keperluan kemudahan.
modelAnswer.en:
Natural increase = 3,000 − 1,000 = 2,000 people.
Total change = 2,000 − 500 = +1,500 people; rate = 1,500/200,000 × 100% = 0.75%.
Plan clinic and housing capacity for the growing population; check age and location distributions before determining facility needs.

point.bm: Rancang kapasiti klinik dan perumahan untuk penduduk yang bertambah; semak taburan umur serta lokasi sebelum menentukan keperluan kemudahan.
point.en: Plan clinic and housing capacity for the growing population; check age and location distributions before determining facility needs.

prompt.bm: Nilai penghijrahan belia dari kampung ke bandar: satu faktor tolakan, satu tarikan dan kesan kepada kedua-dua tempat.

modelAnswer.bm:
Tolakan: peluang pekerjaan tempatan terhad.
Tarikan: pekerjaan atau pendidikan di bandar.
Kampung mungkin kehilangan tenaga kerja; bandar mendapat tenaga tetapi memerlukan perumahan dan perkhidmatan.
modelAnswer.en:
Push: limited local job opportunities.
Pull: urban jobs or education.
Villages may lose labour; cities gain workers but need housing and services.

point.bm: Tarikan: pekerjaan atau pendidikan di bandar.

point.en: Villages may lose labour; cities gain workers but need housing and services.

prompt.bm: Penduduk bandar meningkat dari 300 000/1 juta kepada 500 000/1.25 juta. Hitung perubahan kadar urbanisasi dan cadangkan dua tindak balas perancangan.
prompt.en: Urban population rises from 300,000/1 million to 500,000/1.25 million. Calculate the change in urbanisation proportion and suggest two planning responses.

modelAnswer.bm:
Kadar awal = 300 000/1 000 000 = 30%; kadar akhir = 500 000/1 250 000 = 40%.
Peningkatan = 10 mata peratus; peningkatan relatif kadar = (40−30)/30 × 100% ≈ 33.3%.
Tingkatkan pengangkutan awam untuk permintaan perjalanan; tambah perumahan berserta kemudahan asas untuk penduduk bandar yang meningkat.
modelAnswer.en:
Initial rate = 300,000/1,000,000 = 30%; final rate = 500,000/1,250,000 = 40%.
The increase is 10 percentage points; relative growth in the proportion is (40−30)/30 × 100% ≈ 33.3%.
Expand public transport for increased travel demand; add housing with basic services for the growing urban population.

point.bm: Peningkatan = 10 mata peratus; peningkatan relatif kadar = (40−30)/30 × 100% ≈ 33.3%.
point.en: The increase is 10 percentage points; relative growth in the proportion is (40−30)/30 × 100% ≈ 33.3%.

point.bm: Tingkatkan pengangkutan awam untuk permintaan perjalanan; tambah perumahan berserta kemudahan asas untuk penduduk bandar yang meningkat.
point.en: Expand public transport for increased travel demand; add housing with basic services for the growing urban population.

stem.bm: Dengan masa dua jam, Aina boleh menyiapkan sama ada poster atau latihan debat. Dia memilih debat. Kos lepas ialah?
stem.en: With two hours, Aina can complete either a poster or debate practice. She chooses debate. What is the opportunity cost?

options.bm: Poster sebagai alternatif terbaik yang dilepaskan
options.en: The poster as the best forgone alternative

options.bm: Jumlah faedah poster dan debat bersama
options.en: The combined benefits of poster and debate
The benefit of the chosen debate practice

options.bm: Kos wang untuk menyiapkan poster sahaja
options.en: Only the monetary cost of making the poster

explanation.bm: Kos lepas ialah alternatif terbaik yang dilepaskan, bukan manfaat pilihan diambil.
explanation.en: Opportunity cost is the best forgone alternative, not the benefit chosen.

stem.bm: Kilang boleh menghasilkan 40 meja atau 80 kerusi dengan sumber sama. Andaikan kadar pertukaran tetap. Kos lepas 1 meja?
stem.en: A factory makes 40 tables or 80 chairs with the same resources. Assume a constant trade-off. Opportunity cost of one table?

explanation.bm: 80/40 = 2 kerusi bagi setiap meja.
explanation.en: 80/40 = 2 chairs per table.

stem.bm: Sebuah ekonomi menggunakan harga pasaran serta kerajaan menyediakan kesihatan awam. Ciri ini paling sesuai dengan?
stem.en: An economy uses market prices while government provides public healthcare. Which system fits best?

explanation.bm: Keputusan pasaran wujud bersama peranan kerajaan.
explanation.en: Market decisions coexist with government roles.

stem.bm: Pada RM 5, kuantiti diminta 120 dan ditawar 80. Keadaan pasaran?
stem.en: At RM 5, quantity demanded is 120 and supplied 80. Market condition?

explanation.bm: 120 − 80 = 40 kekurangan; kuantiti diminta melebihi ditawar.
explanation.en: 120−80 = 40 shortage; demand exceeds supply at that price.

stem.bm: Pendapatan meningkat dan barang ialah barang normal. Andaikan faktor lain tetap. Apa berlaku?
stem.en: Income rises for a normal good, other factors constant. What happens?

options.bm: Pergerakan ke atas sepanjang keluk permintaan asal
options.en: Upward movement along the original demand curve

explanation.bm: Pendapatan ialah penentu bukan harga sendiri; barang normal mengalami peningkatan permintaan.
explanation.en: Income is a non-price determinant; demand for a normal good rises.

stem.bm: Harga naik 10%, kuantiti diminta turun 20%. Guna nilai mutlak keanjalan. Nilainya?
stem.en: Price rises 10%, quantity demanded falls 20%. Absolute price elasticity?

explanation.bm: Keanjalan harga permintaan = nilai mutlak (−20% ÷ 10%) = 2. Nilai melebihi 1 menunjukkan permintaan anjal.
explanation.en: Price elasticity of demand = absolute value of (−20% ÷ 10%) = 2. A value above 1 indicates elastic demand.

stem.bm: Gaji RM 2 800, elaun RM 200 dan potongan wajib RM 350. Pendapatan boleh guna?
stem.en: Salary RM 2,800, allowance RM 200 and compulsory deductions RM 350. Disposable income?

stem.bm: Seseorang membandingkan harga dua komputer dalam RM. Fungsi wang?
stem.en: Someone compares two computer prices in RM. Function of money?

explanation.bm: Harga dalam unit sama membolehkan perbandingan nilai.
explanation.en: Prices in a common unit enable value comparison.

stem.bm: Pendapatan boleh guna RM 2 500, perbelanjaan RM 2 100. Jika simpanan dinaikkan RM 100 tanpa perubahan pendapatan, perbelanjaan baharu?
stem.en: Disposable income RM 2,500, spending RM 2,100. Saving rises RM 100 with income unchanged. New spending?

explanation.bm: Simpanan asal RM 400; baharu RM 500; perbelanjaan = 2 500−500.
explanation.en: Original saving RM 400; new RM 500; spending RM 2,000.

stem.bm: Kos tetap RM 600, kos berubah seunit RM 8, output 100. Jumlah kos?
stem.en: Fixed cost RM 600, variable cost RM 8 per unit, output 100. Total cost?

explanation.bm: Jumlah kos = 600 + 8×100 = RM 1 400.
explanation.en: Total cost = fixed plus variable cost.

stem.bm: Hasil jualan RM 2 000 dan jumlah kos RM 1 400. Untung?
stem.en: Sales revenue RM 2,000 and total cost RM 1,400. Profit?

explanation.bm: Untung = jumlah hasil − jumlah kos = RM 600.
explanation.en: Profit = total revenue minus total cost.

stem.bm: Lima pekerja menghasilkan 200 unit sehari; selepas latihan masih lima pekerja menghasilkan 250. Produktiviti buruh berubah bagaimana?
stem.en: Five workers make 200 units/day; after training the same five make 250. Labour productivity change?

explanation.bm: Produktiviti = output/input buruh:200/5=40,250/5=50.
explanation.en: Productivity is output per labour input.

prompt.bm: Kelab mempunyai RM 600. Projek A menggunakan semua dana untuk buku, projek B untuk peralatan sukan. Terangkan kekurangan, pilihan dan kos lepas jika A dipilih. Cadangkan satu maklumat tambahan untuk keputusan.
prompt.en: A club has RM 600. Project A spends all funds on books; B on sports equipment. Explain scarcity, choice and opportunity cost if A is chosen, and one additional fact needed.

modelAnswer.bm:
Dana terhad tidak dapat membiayai kedua-dua projek.
Memilih A bermakna manfaat projek B sebagai alternatif terbaik dilepaskan.
Bandingkan bilangan pengguna atau keperluan sebenar; kos wang sahaja tidak mengukur manfaat.
modelAnswer.en:
Limited funds cannot finance both projects.
Choosing A forgoes the benefit of B as the next-best alternative.
Compare users or actual needs; money cost alone does not measure benefit.

point.bm: Dana terhad tidak dapat membiayai kedua-dua projek.
point.en: Limited funds cannot finance both projects.

point.bm: Memilih A bermakna manfaat projek B sebagai alternatif terbaik dilepaskan.
point.en: Choosing A forgoes the benefit of B as the next-best alternative.

point.bm: Bandingkan bilangan pengguna atau keperluan sebenar; kos wang sahaja tidak mengukur manfaat.
point.en: Compare users or actual needs; money cost alone does not measure benefit.

prompt.bm: Pada harga RM 4: Qd=100, Qs=60; RM 6: Qd=80, Qs=80; RM 8: Qd=60, Qs=100. Kenal pasti keseimbangan dan keadaan pada RM 4 serta RM 8. Jelaskan tekanan harga tanpa kawalan.
prompt.en: At RM 4: Qd 100/Qs 60; RM 6: Qd 80/Qs 80; RM 8: Qd 60/Qs 100. Identify equilibrium, conditions at RM 4/RM 8 and price pressures without controls.

modelAnswer.bm:
Keseimbangan RM 6 dan 80 unit kerana Qd=Qs.
RM 4: kekurangan 40, memberi tekanan harga naik.
RM 8: lebihan 40, memberi tekanan harga turun.
modelAnswer.en:
Equilibrium is RM 6 and 80 units, where Qd=Qs.
RM 4: shortage 40, exerting upward price pressure.
RM 8: surplus 40, exerting downward price pressure.

point.bm: Keseimbangan RM 6 dan 80 unit kerana Qd=Qs.
point.en: Equilibrium is RM 6 and 80 units, where Qd=Qs.

point.bm: RM 4: kekurangan 40, memberi tekanan harga naik.
point.en: RM 4: shortage 40, exerting upward price pressure.

point.bm: RM 8: lebihan 40, memberi tekanan harga turun.
point.en: RM 8: surplus 40, exerting downward price pressure.

prompt.bm: Pendapatan boleh guna RM 3 200; sewa 800, makanan 700, pengangkutan 300, komitmen 400, hiburan 300. Hitung simpanan dan cadangkan cara mencapai RM 900 tanpa pinjaman. Jelaskan satu trade-off.
prompt.en: Disposable income RM 3,200; rent 800, food 700, transport 300, commitments 400, entertainment 300. Find saving and plan to reach RM 900 without borrowing; explain a trade-off.

modelAnswer.bm:
Perbelanjaan RM 2 500; simpanan RM 700.
Kurangkan RM 200 perbelanjaan, contohnya hiburan 300→100; kekalkan jumlah bajet seimbang.
Simpanan tambahan melepaskan sebahagian penggunaan sekarang; pilihan perlu sesuai keperluan.
modelAnswer.en:
Spending RM 2,500; saving RM 700.
Reduce spending by RM 200, e.g. entertainment 300→100; balance the budget.
Extra saving forgoes some current consumption; choices should fit needs.

point.bm: Kurangkan RM 200 perbelanjaan, contohnya hiburan 300→100; kekalkan jumlah bajet seimbang.
point.en: Reduce spending by RM 200, e.g. entertainment 300→100; balance the budget.

point.bm: Simpanan tambahan melepaskan sebahagian penggunaan sekarang; pilihan perlu sesuai keperluan.
point.en: Extra saving forgoes some current consumption; choices should fit needs.

prompt.bm: Kedai mengeluarkan 100 unit dengan kos tetap RM 500 dan kos berubah RM 900; harga jual RM 18/unit, semua terjual. Hitung kos purata, hasil dan untung. Terangkan mengapa pencemaran boleh menyebabkan kos sosial melebihi kos persendirian.
prompt.en: A shop makes 100 units with fixed cost RM 500 and variable cost RM 900; all sell at RM 18 each. Find average cost, revenue and profit; explain pollution externalities.

modelAnswer.bm:
Jumlah kos RM 1 400; kos purata RM 14.
Hasil RM 1 800; untung RM 400.
Kesan pencemaran ditanggung pihak lain dan mungkin tidak termasuk kos pengeluar.
modelAnswer.en:
Total cost RM 1,400; average cost RM 14.
Revenue RM 1,800; profit RM 400.
Pollution imposes costs on others that may not enter the producer’s private cost.

point.bm: Jumlah kos RM 1 400; kos purata RM 14.
point.en: Total cost RM 1,400; average cost RM 14.

point.bm: Kesan pencemaran ditanggung pihak lain dan mungkin tidak termasuk kos pengeluar.
point.en: Pollution imposes costs on others that may not enter the producer’s private cost.

stem.bm: IHP meningkat 100→105. Kadar inflasi?
stem.en: CPI rises from 100 to 105. Inflation rate?

stem.bm: Tenaga buruh 2 juta; penganggur 100 000. Kadar pengangguran?
stem.en: Labour force 2 million; unemployed 100,000. Unemployment rate?

explanation.bm: 100 000/2 000 000×100=5%; penyebut ialah tenaga buruh.
explanation.en: Use the labour force as denominator.

stem.bm: Ketika kemelesetan, kerajaan menaikkan perbelanjaan pembangunan. Tujuan fiskal utama?
stem.en: During recession, government increases development spending. Main fiscal aim?

options.bm: Mengurangkan penawaran wang melalui dasar fiskal
options.en: Reduce money supply through fiscal policy

options.bm: Menaikkan kadar faedah melalui perbelanjaan pembangunan
options.en: Raise interest rates through development spending

options.bm: Meningkatkan permintaan agregat dan peluang pekerjaan

explanation.bm: Perbelanjaan kerajaan ialah alat fiskal; kesan sebenar bergantung kapasiti dan keadaan ekonomi.
explanation.en: Government spending is a fiscal tool; outcomes depend on capacity and conditions.

stem.bm: Kadar berubah USD 1=RM 4 kepada USD 1=RM 4.50. Ringgit mengalami apa?
stem.en: Rate changes from USD 1=RM 4 to USD 1=RM 4.50. What happens to ringgit?

options.bm: Ringgit membeli lebih banyak USD kerana 4.50 lebih besar
options.en: The ringgit buys more USD because 4.50 is larger

options.bm: Kuasa beli ringgit terhadap USD kekal
options.en: Ringgit purchasing power against USD is unchanged

explanation.bm: Lebih RM diperlukan untuk USD 1; nilai ringgit relatif kepada USD turun.
explanation.en: More ringgit buys one USD, so ringgit depreciates against USD.

stem.bm: Eksport barang RM 900 juta, import barang RM 700 juta. Imbangan dagangan?
stem.en: Goods exports RM 900 m, goods imports RM 700 m. Trade balance?

explanation.bm: Eksport−import=+RM 200 juta; ini imbangan barang, bukan keseluruhan imbangan pembayaran.
explanation.en: Exports minus imports is positive RM 200 m; goods trade is not the entire balance of payments.

stem.bm: Firma tempatan membeli mesin USD 10 000. Kadar RM 4/USD berubah RM 4.50/USD. Kos RM bertambah?
stem.en: A local firm buys a USD 10,000 machine. Rate changes RM 4/USD to RM 4.50/USD. Extra ringgit cost?

explanation.bm: Kos 40 000→45 000; pertambahan RM 5 000.
explanation.en: Cost rises from RM 40,000 to RM 45,000, an increase of RM 5,000.

prompt.bm: IHP tahun A=120, tahun B=126; tenaga buruh 500 000, penganggur 25 000. Hitung dua indikator dan bandingkan satu langkah fiskal dengan satu langkah monetari bagi menyokong aktiviti ekonomi.
prompt.en: CPI A 120/B 126; labour force 500,000/unemployed 25,000. Calculate both indicators and compare one fiscal and one monetary expansion measure.

modelAnswer.bm:
Inflasi=(126−120)/120×100=5%; pengangguran=25 000/500 000×100=5%.
Fiskal: perbelanjaan kerajaan meningkat atau cukai berkurang menyokong permintaan.
Monetari: penurunan kadar faedah boleh menyokong pinjaman/perbelanjaan; pertimbangkan risiko inflasi.
modelAnswer.en:
Inflation and unemployment are both 5%.
Fiscal: higher government spending or lower taxes can support demand.
Monetary: lower interest rates may support borrowing/spending; consider inflation risk.

point.bm: Fiskal: perbelanjaan kerajaan meningkat atau cukai berkurang menyokong permintaan.
point.en: Fiscal: higher government spending or lower taxes can support demand.

point.bm: Monetari: penurunan kadar faedah boleh menyokong pinjaman/perbelanjaan; pertimbangkan risiko inflasi.
point.en: Monetary: lower interest rates may support borrowing/spending; consider inflation risk.

title.bm: Kajian kes: Malaysia dan Ekonomi Global

prompt.bm: Eksport barang RM 500 juta, import RM 560 juta. Firma mengimport peralatan USD 20 000; kadar berubah RM 4/USD kepada RM 4.20/USD. Hitung imbangan dagangan dan tambahan kos; jelaskan satu manfaat serta risiko perdagangan global.
prompt.en: Goods exports RM 500 m/imports RM 560 m. Equipment USD 20,000; rate moves RM 4/USD to RM 4.20/USD. Calculate trade balance and extra cost, then one benefit and risk of global trade.

modelAnswer.bm:
Imbangan dagangan = −RM 60 juta, defisit.
Kos RM 80 000→84 000; tambahan RM 4 000.
Manfaat: pasaran/input lebih luas; risiko: turun naik pertukaran atau gangguan bekalan.
modelAnswer.en:
Trade balance is a RM 60 m deficit.
Cost rises RM 80,000→84,000; extra RM 4,000.
Benefit: wider markets/inputs; risk: exchange volatility or supply disruption.

point.en: Trade balance is a RM 60 m deficit.

point.bm: Manfaat: pasaran/input lebih luas; risiko: turun naik pertukaran atau gangguan bekalan.
point.en: Benefit: wider markets/inputs; risk: exchange volatility or supply disruption.

stem.bm: Dua rakan menjadi pemilik kedai, berkongsi modal, untung dan pengurusan melalui perjanjian, tanpa menubuhkan syarikat. Bentuk yang sesuai?
stem.en: Two friends own a shop, share capital, profits and management under an agreement, and do not incorporate a company. Which form fits?

explanation.bm: Perkongsian melibatkan dua atau lebih pemilik; tanggungjawab perlu dibezakan daripada syarikat berhad.
explanation.en: A partnership has multiple owners; liability differs from an incorporated company.

stem.bm: Perniagaan untung tetapi gagal membayar pembekal tepat masa. Apa yang paling perlu disemak?
stem.en: A profitable business cannot pay suppliers on time. What most needs review?

options.bm: Jumlah jualan kredit tanpa tarikh pembayaran
options.en: Total credit sales without payment dates

options.bm: Aliran tunai dan masa kutipan penghutang
options.en: Cash flow and timing of receivables collection

options.bm: Nilai stok tanpa memeriksa tunai tersedia
options.en: Inventory value without checking available cash

options.bm: Kadar untung kasar tanpa meneliti masa kutipan
options.en: Gross profit margin without reviewing collection timing

explanation.bm: Untung akruan tidak menjamin tunai tersedia pada tarikh bayaran.
explanation.en: Accrual profit does not guarantee cash on the payment date.

stem.bm: Mengapa pemilik memilih syarikat berhad berbanding milikan tunggal?
stem.en: Why might an owner choose a limited company over sole proprietorship?

options.bm: Pemegang saham menanggung semua hutang tanpa had
options.en: Shareholders bear all debts without limit

options.bm: Syarikat berhad tidak boleh menambah pemegang saham
options.en: A limited company cannot add shareholders

options.bm: Entiti berasingan dan liabiliti terhad pemegang saham
options.en: Separate entity and limited shareholder liability

options.bm: Syarikat dan pemilik menjadi entiti undang-undang yang sama
options.en: Company and owners form the same legal entity

explanation.bm: Syarikat mempunyai personaliti undang-undang berasingan; liabiliti terhad tertakluk undang-undang dan kewajipan berkaitan.
explanation.en: A company has separate legal personality; limited liability is subject to applicable duties and law.

stem.bm: Kos import naik akibat susut nilai mata wang. Faktor persekitaran?
stem.en: Import costs rise due to currency depreciation. Environmental factor?

explanation.bm: Kadar pertukaran ialah faktor ekonomi luaran yang mempengaruhi kos.
explanation.en: Exchange rates are an external economic factor affecting cost.

stem.bm: Permintaan dalam talian meningkat, tetapi kedai kecil belum mengetahui jualan sebenar atau keupayaan penghantarannya. Tindakan awal paling berasas?
stem.en: Online demand is rising, but a small shop does not yet know its actual online sales or delivery capacity. What is the best-supported first step?

options.en: Expand digital advertising first without testing delivery capacity

options.bm: Uji jualan dalam talian dengan bajet, penghantaran dan sokongan pelanggan
options.en: Pilot online sales with a budget, delivery and customer support

options.bm: Bina stok semua produk berdasarkan jumlah pengikut media sosial
options.en: Build stock of all products based on social-media follower totals

options.bm: Pindahkan keseluruhan operasi berdasarkan pertumbuhan pasaran umum
options.en: Move the entire operation based on general market growth

explanation.bm: Ujian terkawal dan keupayaan operasi mengurangkan risiko; jualan dan kos perlu diukur.
explanation.en: A controlled pilot and operational capacity reduce risk; measure sales and costs.

stem.bm: Pelanggan semakin memilih pembungkusan boleh guna semula. Maklumat paling berguna sebelum perubahan?
stem.en: Customers prefer reusable packaging. Most useful information before changing?

options.bm: Bilangan pelanggan berminat sahaja tanpa harga pilihan
options.en: Interested customer numbers alone without price choices

options.bm: Kesanggupan membayar, kos pembungkusan dan kesesuaian produk
options.en: Willingness to pay, packaging cost and product suitability

options.bm: Harga pembekal sahaja tanpa kos penghantaran atau kesesuaian
options.en: Supplier price alone without delivery cost or suitability

options.bm: Pembungkusan pesaing sahaja tanpa maklum balas pelanggan sendiri
options.en: Competitor packaging alone without own-customer feedback

explanation.bm: Perubahan perlu memenuhi permintaan dan kekal berdaya maju dari segi kos/fungsi.
explanation.en: A change should meet demand while remaining viable and functional.

stem.bm: Yang manakah objektif paling boleh diukur?
stem.en: Which objective is most measurable?

options.bm: Naikkan jualan bulanan 10% daripada garis dasar dalam enam bulan
options.en: Raise monthly sales 10% from a baseline within six months

options.bm: Tingkatkan prestasi kedai dengan usaha pemasaran
options.en: Improve shop performance through marketing efforts

options.bm: Naikkan jualan 10% apabila keadaan pasaran mengizinkan
options.en: Raise sales 10% when market conditions permit

options.bm: Naikkan jualan bulanan tanpa menetapkan kadar atau tempoh
options.en: Raise monthly sales without setting a rate or deadline

explanation.bm: Objektif mempunyai ukuran, tempoh dan garis dasar yang jelas.
explanation.en: It specifies a measure, timeframe and baseline.

stem.bm: Sasaran jualan dicapai tetapi margin jatuh. Penilaian paling wajar?
stem.en: Sales target is met but margin falls. Best evaluation?

options.bm: Semak jumlah jualan sahaja kerana sasaran jualan tercapai
options.en: Review only sales because the sales target was reached

options.bm: Semak jualan, margin untung dan kos promosi bersama
options.en: Review sales, profit margins and promotion costs together

options.bm: Semak belanja promosi sahaja tanpa kesan pada jualan
options.en: Review only promotion expenditure without its sales effect

options.bm: Semak bilangan transaksi sahaja tanpa nilai atau kos
options.en: Review only transaction counts without value or cost

explanation.bm: Satu ukuran tidak mewakili keseluruhan prestasi atau kelestarian.
explanation.en: One measure does not capture overall performance or viability.

stem.bm: Visi perniagaan berbeza daripada objektif operasi kerana visi biasanya?
stem.en: A vision differs from an operational objective because it generally describes?

options.bm: Hala tuju dan aspirasi jangka panjang

options.en: A daily procedure for accepting orders

options.bm: Sasaran jualan tertentu untuk bulan hadapan
options.en: A specific sales target for next month

explanation.en: Vision gives direction; objectives translate it into assessable targets.

stem.bm: Produk kerap kehabisan stok ketika promosi. Kerjasama bahagian paling perlu?

options.bm: Kewangan, sumber manusia dan khidmat pelanggan
options.en: Finance, human resources and customer service

explanation.bm: Ramalan promosi perlu diselaraskan dengan pembelian dan kapasiti operasi.
explanation.en: Promotion forecasts must align with purchasing and operational capacity.

stem.bm: Bahagian manakah menilai bajet dan aliran tunai?
stem.en: Which function evaluates budgets and cash flow?

explanation.bm: Kewangan mengurus sumber wang, bajet dan pemantauan tunai.
explanation.en: Finance manages money, budgets and cash monitoring.

stem.bm: Aduan produk dikumpul tetapi tidak sampai kepada pereka. Masalah utama?
stem.en: Product complaints are collected but never reach designers. Main issue?

options.bm: Ramalan jualan gagal menentukan kuantiti pengeluaran
options.en: Sales forecasts fail to set output quantity

options.bm: Bajet kewangan gagal menentukan dana latihan pekerja

options.bm: Jadual pembelian gagal menjamin bahan mentah mencukupi
options.en: Purchasing schedules fail to secure enough raw material

options.bm: Aliran maklumat antara khidmat pelanggan dan pembangunan produk lemah
options.en: Weak information flow from customer service to product development

explanation.bm: Maklum balas perlu menghubungkan khidmat pelanggan dengan pembangunan produk.
explanation.en: Feedback should connect customer service with product development.

title.bm: Kajian kes: Tujuan Perniagaan dan Pemilikan Perniagaan

prompt.bm: Bandingkan milikan tunggal dan perkongsian untuk kedai kecil: modal, keputusan serta risiko liabiliti. Cadangkan bentuk berdasarkan alasan, bukan saiz sahaja.
prompt.en: Compare sole proprietorship and partnership for a small shop: capital, decisions and liability. Recommend with reasons.

modelAnswer.bm:
Milikan tunggal bergantung pada modal seorang pemilik dan membolehkan keputusan sendiri, tetapi sumber mungkin terhad.
Perkongsian biasa menggabungkan modal dan kemahiran; keputusan serta tanggungjawab perlu dipersetujui untuk mengurangkan konflik.
Kedua-dua bentuk biasa mempunyai liabiliti tidak terhad. Jika dua rakan mahu berkongsi modal dan pengurusan, cadangkan perkongsian biasa dengan perjanjian jelas; ia tidak menghapuskan liabiliti peribadi.
modelAnswer.en:
A sole proprietor relies on one owner’s capital and makes decisions independently, but resources may be limited.
An ordinary partnership pools capital and skills; decisions and responsibilities need agreement to reduce conflict.
Both ordinary forms have unlimited liability. If two friends want to share capital and management, recommend an ordinary partnership with a clear agreement; it does not remove personal liability.

point.bm: Milikan tunggal bergantung pada modal seorang pemilik dan membolehkan keputusan sendiri, tetapi sumber mungkin terhad.
point.en: A sole proprietor relies on one owner’s capital and makes decisions independently, but resources may be limited.

point.bm: Perkongsian biasa menggabungkan modal dan kemahiran; keputusan serta tanggungjawab perlu dipersetujui untuk mengurangkan konflik.
point.en: An ordinary partnership pools capital and skills; decisions and responsibilities need agreement to reduce conflict.

point.bm: Kedua-dua bentuk biasa mempunyai liabiliti tidak terhad. Jika dua rakan mahu berkongsi modal dan pengurusan, cadangkan perkongsian biasa dengan perjanjian jelas; ia tidak menghapuskan liabiliti peribadi.
point.en: Both ordinary forms have unlimited liability. If two friends want to share capital and management, recommend an ordinary partnership with a clear agreement; it does not remove personal liability.

prompt.en: Turn “we want better service” into a measurable objective, with baseline, target, timeframe and protection against misleading measurement.

modelAnswer.bm:

Track resolution or satisfaction so speed does not replace quality.

point.en: Track resolution or satisfaction so speed does not replace quality.

stem.bm: Pekerja baharu membuat kesilapan kerana tidak memahami prosedur. Langkah awal terbaik?
stem.en: New workers make errors because procedures are unclear. Best first action?

options.bm: Induksi dan latihan kerja dengan semakan kefahaman

options.bm: Pengambilan lebih ramai pekerja tanpa latihan prosedur
options.en: Recruit more workers without procedure training

explanation.bm: Masalah pengetahuan memerlukan latihan dan arahan yang dapat difahami.
explanation.en: Knowledge gaps require understandable instruction and training.

stem.bm: Menilai keberkesanan latihan khidmat pelanggan. Ukuran terbaik antara pilihan?

options.bm: Jumlah kos yang dibelanjakan untuk latihan
Jumlah pekerja yang hadir dalam sesi latihan

options.bm: Perubahan kadar penyelesaian dan mutu jawapan pelanggan
options.en: Change in resolution rate and response quality
The number of training hours provided

explanation.bm: Ukuran perlu menguji hasil kerja selepas latihan, bukan input aktiviti sahaja.
explanation.en: Measure job outcomes after training, not only activity inputs.

stem.bm: Deskripsi tugas digunakan terutama untuk apa?

options.en: Clarify the role’s duties and responsibilities

options.bm: Merekod pencapaian pekerja bagi penilaian prestasi

explanation.bm: Deskripsi tugas menjelaskan peranan; spesifikasi pekerja pula menerangkan kelayakan diperlukan.
explanation.en: Job description outlines the role; person specification states required qualifications.

stem.bm: Mesin penting kerap rosak. Tindakan pencegahan paling sesuai?
stem.en: A critical machine often fails. Best preventive action?

options.bm: Penambahan syif tanpa pemeriksaan komponen mesin
options.en: Add shifts without inspecting machine components

options.bm: Pembaikan hanya apabila mesin berhenti beroperasi
options.en: Repair only when the machine stops working

options.bm: Penyimpanan alat ganti tanpa jadual pemeriksaan
options.en: Store spare parts without an inspection schedule

options.bm: Penyelenggaraan berjadual berdasarkan penggunaan dan rekod kerosakan
options.en: Scheduled maintenance based on use and failure records

explanation.bm: Penyelenggaraan terancang mengurangkan gangguan dan memanjangkan kegunaan aset.
explanation.en: Planned maintenance reduces disruption and supports asset life.

stem.bm: Syarikat perlu melindungi kerahsiaan data pelanggan dan memulihkannya selepas kegagalan sistem. Gabungan kawalan paling lengkap?
stem.en: A company must protect customer-data confidentiality and restore data after system failure. Which combination provides the most complete controls?

options.bm: Akses semua pekerja dengan kata laluan kuat, tanpa sandaran
options.en: All-staff access with strong passwords but no backups

options.bm: Akses terhad tanpa menguji pemulihan sandaran
options.en: Limited access without testing backup restoration

options.bm: Sandaran diuji tetapi semua pekerja boleh mengubah semua rekod
options.en: Tested backups but all workers can edit every record

options.bm: Akses mengikut peranan dan sandaran yang diuji pemulihannya
options.en: Role-based access and backups with tested restoration

explanation.bm: Akses minimum dan pemulihan diuji melindungi kerahsiaan serta kesinambungan.
explanation.en: Limited access and tested recovery protect confidentiality and continuity.

stem.bm: Perniagaan mempertimbangkan perisian baharu. Penilaian paling lengkap?
stem.en: A business considers new software. Most complete evaluation?

options.bm: Harga lesen awal dan tempoh diskaun sahaja
options.en: Initial licence price and discount period only

options.bm: Reputasi pembekal tanpa mengira kos latihan dan operasi
options.en: Supplier reputation without training and operating costs

options.bm: Ciri perisian tanpa menilai keserasian sistem sedia ada
options.en: Software features without assessing existing-system compatibility

options.bm: Jumlah kos, latihan, keserasian dan manfaat kerja
options.en: Total cost, training, compatibility and work benefits

explanation.bm: Pelaksanaan melibatkan lebih daripada harga pembelian awal.
explanation.en: Implementation involves more than the initial purchase price.

stem.bm: Mesin digunakan lima tahun. Prinsip padanan pembiayaan yang sesuai?
stem.en: A machine is used for five years. Suitable financing matching principle?

options.bm: Pembiayaan jangka panjang sepadan dengan hayat aset
options.en: Long-term finance matched to asset life

options.bm: Kredit pembekal 30 hari untuk menanggung kos aset lima tahun
options.en: Thirty-day trade credit to finance the five-year asset

options.bm: Pinjaman sebulan yang perlu dibayar sebelum mesin menjana tunai
options.en: A one-month loan due before the machine generates cash

options.bm: Overdraf jangka pendek sebagai sumber utama lima tahun
options.en: Short-term overdraft as the main source for five years

explanation.bm: Pembiayaan perlu selaras tempoh penggunaan dan keupayaan bayaran.
explanation.en: Finance should fit use duration and repayment capacity.

stem.bm: Untung tertahan sebagai pembiayaan dalaman mempunyai kelebihan apa?
stem.en: What is an advantage of retained profit as internal finance?

options.bm: Dana tersebut memerlukan pembayaran faedah kepada bank
Dana tersebut tidak memerlukan pinjaman baharu
options.en: Those funds do not require new borrowing

options.bm: Dana tersebut perlu dibayar balik mengikut ansuran pinjaman
options.en: Those funds must be repaid in loan instalments

options.bm: Dana tersebut menambah pemegang saham baharu

explanation.bm: Dana dalaman mengurangkan keperluan hutang tetapi tetap terhad dan ada kos lepas.
explanation.en: Internal funds reduce borrowing needs but remain limited and have opportunity cost.

stem.bm: Dua pinjaman sama amaun dan kadar iklan. Apa lagi perlu dibandingkan?
stem.en: Two loans have equal principal and advertised rates. What else should be compared?

options.bm: Ansuran bulanan sahaja tanpa bilangan ansuran
options.en: Monthly payment alone without the number of instalments

options.bm: Tempoh, fi dan jumlah pembayaran balik
Cagaran sahaja tanpa kos sepanjang tempoh pinjaman
Jumlah diluluskan sahaja tanpa fi tambahan
options.en: Approved amount alone without additional fees

explanation.bm: Kadar iklan sahaja tidak menentukan jumlah kos dan beban tunai.
explanation.en: Advertised rate alone does not determine total cost and cash burden.

stem.bm: Jualan RM 80 000, kos jualan RM 50 000. Untung kasar?
stem.en: Sales RM 80,000, cost of sales RM 50,000. Gross profit?

explanation.bm: Untung kasar = jualan−kos jualan; belanja operasi belum ditolak.
explanation.en: Gross profit is sales minus cost of sales, before operating expenses.

stem.bm: Aset semasa RM 24 000, liabiliti semasa RM 12 000. Nisbah semasa?
stem.en: Current assets RM 24,000, current liabilities RM 12,000. Current ratio?

explanation.bm: 24 000/12 000 =2; tafsiran perlu komposisi dan kecairan aset.
explanation.en: Ratio is 2; interpretation also needs asset composition and liquidity.

stem.bm: Untung bersih RM 8 000 daripada jualan RM 100 000. Margin untung bersih?
stem.en: Net profit RM 8,000 on sales RM 100,000. Net profit margin?

stem.bm: Usahawan menghasilkan reka bentuk baharu, menguji prototaip dengan pelanggan dan mengubah suai fungsi produk. Ciri manakah paling jelas ditunjukkan?
stem.en: An entrepreneur creates a new design, tests prototypes with customers and revises product functions. Which trait is most clearly shown?

explanation.bm: Menghasilkan dan menambah baik reka bentuk menunjukkan kreativiti serta inovasi. Ujian prototaip juga membantu mengurus risiko, tetapi soalan menekankan pembaharuan produk.
explanation.en: Creating and improving designs demonstrates creativity and innovation. Prototype testing also manages risk, but the question emphasises product improvement.

stem.bm: Mengapa risiko usahawan perlu dikira?
stem.en: Why should entrepreneurial risk be calculated?

options.bm: Memilih projek dengan pulangan tertinggi tanpa menilai variasi
options.en: Choose the highest-return project without assessing variability

options.bm: Menggunakan nilai jualan pesaing sebagai jaminan pulangan sendiri
options.en: Use competitor sales as a guarantee of own returns

options.bm: Menilai kebarangkalian, kesan dan langkah mengurangkan risiko
options.en: Assess likelihood, impact and risk-reduction measures

options.bm: Menilai hasil jualan tanpa mempertimbangkan kerugian
options.en: Assess sales revenue without considering losses

explanation.bm: Pengurusan risiko memperbaiki keputusan tetapi tidak menghapus ketidakpastian.
explanation.en: Risk management improves decisions without eliminating uncertainty.

stem.bm: Dalam kajian, 50 orang menyatakan minat tetapi hanya 5 bersedia membeli pada harga sasaran. Berapakah peratus kumpulan berminat yang bersedia membayar?
stem.en: In a survey, 50 people express interest but only 5 are willing to buy at the target price. What percentage of the interested group is willing to pay?

explanation.bm: 5 ÷ 50 × 100% = 10%. Minat awal tidak sama dengan kesanggupan membeli; peratus ini belum menjamin jualan sebenar.
explanation.en: 5 ÷ 50 × 100% = 10%. Initial interest differs from willingness to buy; this percentage does not yet guarantee actual sales.

stem.bm: Lokasi kedai murah tetapi sukar diakses pelanggan sasaran. Apa perlu dinilai?
stem.en: A shop has low rent but poor target-customer access. What should be evaluated?

options.bm: Kos hiasan sahaja tanpa menilai pengangkutan
options.en: Decoration cost alone without considering transport

options.bm: Sewa bulanan sahaja sebagai ukuran kos lokasi
options.en: Monthly rent alone as the location-cost measure

options.bm: Saiz ruang sahaja tanpa menilai jumlah pelanggan
options.en: Floor area alone without considering customers

options.bm: Jumlah kos, akses pelanggan dan potensi jualan
options.en: Total costs, customer access and sales potential

explanation.bm: Lokasi menjejaskan permintaan, logistik dan kos lain.
explanation.en: Location affects demand, logistics and other costs.

stem.bm: Modal permulaan perlu merangkumi apa selain peralatan?
stem.en: What should start-up capital include besides equipment?

options.bm: Nilai jualan kredit sebagai tunai segera keseluruhannya
options.en: Credit sales value as cash immediately available

options.bm: Untung ramalan sebagai tunai yang sudah tersedia
options.en: Forecast profit as cash already available

options.bm: Modal kerja untuk stok, sewa dan belanja sebelum kutipan mencukupi
options.en: Working capital for stock, rent and expenses before receipts suffice

options.bm: Susut nilai tahunan sebagai satu-satunya tunai operasi
options.en: Annual depreciation as the sole operating cash

explanation.bm: Tunai diperlukan bagi stok, sewa dan belanja sebelum kitaran kutipan stabil.
explanation.en: Cash supports stock, rent and expenses before collections stabilise.

stem.bm: Mengapa lesen dan pendaftaran perlu disemak mengikut aktiviti/lokasi?
stem.en: Why check registration and licensing by activity/location?

options.bm: Aktiviti dan lokasi mempengaruhi keperluan pihak berkuasa berkaitan
options.en: Activity and location affect relevant authority requirements

options.bm: Lesen premis sama dengan pendaftaran bentuk pemilikan
options.en: A premises licence is the same as ownership-form registration

options.bm: Pendaftaran entiti sama dengan kelulusan semua premis
options.en: Entity registration is the same as all premises approvals

options.bm: Permit satu aktiviti meliputi semua aktiviti baharu di lokasi lain

explanation.bm: Semakan pihak berkuasa berkaitan mengesahkan keperluan yang terpakai.

options.bm: Jurang 400 unit membuktikan harga jualan terlalu rendah

options.bm: Ramalan jualan membuktikan mesin sudah mampu 1 000 unit

options.bm: Ramalan jualan tidak sepadan dengan kapasiti operasi

explanation.bm: Ramalan, kapasiti dan kewangan perlu diselaraskan untuk pelaksanaan.

stem.bm: Kos tetap RM 2 000, harga RM 20, kos berubah RM 12/unit. Titik pulang modal unit?
stem.en: Fixed cost RM 2,000, price RM 20, variable cost RM 12/unit. Break-even units?

explanation.bm: Sumbangan seunit 20−12=8;2 000/8=250.
explanation.en: Contribution per unit is 8; break-even is 250.

explanation.en: The summary explains the proposal and basis before detail.

prompt.bm: Kedai mengalami pertukaran pekerja tinggi. Cadangkan tiga langkah HR dengan alasan dan data untuk menilai hasil.
prompt.en: A shop has high staff turnover. Suggest three HR measures with reasons and evaluation data.

modelAnswer.bm:
Semak beban kerja dan maklum balas pekerja keluar, kemudian baiki pembahagian tugas jika beban tidak seimbang.
Sediakan latihan serta laluan perkembangan kerjaya untuk meningkatkan kemahiran dan peluang kemajuan.

point.en: Review workloads and exit feedback, then improve duty allocation if workloads are uneven.

point.bm: Sediakan latihan serta laluan perkembangan kerjaya untuk meningkatkan kemahiran dan peluang kemajuan.
point.en: Provide training and career-development paths to improve skills and advancement opportunities.

point.bm: Tetapkan ganjaran serta jadual yang adil untuk mengurangkan ketidakpuasan; bandingkan kadar keluar pekerja dan kepuasan sebelum serta selepas perubahan.
point.en: Set fair rewards and schedules to reduce dissatisfaction; compare turnover and satisfaction before and after changes.

prompt.bm: Bandingkan membeli dan menyewa pencetak untuk perniagaan bermusim. Nyatakan dua kos/risiko dan satu cara menilai pilihan.
prompt.en: Compare buying and renting a printer for a seasonal business. Give two costs/risks and one evaluation method.

modelAnswer.bm:
Membeli memerlukan modal awal serta kos penyelenggaraan dan susut nilai.
Menyewa mempunyai bayaran berkala dan syarat kontrak tetapi boleh mengurangkan modal awal.
Bandingkan jumlah kos bagi tempoh dan volum sama, termasuk masa henti serta fleksibiliti.
modelAnswer.en:
Buying needs upfront capital, maintenance and depreciation.
Renting has recurring fees/contract terms but may reduce upfront capital.
Compare total cost over equal duration/volume, including downtime and flexibility.

point.bm: Membeli memerlukan modal awal serta kos penyelenggaraan dan susut nilai.
point.en: Buying needs upfront capital, maintenance and depreciation.

point.bm: Menyewa mempunyai bayaran berkala dan syarat kontrak tetapi boleh mengurangkan modal awal.
point.en: Renting has recurring fees/contract terms but may reduce upfront capital.

point.bm: Bandingkan jumlah kos bagi tempoh dan volum sama, termasuk masa henti serta fleksibiliti.
point.en: Compare total cost over equal duration/volume, including downtime and flexibility.

prompt.bm: Perniagaan memerlukan RM 20 000 mesin dan RM 3 000 modal kerja bermusim. Cadangkan sumber berbeza serta dua perkara yang perlu disemak sebelum menerima pembiayaan.
prompt.en: A business needs RM 20,000 for machinery and RM 3,000 seasonal working capital. Suggest suitable sources and two checks before financing.

modelAnswer.bm:
Mesin RM 20 000: contoh pinjaman berjangka bank dengan tempoh sepadan hayat aset, jika aliran tunai mampu membayar ansuran.
Modal kerja bermusim RM 3 000: contoh overdraf jangka pendek dalam had dipersetujui, dibayar apabila hasil jualan dikutip.
Bandingkan jumlah kos termasuk faedah dan fi; semak kemampuan pembayaran daripada bajet tunai serta syarat atau cagaran sebelum memilih.
modelAnswer.en:
RM 20,000 machinery: for example, a bank term loan matched to the asset’s life, if cash flow can meet repayments.
RM 3,000 seasonal working capital: for example, a short-term overdraft within the agreed limit, repaid when sales receipts arrive.
Compare total cost including interest and fees; check repayment capacity from a cash budget and terms or collateral before choosing.

point.bm: Mesin RM 20 000: contoh pinjaman berjangka bank dengan tempoh sepadan hayat aset, jika aliran tunai mampu membayar ansuran.
point.en: RM 20,000 machinery: for example, a bank term loan matched to the asset’s life, if cash flow can meet repayments.

point.bm: Modal kerja bermusim RM 3 000: contoh overdraf jangka pendek dalam had dipersetujui, dibayar apabila hasil jualan dikutip.
point.en: RM 3,000 seasonal working capital: for example, a short-term overdraft within the agreed limit, repaid when sales receipts arrive.

point.bm: Bandingkan jumlah kos termasuk faedah dan fi; semak kemampuan pembayaran daripada bajet tunai serta syarat atau cagaran sebelum memilih.
point.en: Compare total cost including interest and fees; check repayment capacity from a cash budget and terms or collateral before choosing.

prompt.bm: Jualan RM 120 000, kos jualan RM 72 000, belanja operasi RM 30 000, aset semasa RM 40 000, liabiliti semasa RM 20 000. Hitung untung kasar, untung bersih dan nisbah semasa; nyatakan satu had analisis.
prompt.en: Sales RM 120,000, cost of sales RM 72,000, operating expenses RM 30,000, current assets RM 40,000, current liabilities RM 20,000. Calculate profits and current ratio, and one limitation.

modelAnswer.bm:
Untung kasar RM 48 000; untung bersih RM 18 000.
Nisbah semasa 2:1.
Nisbah sahaja tidak menunjukkan masa kutipan atau mutu inventori; banding tempoh dan konteks.
modelAnswer.en:
Gross profit RM 48,000; net profit RM 18,000.
Current ratio 2:1.
A ratio alone misses collection timing/inventory quality; compare periods and context.

point.bm: Untung kasar RM 48 000; untung bersih RM 18 000.
point.en: Gross profit RM 48,000; net profit RM 18,000.

point.bm: Nisbah sahaja tidak menunjukkan masa kutipan atau mutu inventori; banding tempoh dan konteks.
point.en: A ratio alone misses collection timing/inventory quality; compare periods and context.

prompt.bm: Anda mahu menjual perancang belajar. Rancang ujian kecil sebelum pengeluaran besar: pelanggan sasaran, bukti permintaan dan had risiko.
prompt.en: You want to sell study planners. Design a small pilot before mass production: target users, demand evidence and risk limits.

modelAnswer.bm:
Contoh sasaran: pelajar SPM yang mahu menyusun jadual ulang kaji; temu bual beberapa pelajar tentang masalah perancangan mereka.
Uji prototaip dan harga, kemudian rekod pesanan sebenar dengan syarat jelas; bezakan komen berminat daripada pembelian.
Hadkan kos dan kuantiti kelompok pertama mengikut dana; teruskan jika pesanan, margin dan kepuasan menyokongnya, atau ubah reka bentuk jika bukti lemah.
modelAnswer.en:
Example target: SPM students organising revision schedules; interview several students about their planning problems.
Test prototypes and prices, then record genuine orders with clear terms; distinguish interested comments from purchases.
Limit first-batch cost and quantity to available funds; continue if orders, margins and satisfaction support it, or revise the design if evidence is weak.

point.bm: Contoh sasaran: pelajar SPM yang mahu menyusun jadual ulang kaji; temu bual beberapa pelajar tentang masalah perancangan mereka.
point.en: Example target: SPM students organising revision schedules; interview several students about their planning problems.

point.bm: Hadkan kos dan kuantiti kelompok pertama mengikut dana; teruskan jika pesanan, margin dan kepuasan menyokongnya, atau ubah reka bentuk jika bukti lemah.
point.en: Limit first-batch cost and quantity to available funds; continue if orders, margins and satisfaction support it, or revise the design if evidence is weak.

prompt.bm: Sediakan senarai persediaan kedai makanan kecil: pelanggan/lokasi, sumber operasi dan keperluan pematuhan. Jelaskan bagaimana bajet tunai membantu.
prompt.en: Prepare a small food-shop checklist: customers/location, operating resources and compliance. Explain how a cash budget helps.

modelAnswer.bm:
Kaji pelanggan, akses dan pesaing bagi anggaran permintaan.
Rancang peralatan, pembekal, pekerja dan modal kerja.
Semak pendaftaran/lesen dengan pihak berkuasa berkaitan; bajet tunai mengenal pasti masa kekurangan dana.
modelAnswer.en:
Study customers, access and competition to estimate demand.
Plan equipment, suppliers, staffing and working capital.
Check registration/licences with authorities; a cash budget identifies funding shortfalls over time.

point.bm: Kaji pelanggan, akses dan pesaing bagi anggaran permintaan.
point.en: Study customers, access and competition to estimate demand.

point.bm: Rancang peralatan, pembekal, pekerja dan modal kerja.
point.en: Plan equipment, suppliers, staffing and working capital.

point.bm: Semak pendaftaran/lesen dengan pihak berkuasa berkaitan; bajet tunai mengenal pasti masa kekurangan dana.

prompt.bm: Rancang perniagaan dengan harga RM 30, kos berubah RM 18/unit, kos tetap RM 3 600/bulan dan kapasiti 400 unit. Hitung pulang modal, untung pada 400 unit dan satu risiko ramalan.
prompt.en: Plan a business with price RM 30, variable cost RM 18/unit, fixed cost RM 3,600/month and capacity 400 units. Find break-even, profit at 400 and a forecast risk.

modelAnswer.bm:
Sumbangan RM 12; pulang modal 3 600/12=300 unit.
Untung pada 400=(30−18)×400−3 600=RM 1 200.
Kapasiti bukan permintaan terjamin; uji pasaran dan sensitiviti volum/kos.
modelAnswer.en:
Contribution RM 12; break-even 300 units.
Profit at 400 units is RM 1,200.
Capacity is not guaranteed demand; test market and volume/cost sensitivity.

point.bm: Kapasiti bukan permintaan terjamin; uji pasaran dan sensitiviti volum/kos.
point.en: Capacity is not guaranteed demand; test market and volume/cost sensitivity.
